tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ga)༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gya
(ga)༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gya

tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'od gsal shes rab ma las legs 'khrungs pa'i// dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i zung 'jug sku// rig ma'i skyes bu rdo rje 'chang dbang dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'phags mchog klu sgrub gzhung lugs gangs ri las// rmad byung bskyed rim man ngag chu bo'i rgyun// mkhas mang gzhung gi rgyun lam las drangs nas// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i lam bzang bshad kyis nyon// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam bsgom par bya ba la gsum ste/ rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis kyi dang po tshogs gnyis bsag pa ni/ ri bo la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ 'jam pa'i stan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug nas/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar bsdu'o// de nas/ khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam gyur dngos kun ngo bo nyid// dag cing zhi la rnam dben mchog zhi 'di ni rnal 'byor pa nyid yul// go dka' brtag par dka' la bdag gzhan rab phan khyab cing mtshan ma med// rgyal ba'i bde ba mnyam med mnyam sku mi rtog tshul gcig la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas phyag bya/ thugs ka nas rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥmaṇ+ḍa la/

sa pa ri wā ra/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pes me tog dang*/ dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me dang*/ gan+dhes dri dang*/ nai wi d+yes zhal zas dang*/ shab+das rol mo rnams dbul/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su shap+ta sgra/ gan+dhe dri/ ra sa ro/ spar+ṣe reg bya rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pa ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// zhes sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar bshad pa'i tshig lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥs tshogs zhing gshegs par bsam mo// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig snyam pa'i tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du bsams la/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de ye shes kyi tshogs so// gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa la gsum gyi/ dang po bdag bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du bsam mo// de dag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i byang sems rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar babs pa las hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje/ de las mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur pa thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka ces pas thugs ka nas phyir byung*/ phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar gcig du 'dus ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas/ rang la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ rtsa zhal nag po drag po'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// gnyis pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'bar ba bsams la/

de las khro bo bcu'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus khro bo bcu'i skur gyur nas/ rang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams dang bcas pa rnams su 'khod par bsams la/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi bar zhal phyag 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bsgom/ de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs nas mdun du 'dug ste/ bdag gis ci bgyi zhes bka' nod pa la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje de lcags kyur gyur nas/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis bsdigs bzhin pas bkug nas/ khro bo bcu la gtad pas phyi rol du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa'i nang du bcug par bsam mo// de nas byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje phur bu stod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa can/ lte ba man chad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can me dpung rab tu 'bar ba bcu spros te/ phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor zug par bsam/ de nas gnod mdzes la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gh+nān/ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes kyi lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me 'bar bar gyur nas/ phur bus spyi bo nas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar phug ste/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi bar du son par phur bus btab pas/ lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/

yid rnam par rtog pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par bsams la/ gnod mdzes rnams 'og gi gnod mdzes la bsdu/ de nas khro bo dang phur bu las me 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bgegs kyi 'khor gdug pa can rnams tshig cing phyogs bcur bros nas me lce rnams slar 'dus te phyi rol du me'i rwa bar gyur par bsam mo// de nas/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dza/ zhes brjod pas/ khro bo'i phyi ru rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ de'i nang du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gur dang*/ 'og gzhi hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po bsams la go cha bya zhing*/ ngag tu yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ cung zad bzlas pas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// bsgom pa'ang dmigs su med pa'o// zhes brjod la/ snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thim par bsams te/ ye shes kyis bskyed pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum pa kha dog dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i logs gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar bas mtshan pa'i logs gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa'i logs gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/

de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i logs gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan par bsam mo// de nas rlung gis me sbar/ mes chu bskol/ chus sa bzhu ste/ thams cad ro gcig du 'dres pa las sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur par bsams te/ rdo rje'i sa'i cha bskyed pa'o// de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng na/ gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su// chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ dril bu dang rnga yab dang me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ me long dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dang*/ steng du mda' yab pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba/ de dag gi bar rnams su rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur gyi rtse bzhir gdugs bzhis mdzes shing*/ phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ gzungs ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi'i sa gzhi la rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'o// de'i nang du lha snam rim pa gnyis shar dkar/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu'i dbus su dkyil 'khor nang ma phyi nas 'od zer sna lngas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i phyi'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur ba'i nang du/ thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan gtso bo dang shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ de ma gtogs lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan te thams cad kyang lha rdzas kyi rin po che las grub par bsams te gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum/ lhag mos kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin no// dang po ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum reg bya rdo rje ma zhal phyag yab dang 'dra ba dang snyoms par 'jug par bsam/ de dang dus mnyam du shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal can/

g.yas nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub du 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pas pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs kar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas na ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la/ rin po che'i cod paṇa prog zhu gsol ba/ rin po che'i snyan rgyan dang mgul rgyan dang*/ se mo do dang*/ do shal dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub kyis brgyan pa/ sku ltos lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal byas pa/ smad lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o// shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po rtsa ba dmar ba/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs kar ut+pal kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang gu don grub gyi cod paṇa can/

ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi wang sngon po bsgreng ba/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo dang ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo/ 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang gu/ don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag mas rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du sngar gyi reg bya rdo rje ma ste/ lha mo dgu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sil sgra 'byin pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ lha'i na bza' sna tshogs pas mdzes pa'o// rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su byams pa dang*/ g.yon du sa snying gnyis dkar po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ byams pa'i g.yas dang pos klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rnam snang lta bu/

lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su phyag rdor dang g.yon du nam snying gnyis/ rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ zhal phyag rin 'byung lta bu/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal gnyis/ 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ zhal phyag 'od dpag med lta bu/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su sgrib sel dang*/ g.yon du kun bzang gnyis don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ zhal phyag don grub dang 'dra ba de thams cad kyang zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas na dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po ral gri/ g.yon snga ma dang 'dra ba/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas dkur brten pa dang dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon gshin rje gshed dang 'dra ba/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang dgra s+t+wa zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba/

g.yas lhag mas rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon lhag mas zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa pad+ma dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po rdo rje 'khor lo// g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon lhag mas sdigs mdzub ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ khro bo bcu ka'ang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ bzhin shin tu rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mi bzad pa'i ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag po sgrogs shing mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pas 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ sbrul mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna ba la brgyan pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul pa la brgyan pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas pa/ stobs rgyu ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bu'i ska rags byas pa/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsams te/ lhag mos kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// de nas lha so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs te/ lha rnams kyi sku mthong bas sgrib pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud rnam par dag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par bsams te/ lhag mos kyi mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i dang po rnal 'byor ni/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad spyan drangs te/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad nas/ rkang mthil du gnod mdzes rgyal po'i bar 'og sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs ltar/ lus kyi gnas rnams su bkod pas/ rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams dang ngo bo dbyer med par gyur te/ rang gi lus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab las grub pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bsams te/ lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'o// de nas lus dkyil gyi lha rnam snang*/ spyan ma gzugs rdo rje/ byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ gshin rje gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams 'od gsal du thim/ de nas rin 'byung*/ mā ma kī/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgra rdo rje/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams 'od gsal du thim/ de nas 'od dpag med/ gos dkar mo/ dri rdo rje/ nam mkha'i snying po/ rta mgrin/ dbyug sngon can rnams 'od gsal du thim/ de nas don grub/ sgrol ma/

'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams 'od gsal du thim/ de nas steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis reg bya rdo rje dang bcas pa 'jam dpal la thim/ 'jam dpal gtso bo la de'ang 'od gsal du thim par bsams te/ lhag mos don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsdu ba'o// de ltar thams cad stong pa 'od gsal 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i de bzhin nyid du bsgoms la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsigs pa/ yi ge gsum dang pad+ma yas mar thim/ nyi ma mas yar thim te thams cad 'dus pas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bur bsam/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad bsdus nas zla ba la thim pas/ thams cad rang gi sems 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du bsgoms la/ oṃ dharmā dhā dhu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de zla ba las byang chub pa'o// gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgod de/ sa bon las byang chub pa'o// de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te de la thim pas/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o// de nas rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can du bsams pa ni sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o// gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ dang po'i mgon po'i thugs ka nas mi bskyod pa spros/ des nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par byas/ sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ slar sku gcig tu gyur pa bdag nyid la rjes su zhugs pas/ bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin po che ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams pa ni/ sprul skur bsgyur ba'o// de'i lus kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ kha dang sna bug g.yas g.yon 'og sgo ste/ rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ kun rdzob kyi sna rtse snying ga'i sna rtse gsang gnas dang lte ba gnyis ni gsang ba'i sna rtse ste/ sna rtse bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ rnam rtog gi bzhon pa ye shes lnga dag pa'i rlung lnga ni rtsig pa lnga/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ rgyu ma drwa ba/ rgyus pa drwa ba phyed pa/ byang sems dkar po'i cha ni zla phyed/ mig gi rnam shes me long*/ rna ba'i rnam shes ba dan/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi phreng ba/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ mig rta babs kyi steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan ma/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags/ sna rta babs la gnas pa'i ba dan/ lce dril bu/ rna ba sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang*/ zur gyi rdo rje rin po che/ lus kyi tshogs rnams rnga yab la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ yid dbang dbus kyi pad+ma/ lto ba bum pa ste/ rdo rje 'chang gi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam mo// de nas spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ dkar po las rnam snang*/

mgrin par 'du shes kyi ngo bo āḥdamar po las 'od dpag med/ snying gar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor ba'i ngo bo swā ser po las rin 'byung*/ brla rtsar 'du byed kyi ngo bo hā ljang gu las don grub/ lte bar sa khams kyi ngo bo lam̐ las spyan ma/ snying gar chu khams kyi ngo bo mām̐ las mā ma kī/ mgrin par me khams kyi ngo bo pam̐ las gos dkar mo/ spyi bo rlung khams kyi ngo bo tām̐ las sgrol ma/ mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo thiṃl las sa snying*/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las phyag rdor/ snar sna'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las nam snying*/ lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūm̐ las 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje'i sgor lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ las sgrib sel/ tshigs mtshams su tshigs mtshams kyi ngo bo saṃ las kun bzang*/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus kyi ngo bo maiṃ las byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra'i ngo bo hūm̐ las sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri'i ngo bo bam̐ las dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro'i ngo bo hoḥlas ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rang rang gi gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ lag pa g.yas par de'i ngo bo hūm̐ las gshin rje gshed/ de bzhin du g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ khar rta mgrin/ rdo rjer bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ las gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams bsams te/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni rang gi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/

de las spyan ma'i tshogs spros de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnam snang spyan ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo sku rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs gnas su// rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs gnas su// rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol// zhes gtso bo dang 'khor la gsol ba gdab pas/ rnam snang 'khor dang bcas pa bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ rang gi lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin// phung po lnga yi rab bkang bas// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis// bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /ces smon lam btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung te sku byin gyis brlab pa'o// lcer pad+ma la gnas pa'i ā:dmar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las gos dkar mo'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyis gnas nas 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang snyoms pa 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su gtso bo gsung rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlab gnas su// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs gnas su// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// zhes gtso 'khor la gsol btab pas/ 'od dpag med 'khor bcas bdag gi mgrin pa nas zhugs pas rang gi ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/

rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin// nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs// bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing*// chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /ces smon lam btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ste gsung byin gyis brlabs pa'o// snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las mā ma kī'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi bskyod pa mā ma kī dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo thugs rdo rje mtshan dpes spros pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs gnas su// rdo rje'i thugs kyis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlab gnas su// rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol// zhes gtso 'khor la gsol ba btab pas/ mi bskyod pa 'khor bcas rang gi snying ga nas zhugs pas/ rang gi sems thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin// gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa// bdag kyang de dang 'dra 'gyur zhing*// rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /ces smon lam btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung te thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas bdag nyid sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ste sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'o// rang dam tshig sems dpar yun ring du bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' gsung longs sku'i bdag nyid can/ yungs kar gyi tshad tsam par bsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar thugs chos sku'i ngo bo ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ nag po rtag tu 'char ba mar me chen po lta bu/ mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i rtags su snang ba'i phung po chen po 'bar bar bsam mo// rang gi spyi gtsug tu rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa snyoms 'jug gi sbyor bas zla ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs dang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi 'dzag pas sems dpa' gsum ka tshim zhing mnyes par bsams pa ni sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'o// gsum pa rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ phyi'i rang rigs kyi phyag rgya'am/ yang na snying ga nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya phyung*/ de khaṃ las rdo rje/ de las reg bya rdo rje mar bskyed/ de'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ dkar po ces pa nas/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi ngo bo tām̐ las sgrol ma bskyed pa'i bar dang*/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaṃḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma nas bha ga'i rtse mor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rang rang gi yab byang chub sems dpa' dang snyoms par 'jug bzhin par bsam/ lag pa g.yas par de'i ngo bo hūm̐ las ro langs ma/ de bzhin du g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ khar khro gnyer ma/ bha gar ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas par de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma/ g.yon par sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas par sna tshogs pad+ma/ g.yon par sna tshogs las ma/ spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil gnyis su de'i ngo bo hūm̐ las sa 'dzin lha mo rnams khro mo'i sku can/ nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa/

zhal phyag khro bcu bzhin bsams te// phyag rgya 'du bya ba'o// de nas rang gi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rtse mo dbus ma'i nor bu'i cha la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par bsams te/ rdo rje pad+ma 'du bya ba'o// snyoms par zhugs pas rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer lngas gang bar bsam/ de nas rang rin 'byung du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes pas snyoms par zhugs/ rang rdo rje 'chang du gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ glur blang zhing las la gnas par byas la/ phaṭa/ de nas rang don grub tu gyur par bsams la lus dkyil gyi lha thig ler zhu nas/ pad+ma'i dbus su babs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes nga rgyal gzung ngo*// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs spyi gtsug nas zhugs te zhu ba las rang yab yum gyi lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa thig le'i rnam par zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa/ thig le cha gnyis su gyur nas cha gcig bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par bskyed/ thig le cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur nas/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa las lha rnams la bskyed de/ de'ang dbus kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ de las mi bskyod pa zhal phyag sngar bzhin bsam/ de bzhin du shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ de las 'khor lo/ de las rnam par snang mdzad/ lho'i thig le oṃ āḥswā hūm̐/ de las nor bu/ de las rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐/ de las pad+ma/ de las 'od dpag med pa/

byang gi thig le oṃ āḥhā hūm̐/ de las ral gri/ de las don yod grub pa/ shar lho'i thig le oṃ āḥlam̐ hūm̐/ de las ut+pal dkar po/ de las spyan ma/ lho nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥmām̐ hūm̐/ de las ut+pal sngon po/ de las mā ma kī/ nub byang gi thig le oṃ āḥpam̐ hūm̐/ de las ut+pal dmar po/ de las gos dkar mo/ byang shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥtām̐ hūm̐/ de las ut+pal ljang gu/ de las sgrol ma ljang gu/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i thig le oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ de las me long dmar po/ de las gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ de las pi wang sngon po/ de las sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang gi thig le oṃ āḥbam̐ hūm̐/ de las dri'i dung chos/ de las dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥhoḥhūm̐/ de las bcud kyi snod/ de las ro rdo rje ma/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi thig le oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūm̐/ de las rdo rje/ de las reg rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar sgo'i g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥmaiṃ hūm̐/ de las klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa/ de las byams pa/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥthaliṃ hūm̐/ de las 'khor lo/ de las sa'i snying po/ lho'i g.yas phyogs kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ de las rin po che/ de las phyag na rdo rje/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ de las rin po che/ de las nam mkha'i snying po/ nub kyi g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ de las pad+ma/ de las 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ de las pad+ma/ de las 'jam dpal/ byang gi g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ de las ral gri/ de las sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥsam̐ hūm̐/ de las ral gri/ de las kun tu bzang po/ shar sgo'i thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ de las dbyug pa/

de las gshin rje gshed/ de bzhin du sa bon thams cad 'dra bar sbyar la/ lho sgo'i thig le rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/ de las shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgo'i thig le pad+ma dmar po/ de las pad+ma mthar byed/ byang sgo'i thig le sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las bgegs mthar byed/ shar lho'i thig le ral gri/ de las mi g.yo ba/ lho nub kyi thig le rdo rje/ de las 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ nub byang gi thig le rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po/ de las dbyug sngon can/ byang shar gyi thig le rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po/ de las stobs po che/ steng gi thig le rdo rje/ de las gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba/ 'og gi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ de las rdo rje/ de las gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams zhal phyag sngar lhag mos kyi skabs ltar bsams te/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o// de nas phyir spro ba'i tshe/ dang por mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i lha re re zhing yum gyi mkha' nas yab kyi thugs kar drangs/ thugs ka nas so so'i 'byin sngags kyis phyir spro ste/ de'ang badz+ra dhṛka ces brjod pas/ mi bskyod pa'i tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyi'i mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs te/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus mi bskyod pa ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur slar 'dus nas bdag nyid kyi mdun du gnas par bsam/ de bdag nyid kyi snying gar rjes su zhugs pas/ sngar gyi zla gdan nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhi ba/ de zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur te/ sku mdog mthing nag rtsa zhal nag po khros pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/

g.yon zhal dmar po 'dod chags chen po'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin cing*/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la/ rin po che'i cod paṇa prog zhu gsol ba/ rin po che'i snyan rgyan dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ se mo do dang*/ do shal dang*/ ska rags dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub kyi brgyan pa/ sku stod lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal byas pa/ smad lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs grol ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'dod chags chen po dang khro ba 'dres pa'i nyams can du bsam/ de nas rang zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis 'khor rnams spro ba'i phyir/ mkha' nang gi rnam snang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ thugs ka nas dzi na dzika

rgyal ba ces pas/ rnam snang spros pas/ spyi dang khyad par gti mug can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ rnam snang gi go 'phang la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus pa sogs thams cad la sbyar la/ slar 'dus nas shar gyi ri mig gis pad zla'i steng du bzhugs par bsam/ de bzhin du rat+na dhṛka rin chen 'dzin pa gis rin 'byung spros/ spyi dang khyad par nga rgyal dang ser sna'i nyon mongs pa sbyangs/ rin 'byung gi go 'phang la bkod/ lho'i ri mig gi pad+ma dang rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ ā ro l̥ka gis 'od dpag med spros/ spyi dang khyad par 'dod chags can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ nub kyi re mig la pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ shes rab 'dzin pa pra dzñā dhṛka gis don grub spros/ spyi dang khyad par log pa'i ngag rdzun du smra ba can dang phrag dog sbyangs/ don grub kyi go 'phang la bkod/ byang gi ri mig gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ mo ha ra tis gti mug dga' ma spyan ma spros/ sems can gdon dang nad kyis gdungs pa rnams zhi bar mdzad de/ shar lho'i zla ba'i gdan la 'khod/ zhe sdang dga' ma/ dā+e ṣa ra tis mā ma kī spros/ sems can bgegs chen pos gzir ba rnams thugs rje chen pos bsrungs te rgyas par mdzad de/ lho nub du rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ rā 'dod chags dga' ma ga ra tis gos dkar mo spros/ sems can gdon gyis nyen pa rnams zhi bar mdzad de/ nub byang du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/ badz+ra ra tis rdo rje dga' ma sgrol ma spros/ sems can thams cad dbang du mdzad de/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ rū pa gzugs rdo rje ma badz+ra gyis gzugs rdo rje ma spros/ yul gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ rgyal ba rnams gzugs sdug pa'i bde bas mchod de/

rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ shap+ta badz+ra sgra rdo rje gyis sgra rdo rje ma spros/ sgra'i skye mched sbyangs/ sgra'i bde bas mchod de/ lho nub kyi grwar rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ dri rdo rje gan+dhe badz+ra gyis dri rdo rje ma spros/ dri'i skye mched sbyangs/ dri'i bde bas mchod de/ nub byang gi grwar pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/ ra ro rdo rje sa badz+ra gyis ro rdo rje ma spros/ ro'i skye mched sbyangs/ ro'i bde bas mchod de/ byang shar gyi grwar sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ spar+ṣe badz+ra reg rdo rje gyis reg rdo rje ma spros/ reg bya'i skye mched sbyangs/ rgyal ba rnams reg bya'i bde bas mchod de/ sngar gyi reg bya rdo rje dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ maiṃ byams pa tris byams pa spros/ rtsa rgyus dang*/ nyon yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag zad kyi mngon shes la bkod de/ shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su zla gdan la 'khod/ k+ṣi ti gar+bhas sa'i snying po sa snying spros/ mig dang mig gi rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang mig gis mngon shes la bkod de/ shar gyi snam bu'i g.yon phyogs su zla gdan la 'khod/ badz+ra phyag na rdo rje pā ṇis phyag rdor spros/ rna ba dang rna shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang*/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes la bkod de/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ kha gar+bhas nam mkha'i snying po nam snying spros/ sna dang sna shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sna dang sna'i mngon shes la bkod de/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yon du rin po che'i gdan la 'khod/ lo ke shwa 'jig rten dbang phyug ras 'jig rten dbang phyug spros/ lce dang lce shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lce dang lce'i mngon shes la bkod de/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/

mañdzu shrīs 'jam dpal 'jam dpal spros/ yid dang yid shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes la bkod de/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yon du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la 'khod/ thams cad sarba ṇi wa ra sgrib pa ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni rnam par bsal ba sa sgrib sel spros/ lus dang lus shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lus dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes la bkod de/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod/ sa man+ta bha dras kun tu bzang po kun bzang spros/ tshigs dang kun gzhi sbyangs/ rdo rje'i tshigs dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes la bkod de/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yon du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod par bsam/ ya mān+ta gshin rje mthar byed kṛ ta gyis gshin rje gshed spros/ dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs skrag par mdzad/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod de/ shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ shes rab mthar byed pra dzñān+ta kṛ ta gyis shes rab mthar byed spros/ gshin rje dang ma mo la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams bcom nas lho sgor 'khod/ pad+mān+ta pad+ma mthar byed kṛ ta gyis rta mgrin spros/ klu dang sa bdag gi gdon bcom ste nub sgor 'khod/ bigh+nan+ta bgegs mthar byed kṛ ta kyis bgegs mthar byed spros/ gnod sbyin dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i bgegs bcom ste byang sgor 'khod/ a tsa mi g.yo ba las mi g.yo ba spros/ yams nad btang ba'i me lha'i gdon rnams bcom ste shar lhor 'khod/ ṭak+ki rā dzas 'dod pa'i rgyal po 'dod rgyal spros/ bden bral gyi bgegs bcom ste lho nub du 'khod/ nī la dbyug sngon daṇ+ḍas dbyug sngon can spros/ yams nad dang rlung lha'i gdon rnams bcom ste nub byang du 'khod/ stobs po che ma hā ba las stobs po che spros/

mkha' 'gro dang dbang ldan gyi gdon rnams bcom ste byang shar du 'khod/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra wartis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba spros/ tshangs pa dang lha'i gdon thams cad bcom ste gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar 'khod/ sum+bha rā dzas gnod mdzes rgyal po gnod mdzes rgyal po'i tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug kā la kū ṭa la sogs pa dang klu dang sa bdag gi gdon bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams sku gcig du 'dus gnod mdzes ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur/ slar 'dus nas gtso bo'i 'og tu nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gzhal yas khang spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma sbyangs/ rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang dang 'dres te slar 'dus nas/ sngar gyi gzhal yas khang la thim pas gzhal yas khang du gyur par bsam/ de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ me long gi gzugs brnyan dang chu nang gi zla ba ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ yun ring du gsal btab cing bsgom mo// gsum pa las rgyal mchog la brgyad las/ dang po phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas/ de la brtan pa thob pa dang*/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam bsam pa/ de'i nang du bcud kyi sems can thams cad 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten rnams gzhal yas khang du bsams la/ brtan pa ma thob bar du bsgom zhing*/ thob nas 'og ltar spros/ yang na kun rdzob kyi sna rtser/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam gyi nang du rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor cig car du gsal btab la bsgom/

brtan pa thob nas 'og ltar spros te/ cig car lha bsgoms pa'i phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// yang na rang gtso bor gsal ba'i rtsa zhal gyi sna rtser zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed pa tsam gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa yungs 'bru tsam bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob pa dang*/ de las phyag mtshan gnyis pa spro/ de las gsum pa sogs nam mkha' khyab pa'i bar du spro zhing*/ slar gcig tu bsdu'o// de la brtan nas phyag mtshan de lha skur bsgyur te zhal phyag rnams gsal btab la bsgom/ de la brtan nas gong ltar spro zhing bsdu/ de la brtan nas de'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i spro bsdu la bslabs te/ rnam rtog shas che bas steng sgo la brten pa'i phra mo'o// yang*/ rang gi rdo rjer thig le yungs 'bru tsam sngon po dwangs shing gsal ba mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor bsgom mo// de la brtan nas rdo rje pad+ma 'du bya ba sngon du 'gro bas snyoms 'jug byas la yum gyi pad+mar spro/ de las thig le de mi bskyod pas gtso bo byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed nas/ phyir spro ba bu'i tshul du spro ba dang*/ des kyang snyoms 'jug sngon du 'gro bas lha spro ba ni tsha bo'i tshul du spro ba ste/ nyon mongs pa shas che bas 'og sgor thig le phra mo la bslab pa ste/ rim gyis lhar bskyed pa'i phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ lce mchu mi 'gul zhing*/ sgra spangs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig gis 'bru gsum ci nus bzlas so// gsum pa ngag gi bzlas pa ni/ lha rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas sa bon las lha tshogs spros/ des 'gro ba'i don byas/ sngags dang lhan cig snying ga'i sa bon la thim zhing sngags brjod pa rdzogs nas spros pa'i lha rnams ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la sdud pa'i tshul gyis bzlas pa ni don dam pa'i bzlas pa'o// bzlas bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ni de kho na nyid kyi snying po'o// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka swā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro l̥ka āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā dhṛka hā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti māṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti tāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+ra baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥspar+ṣe badz+ra khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmai tri maiṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥk+ṣi ti gar+bha thaliṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkha gar+bha oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsarba ṇi wa ra ṇi biskaṃ bhi ni oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bha dra saṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi g+nān ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsuṃ bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams so// bzhi pa gtso bo don dam pa la bzhugs pa ni/ de nas yum yab la thim/ yab dam tshig pa ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de zhabs kyu la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da 'od gsal du thim par bsam mo// lnga pa glus bskul nas bslang ba ni/ yum bzhis gtso bo ma mthong bas blta 'dod de/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bskul bar bsams la/ spyan mas/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs// dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol// mā ma kīs/

rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor los sems can kun la phan// sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog sgrub rab tu phan par gzigs// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba// 'jig rten dag gis dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rab tu brtson// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// spyod pa dri med kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod// sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs te dam tshig mchog gi phan pa'i yon tan che// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces bskul bas/ sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'od gsal las zung 'jug gi sku dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can du bzhengs te/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mthong bar gyur to// drug pa bstod pa dang mchod pa ni/ de la 'khor rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bstod par bsams la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/

de nas rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du/ so so'i ming yig dang po las skyes pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par bsam/ de rnams rang gi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas phyir 'phros nas bdag la mchod par bsams la/ nyer spyod dang 'dod yon lnga'i lha mos mchod pa ni phyi mchod do// de nas thod par bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i chang dang kha zas sbyangs pa'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams nas/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul bas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim par bsams pa ni nang mchod do// de nas rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsams pa ni gsang mchod do// bdun pa nye bar bsdu ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rten gzhal yas khang pa dang*/ brten pa lha 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur par bsam/ de dag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyis 'od zer 'phros/ des sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bas sgrib pa dag nas hūm̐ yig du gyur/ de na nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur par bsam/ de rnams rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ bdag la thim par bsam mo// de las langs nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms la/ chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// brgyad pa las kyi rab tu dbye ba ni/ bsgoms pas lus dub na rang gi spyi bo'i sting gi mtho gang tsam gyis 'phag par wa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus kyi 'og tu oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan par bsams la/ zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa las/

de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi kha dog lnga dang ldan pa babs pas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gang bar bsams te/ lus rgyas pa'i cho ga'o// kha zas za ba'i tshe/ bza' ba gang yin bshang pa dang*/ btung ba gang yin gci ba dang*/ sha gang yod glang po che la sogs pa las kyis shi ba'i sha lngar bsams te/ tha mal pa'i gtsang zhen spangs la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rdzas kyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ āḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs par byas/ oṃ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ des mnan pas mang por sbar te spel bar bsam pa'am/ spro na gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ kha zas sbyang ba'o// de nas lkog ma dung dmar po'i rnam par bsams la/ der hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ sngon po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus rwa sbubs can du yod pa'i rtse mor oṃ dkar po 'od zer zas la 'phro ba dang bcas par bsams te/ lkog ma sbyang ba'o// snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po me lce gsum 'phro ba dang*/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs su mos te/ kha zas oṃ gyi 'od kyis drangs nas/ snying ga'i dbus na lha thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐ la 'bul ba'i tshul gyis longs spyad do// gal te ma zhu ba sogs byung na/ gsang gnas su yaṃ las rlung*/ lte bar raṃ las me/ snying gar laṃ las sa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsams te/ rlung kha sbyor du byas pas rlung gis me sbar/ des sa bsregs/ des chu bskol te zhu bar gyur pa'i dwangs ma rnams lte ba'i me la sbyin sreg byas pas/ snyigs ma rnams thal bar song ste/ 'og sgo nas 'thon par bsams la/ rlung ro bsal te/ snying ga sbyang zhing nang gi sbyin sreg bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thun dang po la sngar bzhin nyer bsdu yan chad rdzogs par byas la/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang yin dang*// byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa'i// spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /ces sogs kyis smon lam btab la spyod lam la 'jug go /thun 'og ma gsum la/ sngar bzhin rgyas par bsgom pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ srung 'khor nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yan chad dang po sbyor ba rdzogs par bsgoms la/ de'i mthar bzlas pa dang mchod bstod nyer bsdu sogs bya'o// de'i tshe lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'i skabs su gdan rnams kyang rang la bsdu'o// thun bzhi ka'i rjes sam/ ma grub na thun tha ma'i mjug tu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma nges par phul te/ de'i cho ga yang kho bos logs su bkod pa ltar bya'o// mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe lus dkyil gyi lha rnams lhag mos 'od gsal du sdud pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bsdus pa'i mthar/ snying gar sems rtse gcig tu dmigs la gnyid kyi 'od gsal bzung la nyal/ nangs par ldang ba'i tshe 'od gsal las lha'i skur langs par bsams la/ rang gtso bor bsgom zhing snod bcud thams cad rdo rje 'chang dang dkyil 'khor du blta'o// de ltar gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus kyis thun bzhir bslab par byas na/ des dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon par rtogs nas/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// ma lus rgyal ba'i gsang gsum kun 'dus pa// dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub thabs 'di// 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel che la rab sbyangs pa// dad ldan shes rab rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor// blo bzang klu sgrub gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos bkod// nongs gyur mchis gang rje btsun bla ma dang*// mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams la bdag 'chags so// 'di sbyar dge ba nam mkha'i nor bu des// thub bstan gling bzhi kun tu gsal ba dang*// lam log mun pa'i bdud las rgyal ba dang*// rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i pad tshal rgyas phyir bsngo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/

bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas dang mdo dang bsres pa dang rnam gzhag rim pa dang 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba'i bskyed rim gyi skabs rnams las 'byung ba'i don rnams tshang bar bkod cing*/ 'grel pa gzhan nas 'byung ba'i spros pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhag nas nyams su blang bde bar mdzes byed kyi lo/ mgo zla ba'i yar tshes gcig la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen bzang pos bgyis so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par sgrub thabs kyi yan lag tu bris pa'o// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rim shin tu rnal 'byor la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bzhed pas/ tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba gnyis yod de/ dang po sgrub thabs mdor byas ltar na/ dang po'i mgon po'i thugs ka nas mi bskyod pa spros/ slar 'dus bdag nyid la zhugs pas/ bdag nyid sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par sgyur/ de las lus dkyil bkod na rnal 'byor chen po byas te/ de'i tshul yang kho bos sgrub thabs su gsal bar bkod zin to// sgrub thabs mdo dang bsres pa ltar na/ zla ba las byang chub pa yan chad byas nas/ zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgod de/ sa bon las byang chub pa'o// de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ de la thim pas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o// de nas rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can du bsams pa ni sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o// de nas shin tu rnal 'byor bya ste/ lugs 'di la/ dang po'i mgon po sprul sku bsgyur ba med pas/ rang nyid dang po'i mgon por bsgoms pa'i lus kyi mdun rgyab dang*/ g.yas g.yon bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ sna rtse bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ rnam rtog gi zhon pa ye shes lnga dag pa'i rlung lnga ni rtsig pa lnga/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ rgyu ma drwa ba/ rgyus pa drwa ba phyed pa/ byang sems dkar po'i cha ni zla phyed/ mig gi rnam shes me long*/ rna ba'i rnam shes ba dan/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi phreng ba/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ mig rta babs kyi steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan ma/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags/ sna rta babs la gnas pa'i ba dan/ lce dril bu/ rna ba sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang*/ zur gyi rdo rje rin po che/ lus kyi tshogs rnams rnga yab la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang brgyad ni/ ka ba brgyad/ yid dbang dbus kyi pad+ma/ lto ba bum pa ste/ dang po'i mgon po'i lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsam mo// de nas spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ dkar po las rnam snang*/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi ngo bo āḥdamar po las 'od dpag med/ snying gar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor ba'i ngo bo swā ser po las rin 'byung*/ brla rtsar 'du byed kyi ngo bo hā ljang gu las don grub/ lte bar sa khams kyi ngo bo laṃ las spyan ma/ snying gar chu khams kyi ngo bo māṃ las mā ma kī/

mgrin par me khams kyi ngo bo paṃ las gos dkar mo/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi ngo bo tāṃ las sgrol ma/ mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo thaliṃ las sa snying*/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las phyag rdor/ snar sna'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las nam snying*/ lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūm̐ las 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje'i sgor lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ las sgrib sel/ tshigs rnams su tshigs mtshams kyi ngo bo saṃ las kun bzang*/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus kyi ngo bo maiṃ las byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra'i ngo bo hūm̐ las sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri'i ngo bo baṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro'i ngo bo hoḥlas ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rang rang gi gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ lag pa g.yas par de'i ngo bo hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed/ de bzhin du g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ khar rta mgrin/ rdo rjer bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ las gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams kha dog dang dbyibs ci lta ba bzhin tu bsgom mo// de ltar rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs su byin gyis brlabs pas/ dang po'i mgon po byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/

rnal 'byor chen po man chad nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di ni mdo bsres kyi dgongs pa ste/ rnam gzhag rim pa dang*/ sgron gsal le'u dang po dang*/ zla grags gnyis pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de'i 'grel pa gnyis la sogs pa gzhung mang po'i don 'di ltar du shes par bya'o// des na phyis kyi bla ma rnams kyis shin tu rnal 'byor tshul gcig kho nar bzung nas mi 'grig pa'i bshad pa mang du byas pa rnams kyang zhib mor ma dpyad par snang ngo*// zhes shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sgrub thabs kyi yan lag tu bris pa'o// // ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi// yan lag gtor ma'i cho ga bri// 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na de'i drung dang*/ ma 'brel na rang gi mdun gzhi bzang po'i steng du/ gtor ma gnyis ji ltar 'byor ba'i rjas sna tshogs dang bcas shing*/ ba lang la sogs pa rang shi bar gyur pa'i sha dang*/ bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa bshams la/ nang mchod dang chu dang chang gis sbyangs/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod dang rdo rje dril bu yang bzhag go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyin pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ dang po mgron bskyed pa ni/ gnas skabs gzhan du gtor ma gtong na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa sngon du song nas/ stong par bsgom pa sogs bya zhing*/ thun rjes kho na la gtor ma gtong na/ de dag mi dgos pas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las mdun du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing*/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub cing rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa'i dbus su thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu so gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan dbus su nyi ma/ shar du zla ba sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bsam mo// de nas rang skad cig gis don yod grub par bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ bkod la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od 'phros khams gsum gyi sems can skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ slar yang 'od zer gyis 'gro ba de rnams bsdus nas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du phyin pa tsam gyis/ sems can de rnams skad cig gis lha sum cu so gnyis su gyur nas/ so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la/ dbus su zhe sdang rdo rje/ shar du rnam snang nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi bar gsal btab/ de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa rang gi mdun du 'ongs te bka' nod pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad khug cig ces bka' bsgos pas/ des rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor lha sum cu so gnyis spyan drangs pa la/ rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mdun gyi gtor ma la bdud rtsis gtor zhing*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/ hūm̐ ngam/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan par bsam/

de'i shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha rnams oṃ yig gis mtshan par bsam/ shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/ byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu rnams oṃ yig gis mtshan par bsam/ de'i steng gi bar snang la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rlung gi ba dan la phog rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams bskol te 'bar bar gyur/ steng gi rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa babs nas dkrugs shing de nyid du 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs nas/ dag pa'i shel ltar gyur par bsam/ pad+ma āḥdang bcas pas las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dri ma med par byas nas/ nyi ma'i mdog can gyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs par byas par bsam/ oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas bsnan pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med par spel zhing sbar bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum yang yang brjod do// gsum pa gtor ma dbul ba ni/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i rwa dbus ma la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis gtor ma drangs nas gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka pañdza a mṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥsuṃ bha rā dza pañdza a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum mam lnga brjod la dbul/ de nas nyer spyod dang*/ bdud rtsis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/

chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing zhi la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med par// de ltar chos 'di shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med gyis// 'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye// zhes bden stobs brjod/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku// ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che// 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba yis// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol/ de nas 'jig rten pa la gtor ma mi gtong na/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams 'dir bya// gtong na thun mong du byas pas rung ngo*// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po mgron bskyed pa ni/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ gtor snod kyi shar du skad cig gis dbang po ser skya glang po che la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he la gnas pa/ g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po sha rgyas pa gter la gnas pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa/

g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha ri dwags ser po la gnas pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ steng gi dbus su tshangs pa ser po ngang po la gnas pa/ zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang*// gnon po la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ de rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur pa las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phyi rol pa sogs phyogs skyong rkyang pa la 'bul na/ 'dir sngar bzhin gtor ma byin brlab bya la/ 'das gtor dang sbrel nas 'bul na/ sngar dus gcig la bya'i 'dir bya mi dgos so// gsum pa gtor ma dbul ba ni/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi ljags byin gyis brlabs pa sngar bzhin byas la/ rdo rje thal mo dang*/ oṃ da sha dika bya bas+thi te bh+yaḥ i ha a bas+thi te bh+yash+tsa de ba nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan dharba a su ra ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra ma ho ra ga bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ ut+mān+da a pasma ra/ ostā ra ka ā di bh+yo/ ba liṃ dā pa yā mi gṛ hī tā/ su kha sau ma na s+ya la bhi no bha ban+tu/ sbā naṃ tsa ni ru pa ḍa baṃ kurban+tu/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

i daṃ a mṛ ta/ piṇ+ḍaṃ bhuk+ta/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya/ shīn+tiṃ kurban+tu swa sti swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ de nas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas/ nyer spyod dang bdud rtsis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang*// 'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang*// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed dang ni brjed byed dang*// gnon po la sogs pa rnams la// gtor ma 'bul gyi bsnams nas kyang*// bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs kyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi yi// bza' ba la ni longs spyad nas// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos shing*// bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes pa// 'byung po'i bdag po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs sngar bzhin brjod la phrin las gzhol lo// gsum pa rjes ni/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas/ 'das pa'i lha rnams rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor la/ bsngo ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ stong nyid rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin par bya'o// mkhas pa gzhan gyis ye shes zhabs sogs kyi// gtor chog sbyar ba mdzes par ma mthong nas// mngon shes can dang klu byang gzhung bzhin du// gsal bar bris pa'i dge de 'gro la bsngo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta mngon shes can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga dang grub pa'i dbang phyug klu'i byang chub kyi cho ga nyi shu pa'i gtor chog gi skabs rnams la brten nas/

shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis nam mkhar dad pa'i sprin bsdus shing*// rnam dag cho ga'i 'brug sgra legs bsgrags pas// yid 'ong mchod pa'i char chen 'bebs mdzad pa// 'dren mchog klu yi dbang po la phyag 'tshal// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ye shes sku// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byed pa// mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i cho ga bshad kyis nyon// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus khyad par can gyi tshe bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa byed par 'dod pas/ don gsum ste/ sbyor ba rten dang mchod pa bsham pa/ dngos gzhi maṇ+ḍal sgrub cing mchod pa/ mjug mchod cing bstod nas gshegs su gsol ba'o// dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas dben par phyag dar dang skyang nul byas la/ der khru gang yan chad ji ltar 'tshams pa'i tshad kyis zlum por byas pa la/ ba'i rnam pa lnga'am/ dri bzang gis byugs la dbus su gnas srung gi don du gser ram me tog gcig bzhag de'i mtha'i zur bzhir mañdzi'i steng du/ mchod yon gyi snod dung chos bzhir me tog dang*/ nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ ku sha dang*/ til dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i mchod yon bsham/ de nas me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri chab dang*/ zhal zas rnams mchod yon bar gyi phyogs bzhir tshan pa re re bsham/ spyi'i mchod pa de'i nang maṇ+ḍal gyi phyi rol tsam du/

bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas gsum phyogs bzhir tshan pa bdun re dang*/ de'i nang gi shar du/ gtso bo'i mchod pa gsum/ nub tu yum gyi gsum/ de'i steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis kyi mchod pa gsum po shar nub tu 'god par rigs na'ang*/ bla ma dag lho byang du 'god kyin snang bas gang bde bya/ sgos mchod kyi nang gi zur bzhir/ mchod yon gyi bzed zhal bzhi me tog nyung zad re dang bcas pa bsham/ mchod pa'i phyi rol shar phyogs su gzhi bzang po'i steng du/ ci 'byor pa'i yo byad kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma rgyal mtshan nam ba dan gyis spras pa lnga'am bzhi bsham/ gzhan yang*/ bla re dang*/ ba dan dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ gos zung dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams ci 'byor du bshams shing*/ rang gi mdun du/ nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang gzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ mdun du dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ de la mchod pa rgyas par dbul ba'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ dpa' bo'i ston mo sogs dang 'brel na/ las kyi rdo rjes lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab par bya/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog rkyang pa la de dag mi dgos pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas la/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa nas brtsams te/ nyer bsdu'i bar gyi mngon par rtogs pa rnams rgyas par bsgoms la/ zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa ni dri bzang po'i chu la/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra u da ke hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pas chu byin gyis brlabs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes pas khrus bya/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pas rkang lag bkrus shing kha bshal lo// de nas srog chags med pa'i me tog gtsang ma'am/ dgun lta bu me tog med na/ de'i dod 'bras dkar po las byas la/ dri bzangs gi chus gtor te lag pas reg la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pa ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe/ ma hā puṣ+pe/ su puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pod+bha we/ puṣ+pa saṃ bha we/ puṣ+pa a wa kīr+ṇa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas me tog byin gyis brlab bo// de nas me tog dang chu lag pas bzung ste/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du cung zad gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta sarba bigh+nān a nut+sā da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bgegs bskrad la/ sngar gyi gnas srung ba'i me tog bsal/ de nas tsan+dan/ ga bur/ a ka ru rnams kyi chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal g.yas skor du khye ma med par byugs la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra re khe hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas dbus su/ oṃ su re khe sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ zhes pas lag pa'i rgyab tu me tog bzhag ste dbus su me tog spungs la bsrung*/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pas lag pa bkrus la/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med// zhes sogs ye shes kyis bskyed pa nas brtsams te/ sgrub thabs ltar gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed la/ tā la'i lo ma'am dū gu la'i ras gtsang mas dri bzang blangs la/ gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi gnas su zlum po re re byas la/ so so'i sngags/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes sogs lan bdun bzla/ dri'i thig le'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i bshad pa mi snang yang*/ bla ma dag mdzad kyin snang bas de ltar bya'o// de nas/ ā li kā li las byung ba// sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// gzhal yas khang dbus nyams dga' ba// zhes dbyangs gsal las bskyed par bshad pa ni/

dbyangs gsal las btus pa'i yig 'bru rnams las lha bskyed pa'i don yin pas mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams sa bon las bskyed par bya ste/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog mthing nag sogs zhal phyag rdzogs par bsgom/ shar du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor swā las rin 'byung*/ nub tu āḥlas 'od dpag med/ byang du hā las don grub/ shar lhor laṃ las spyan ma/ lho nub tu maṃ las mā ma kī/ nub byang du paṃ las gos dkar mo/ byang shar du tāṃ las sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu hūm̐ las sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du baṃ las dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du hoḥlas ro rdo rje ma/ gtso bo'i mdun du khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su maiṃ las byams pa/ g.yon du thaliṃ las sa snying*/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ las phyag rdor/ g.yon du oṃ las nam snying*/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon du hūm̐ las 'jam dpal/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ las sgrib sel/ g.yon du saṃ las kun bzang*/ shar sgor hūm̐ las gshin rje gshed/ de bzhin du khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang hūm̐ las bskyed cing lha thams cad kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rigs bdag rnams sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par bsgom mo// de nas lha rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can kha dog lnga pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ des 'og min gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la se gol gtogs/ de nas spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān sa ma ya ma nu smā ra ti tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu smā ra sa ma ya ma nu smā ra kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ces pas lha thams cad la thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan dbul/ rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas dri'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa'i lha dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ lha thams cad la rang rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyis dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung*// bla med bstod dang dam tshig bzung*// bzlas dang de bzhin gtor ma ste// dkyil 'khor mchod pa rnam pa dgu// zhes pa ltar/ don dgu las/ dang po phyi'i mchod pa lnga lnga las/ dang po nye bar spyod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du/ oṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo/ paṃ las me tog ma ser mo/ dhaṃ las bdug spos ma sngon mo/ daṃ las mar me ma dmar mo/ gaṃ las dri chab ma ljang gu/ naṃ las zhal zas ma dkar mo/ shaṃ las rol mo ma sngon mo rnams zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis kyis rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i mdangs dang ldan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas de rnams rang rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros dpag tu med par gyur nas/ mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du 'khod de/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi mchod rdzas rnams bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/
