shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams bskyed/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ thugs kyi dbang phyug chos dbyings ye shes dngos// dpal ldan mi bskyod mgon po 'khor bcas rnams// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag dang 'gro la dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ byang shar gyi dung chos nas bzed zhal du mchod yon dbul zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes gtso bo dang*/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ man chad thams cad la sbyar la/ oṃ khaṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri reg bya rdo rje dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ sum+bha rā dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas gnod mdzes te lha re re zhing mchod yon dbul/ de nas sngar gyi tshigs bcad kyis/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ me tog 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa bcug gzhan rnams 'dra bar sbyar la/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sbyar bas me tog dbul/ bdug spos 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs dang*/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sbyar bas bdug spos dang*/ mar me 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs dang*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sbyar bas mar me dang*/ dri mchog 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs dang*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sbyar bas dri chab dang zhal zas 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs dang*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ nai wi t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sbyar bas zhal zas dang*/ rol mo 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs dang*/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ shab+daṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

zhes sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzña pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bhā we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho/ a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rol mo ci 'byor pa dbul lo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas/ shar na bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ sku yi dbang phyug me long ye shes dngos// rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad 'khor bcas rnams// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di bzhes la// bdag dang 'gro la dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ lho nub kyi mchod yon gyi snod nas bzed zhal du lan bdun du dbul zhing*/ oṃ oṃ dzi na dzika ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rnam snang dang*/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ man chad thams cad la sbyar/ oṃ laṃ mo ha ra tī spyan ma dang*/ oṃ raṃ rū pa badz+rī gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ oṃ maiṃ mai trī byams pa dang*/ oṃ thaliṃ k+ṣi ti gar+bha sa snying dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛ ta gshin rje gshed dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ a tsa la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mi g.yo ba rnams la mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams sngar gyi tshigs bcad 'don pa bsgyur zhing*/ shar phyogs kyi lha bdun po'i sngags kyi mthar puṣ+paṃ sogs sbyar la dbul lo// de nas lho phyogs kyi lha rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ yon tan dbang phyug mnyam nyid ye shes dngos// 'dren pa rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor bcas rnams// lha rdzas man chad 'dra bar sbyar la/ nub byang gi dung chos nas mchod yon dbul zhing*/ oṃ swā rat+na dhṛka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rin 'byung dang*/ oṃ māṃ dwe ṣa ra tī mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ shaṃ shab+dā badz+rī sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi phyag rdor dang*/ oṃ oṃ kha gar+bha nam snying dang*/

oṃ hūm̐ pra dzñān+ta kṛ ta shes rab mthar byed dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ṭak+ki rā dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'dod rgyal rnams la mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams rol mo'i bar sbyar la dbul lo// de nas nub phyogs pa'i lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ gsung gi dbang phyug sor rtog ye shes dngos// skyob pa 'od dpag med mgon 'khor bcas rnams// lha rdzas man chad dang*/ byang shar gyi dung chos nas mchod yon dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'od dpag med dang*/ oṃ baṃ rā ga ra tī gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ gaṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+rī dri rdo rje dang*/ oṃ oṃ lo ke shwa ra 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ mañdzu shrī 'jam dpal dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dbyug sngon can rnams la mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags rnams rol mo'i bar sbyar la dbul lo// de nas byang phyogs kyi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ phrin las dbang phyug bya grub ye shes dngos// dpa' bo don yod grub pa 'khor bcas rnams// lha rdzas man chad dang*/ shar lho'i dung chos nas mchod yon dbul zhing*/ oṃ hā pradzñā dhṛka don grub dang*/ oṃ tāṃ badz+ra ra tī sgrol ma dang*/ oṃ raṃ ra sa badz+rī ro rdo rje ma dang*/ oṃ oṃ sarba ṇi wa ra ni biskaṃ bi ni sgrib sel dang*/ oṃ saṃ sa man+ta bha dra kun bzang dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ bi gh+nūn+ta kṛta bgegs mthar byed dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ma hā ba la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ stobs po che rnams la mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad rnams 'don pa bsgyur zhing*/ lha so so'i sngags kyi rjes la/ mchod sngags rnams sbyar la rol mo'i bar du dbul/ de la mchod yon ni bzed zhal du/ me tog ni tshom bu so so la me tog sil mar gtor/

dri chab ni ku sha'i rtses blangs la gtor/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas gsum ni so so'i mdun du phul bar bsams la lag pas cung zad reg go /de yang shar phyogs kyi lha bdun gyi mchod pa ni nub phyogs na yod pa'i mchod pa rnams yin la/ de bzhin du lho phyogs pa'i byang dang*/ nub phyogs pa'i shar dang*/ byang phyogs pa'i mchod pa ni/ lho na yod pa rnams yin la/ gtso bo'i mchod pa ni nang gi shar dang*/ yum gyi mchod pa nub dang*/ steng gi khro bo'i byang dang*/ 'og gi khro bo'i mchod pa lhor bkod pa rnams yin gsungs so// myur bar 'dod na rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog tu bshad pa ltar lha rnams go rim bzhin du mchod kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa la gnyis las/ gzugs sogs thabs kyis ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// mchod par byed pas mchod par bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi// zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur du byas pa'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar par/ g.yas thal mo brkyangs pa'i mkhrig ma gyen du blangs te bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang*/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gtso// rol mo dbul zhing gong 'og gi sngags rnams thams cad la sbyar la/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa/ zhes pas sgra dang*/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas te// sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// 'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso// g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dung chos 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas mtheb mdzub sbyar nas/ sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa'i rtses dri chu blangs te lha rnams la byug pa'i tshul du byas la/

gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa/ zhes pas dri dang*/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa/ zhes pas ro dang*/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas// bdag gis rigs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can// mi bskyod pa'i tshul brnyes pa'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa/ zhes pas reg bya dbul/ de ltar gzugs sogs yul lnga po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngar bsgoms la/ des dkyil 'khor mchod par bsam mo// gnyis pa gzugs sogs shes rab kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya'i// sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs// rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang*/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i// brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs// rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bgyi// shab+da badz+rī/ zhes pas sgra dang*/ ga pur a gar dzā ti la sogs pa// legs par sbyar bas byug pa dri yi tshogs// rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar bgyi// gan+dhe badz+rī/ zhes pas dri dang*/ lus mchog rtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas la sogs// mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro// rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la dbul bar bgyi// ra sa badz+rī/ zhes pas ro dang*/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba// dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs// rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha yi lus la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ āḥspar+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐/

zhes pas reg bya rnams dbul te/ phyag rgya ni sngar dang 'dra la/ gzugs sogs yul lnga po rnams rdo rje ma lngar bsgoms la/ des dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam mo// gsum pa thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ las kyi rlung bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag /dri zhim ut+pal kha dog rnam lnga dang*// yid 'phrog me tog pad+ma kha dog lnga// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañdza war+ṇa ut+pa la pad+maṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas pad+ma dang ut+pal kha dog lnga pa dang*/ 'jug gnas ldang gsum rnam par dag pa'i bdag /mdzes shing yid 'ong shin tu dri zhim pa// me tog dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum// rigs gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs la 'bul// tri war+ṇa dzā ti pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas dzā ti'i me tog dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi po rnam par dag pa'i bdag /kar+ṇi ka dang ma li yu thi ka /ka ra bī ra me tog kar+ṇi ka /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la dbul// pañdza puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas me tog lnga 'bul lo// bzhi pa khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ 'khor ba ci srid gnas pa de srid du// zag med bde ba'i ye shes skyed byed pa'i// yon tan kun ldan na chung yid 'ong mchog /bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'bul// yu ba tī pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas gzhon nu ma dang*/ zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan kun// mtha' yas bsod nams dpal las grub pa yi// rin chen me tog bdun gyis rab bkang nas// bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'bul// sap+ta rat+na puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas rin chen bdun dbul/ rgyas pa la spro na/ rkang pa dang po gnyis nas tha ma sngar dang 'dra ba la/ rkang pa gsum pa'i tshab tu/ rin chen pad+ma rā gas rab bkang nas// zhes dang*/ pad+ma rā ga puṣ+paṃ gyis/ pad+ma rā ga'i me tog dang*// de bzhin du/ rin chen in+d+ra nī las rab bkang nas// in+d+ra nī la puṣ+paṃ/

rin chen bai ḍūr+ya yis rab bkang nas// bai ḍūr+ya puṣ+paṃ/ rin chen margad tshogs kyis yongs bkang nas// margat+ta puṣ+paṃ/ rin chen rdo yi snying pos rab bkang nas// aṣ+ma gar+bha puṣ+paṃ/ rin chen mu tig tshogs kyis rab bkang nas// muk+ti ka puṣ+paṃ/ rin chen bye ru'i tshogs kyis rab bkang nas// pra bar puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas dbul lo// lnga pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi mchod pa ni/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed du// bdag nyid kyi ni rnam bsam zhing*// mchod pa'i phyir ni rnam bsams nas// sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nir+yā ta na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje thal mo dpral bar bzhag la lus dbul/ sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar zhing*/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed kyi// bdag nyid kyis ni rnam bsam zhing*// lce ni de snyed ldan dang bcas// sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjod par bya// wāka nir+yā ta na// zhes dang*/ thal mo mgrin par sbyar la ngag dbul/ de nas rnal 'byor de snyed kyi// lus dang ngag sems 'byung ba yi// mchod pa dag ni bsdus nas su// sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya// tsit+ta nir+yā ta na// zhes dang*/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag la sems dbul lo// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa la lnga'i dang po/ nang gi nyer spyod ni/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo in+d+ra nī la ltar// shin tu sngo ba'i rdo rje'i bu ga yis// bskyod pa'i pad+mo las 'ongs me tog dmar// mi bskyod rdo rje lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo gtum mo'i mes bsregs pas// yid 'ong dri yi ngad ldan ga pur spos// nyams su myong bas yid rab sim byed pa// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/

chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas bde ba'i dngos// hūm̐ yig nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od zer can// mi shes mun 'joms sngags kyi mar me 'di// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na legs gnas pa// kun+da ltar dkar dri yi byug pa yis// lus kun khyab pas bde ba'i mchog ster ba// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ rmi lam yul la rol pa ji bzhin du// gang gang dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni// de dang de yi yul la longs spyod zas// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra nai wi t+ye āḥhūm̐/ snyoms 'jug dga' ba'i rol pa las byung ba'i// mi shigs yi ge mchog gis rol mo'i sgra// ā li kā li'i gdangs su shar ba rnams// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo// gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems kyi mchod pa ni/ thabs shes dga' ba'i rol pa las byung ba'i// thabs kyi ye shes bde chen byang chub sems// nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par rab spros nas// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ shi ta ti la ka pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byang chub kyi sems dbul lo// gsum pa lus kyi rgyu mthun gyi mchod pa ni/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin dri chen dri chu dang*// byang sems dkar dmar sha chen dwangs ma ste// rnal 'byor lus kyi rgyu mthun bdud rtsi lnga// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ pañdza a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi lngas mchod do// bzhi pa sgrub pa'i dam tshig gi mchod pa ni/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub 'gugs byed pa// ba glang khyi rta glang chen mi sha ste// sgrub pa'i dam tshig dam pa lcags kyu lnga// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ pañtsa ma hā bā la pū dza āḥhūm̐/

zhes sha lnga dbul lo// lnga pa chang gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi thod pa'i nang gi chang de/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas yi ge gsum brjod pa'i bar gtor chog ltar byas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ de'i dbus nas mtheb srin sbyar bas blangs pa spyi bor gtor zhing*/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje chos/ klu las gyur pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po in+t+ra bhū ti/ bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon 'phags pa lha/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob dpon slob pa'i rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag po pa/ rgyal sras sa 'dres pa chen po/ paṇ+ḍi ta bīr+ya bha dra/ de wa ā kā ra tsan+d+ra/ rje 'gos lo ts+tsha ba/ mar ston seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rngog ye shes seng ge rngog nyi ma seng ge rlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ rngog ār+ya de ba/ mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhes pa rngog lugs kyi dbang bka'/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad bka'/ rim lnga'i khrid bka'/ gsum char gyi bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ de bzhin du zla grags yan sngar dang 'dra ba la/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bik+ṣa ta de ba/ kha che shākya shrī bha dra/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ 'od zer shākya/ dar ma shes rab/

bla ma rin chen dpal/ bla ma rin rgyal/ kun dga' smon lam/ bla ma grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho man chad sngar dang 'dra ba la/ klu byang gi dkyil chog gi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ste/ bla ma so so'i mtshan gyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la dbul/ de nas lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sngags kyi mthar/ yig 'bru gsum btags pas dkyil 'khor la dbul zhing*/ spro na/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa pha rgyud gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la'ang dbul la/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo// de nas srin lag gis bdud rtsi blangs nas/ lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug gsum du thig le byas pas/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gur mgon dang*/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la tsa turmu khā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong gang byed pa la dbul/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po bzhi/ gza' dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ za sha smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/

'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing*/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbul lo// gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dpag tu med pa spros nas/ mdun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul bas/ rgyal ba rnams rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing snyoms par zhugs pas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsams la/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi la mkhas// yid 'phrog gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i dpal yon can// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i gzugs mchog rnams// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ gzugs kyi bde ba dang*/ zur gyis blta zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can// drug ldan la sogs yang dag glu la mkhas// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i glu dbyangs mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// shap+ta badz+rī/ sgra'i bde ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba bzang po'i dri// gang gi lus la rtag tu rnam 'byung zhing*// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i dri mchog rnams// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// gan+dhe badz+rī/ dri'i bde ba dang*/ gang zhig myangs pas byang chub sems 'ju ba// bim+pa ltar dmar ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi sogs// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i ro mchog rnams// mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// ra sa badz+rī/ ro'i bde ba dang*/ gsang ba'i sna rtse phan tshun phrad pa yi// reg bya myong bas gtum mo skul byed pa// pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i reg bya mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ āḥspar+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐/

reg bya'i bde bas mchod pas lha thams cad kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams zhu bas snang ba gsum rnam par dag ste/ 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsams la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pa la gsum las/ dang po bkra shis pa'i yo byad kyi mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ zhes brjod pas rgyal srid sna bdun dang nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa yid kyis sprul nas mchod par bsams te/ gser las grub cing rtsibs stong mu khyud ldan// dgra las rgyal byed 'khor lo rin chen gyis// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa tha ma gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi mgo thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ dpag tshad du mar snang ba'i 'od 'gyed cing*// 'dod dgu'i re skong nor bu rin chen gyis// ma ṇi rat+na/ phrag dog skyon bral bde ba'i dpal bskyed cing*// gzugs mdzes blta sdug bud med rin chen gyis// s+t+rī rat+na/ chos min spang zhing 'gro la phan pa sgrub// mkhas gsal yid gzhungs skyes bu rin chen gyis// na ra rat+na/ thal kar glang chen stobs kyi shugs kyis 'gro// yan lag bdun ldan glang po rin chen gyis// ga dza rat+na/ 'dod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la bgrod// cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta mchog gis// a shwa rat+na/ gang gis bcangs pas bdud dang mu stegs sogs// phas rgol tshar gcod ral gri rin chen gyis// khaḍ+ga rat+na/ ces rgyal srid sna bdun dbul lo// 'di dag gi phyag rgya yang yo ga nas bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/

ral gri rin chen la dmag dpon gyi phyag rgya byed pa'ang rnam snang mngon byang du bshad do// de nas nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun dbul te/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang*// tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang*// yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang*// dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal// gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim// thags bzang bsreg gcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos// chu la mi 'byings ngal dub med pa'i l+h+wam// nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyis mthas gtugs pa// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// sap+ta u pa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca'o// de nas bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad dbul bar bya ste/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i// bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di// gang la phul ba de yis skad cig la// dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /maṅga la tsakra/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa 'dra ba la/ dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di// kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /maṅga la shrī dzab pa na/ rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /maṅga la kum+bha/ 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'di// 'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos shog /maṅga la pad+ma/ g.yas 'khyil shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di// smra ngan pham byed chos grwa sgrogs par shog /maṅga la shaṃ kha/ shin tu gsal ba'i mig ldan gser nya 'di// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /maṅga la nya tsha/ rgyan gyis spras pa'i rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di// kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog /maṅga la ts+tsha traṃ ga dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di// phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog

/maṅga la dh+wa dza pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dbul lo// gnyis pa nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa ni/ nyer mkho'i yo byad dpag tu med par blos sprul la/ rdul yab sbrang yab bsel yab dang*// khyams dang skyed mos tshal dag dang*// gzims cha dang ni gdan khri dang*// myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang*// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// rta babs dang ni bla re sogs// bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs pa// glu gar la sogs mtha' dag mchod// bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba// rin chen lag dang nam mkha'i mdzod// blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /nag po ra ri med pa yi// bum pa lto che bre tshad pa// mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan par// snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin par ras bzangs dag gis dkris// 'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang*// dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can// bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod// de nas rol mo dang bcas pas// gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni// bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*// ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis// gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod// ces brjod do// gsum pa mchod pa nyi shu pas mchod pa ni/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dkur kha gyen du bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ gzugs mdzes mthong bas mi ngoms reg na bde// yid 'phrog snyems ma'i tshul 'dzin sgeg mo yis// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyis mthas gtugs pa// bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza badz+ra lā s+ye pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du 'og ma la'ang sbyar te/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis phreng ba 'dzin pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs 'jig rten na// shin tu dkon pa'i rin chen phreng 'dzin gyis// badz+ra mā le/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul dang*/

drug gi rjes su skyes sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs// thos nas tshim pa len byed glu ma yis// badz+ra gī tī/ lag gnyis gar skor g.yon dang g.yas su bskor nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang*/ gcig nyid du ma'i tshul du rab bstan nas// 'gro ba dga' bskyed gar gyi mchod pa 'dis// badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ gser sogs rin chen las grub 'dab stong ldan// mdangs bkra yid 'ong dri ldan me tog gis// badz+ra puṣ+pe/ bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ a gar nag sogs lhan cig skyes pa dang*// sbyar ba las byung bdug pa'i sprin tshogs kyis// badz+ra dhū pe/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs// mun pa sel byed snang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// badz+ra ā lo ke/ dri'i phyag rgya dang*/ reg na tshim byed zhim pa'i dri dang ldan// ga pur la sogs legs par sbyar ba'i chus// badz+ra gan+dhe/ lag gnyis ting shags brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ rten 'brel las byung skye med rang bzhin can// chos rnams skye med ston pa'i sil snyan sgras// tur+yaṃ/ g.yon khu tshur las mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar ba dung gi phyag rgya dang*/ dge legs rin chen las grub g.yas su 'khyil// rgya chen chos kyi sgra sgrog dung dkar gyis// shaṃ kha/ lag gnyis kyi sor mos g.yas phyogs su gling bu bsgyur ba'i tshul dang*/ gang gis lag pa bskyod pa'i khyad par las// sna tshogs rnar snyan skyed byed gling bu'i sgras// waṃ s+ya/ gti mug rmongs pa'i rdul rnams sel byed pa'i// rnga yab dkar po gser gyi yu ba can// tsā ma ra/ 'dod chags tshad gdung skyob pa'i bsil grib can// bkod legs kha dog cher bkra bsil yab kyis// bi dha ma naṃ bya ñdza naṃ/ 'di gnyis ka la lag pa g.yas pas rnga yab sogs g.yob pa'i tshul du bya'o// lag pa g.yon khu tshur byas pa'i steng du g.yas kyi khu tshur bzhag pa dang*/

nor bu'i tog can dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan che// rgyal mtshan/ dh+wa dza/ zhal zas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ bsam gtan bde ba skyed byed lha yi bshos// sna tshogs kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// ni we d+yaṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis nam mkha' la khang pa gru bzhi pa bri ba'i tshul dang*/ bde gshegs bzhugs gnas dga' ba'i bskyed mos tshal// rin chen las grub khang brtsegs gru bzhi pa// rat+na kū ṭaṃ ga raṃ/ gos zung 'bul tshul dang*/ srab 'jam yang la shin tu dri zhim pa'i// lha rdzas na bza' kha dog sna lnga pa// wa s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis lha la rgyan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang*/ rin chen gdu bu ska rags rkang rgyan dang*// rab mdzes rna cha mu tig do shal lnga// pañdza rat+na a laṃ ka raṃ/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub byas pa'i steng du/ g.yas kyi thal mo'i mthil bzhag pa dang*/ rab mdzes gos kyis steng g.yogs zlum por bres// sna tshogs dar gyi 'khor yug mdzes pa'i gdugs// ts+tsha traṃ ga lag pa g.yon mnyam gzhag la/ g.yas nam mkha' la bskor zhing*/ ting 'dzin snying rje'i rgyan phreng mdzes pa can// chos nyid don rtogs rin chen bla re yis// bi tā naṃ pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod do// bsdus pa la dga' na/ nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun nas 'di'i bar ma byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dir// chos kyis dbyibs kyi rang bzhin 'gro// yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni// dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni brtse bar nyer dgongs te// mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+thā nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la bdag nyid phul bar bsam/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa po rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal gzung ngo*// lnga pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par bsams la/ cung zad gcig mnyam par bzhag cing*/ rdo rje theg pa mnyes byed pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// de yi mchod pa bla na med// sems can gang gis dbu ma yi// theg pa bsgom pa ma bsgoms na// theg pa dman la lhag par mos// de yi mchod pa kun rdzob yin// zhes brjod do// drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de nyid lnga pa'am/ spro na/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing*// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku// kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud// 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// zung 'jug bde chen rnam 'phrul las// sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur ston pa'i// rgyal ba kun gyis bdag skyongs shig /sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid// zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// gti mug dga' sogs phyag 'tshal lo// spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*// chags can chags pa gdul ba'i phyir// bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i// rigs kyi yum bzhis bdag la skyongs// gzugs sgra la sogs rnam dag cing*// thabs mkhas smon lam stobs dang ni// ye shes shes rab ngo bo nyid// rdo rje gzugs sogs phyag 'tshal lo// rab mdzes sgeg pa'i 'gying bag can// 'dod yon sna tshogs char 'bebs shing*// 'dod pas 'dod pa'i dug 'byin pa// mchod pa'i lha mos bdag la skyongs// mig sogs nang gi skye mched dang*// rtsa dang tshigs kyi tshogs sbyong zhing*// lha yi mig sogs stsol mdzad pa// sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal nyid rgyal sras tshul 'dzin cing*// chags med 'gro la rab chags pas// spros med spros pa'i skur ston pa// byams sogs sems dpas bdag la skyongs// ser sna la sogs rnam dag cing*// bsdu dngos bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang mdzad pa'i// sgo srung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam shes tshogs drug rnam dag cing*// phyogs mtshams steng 'og bgegs kun dang*// yams sogs 'tshe ba kun sel ba// mi g.yo mgon sogs phyag 'tshal lo// gdug pa can rnams rab gdul phyir// rab khros rngam zhing mi bzad pa// 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi// khro chen rnams kyis bdag la srungs// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*// byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can// bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa'i// gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi// sa gzhi rwa ba bla re gur// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can// srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi'i rlung gis rnam par mi bskyod cing*// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i thugs ldan pa// dkyil 'khor mchog la bstod pa'i dge ba des// 'gro ba ma lus de 'drar 'gyur bar shog

/ces pa'am// nyung bar 'dod na/ tshigs bcad phyi ma rnams dor nas/ gong ma rnams sbrel nas bstod par bya'o// bdun pa dam tshig bzung pas mchod pa ni/ lus tsog pur 'dug la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa lan gsum gyi bar du gzung ngo*// brgyad pa bzlas pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi lha rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi thugs bde bas mnyes par byas/ 'od zer rnams kyi rtse mo nas mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ de phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes sogs lha so so'i sngags lnga brgya pa re re'am/ ma grub na brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas pas lha rnams mnyes par bsams la/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag la byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye ba'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don gang yin pa la gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// dgu pa gtor mas mchod pa ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams/ nang mchod dang*/ chu dang*/ chang rnams kyis sbyangs la/ gtor ma dang po 'das pa'i lha la dbul te/ 'dir mdun bskyed la dbul bas mgron bskyed pa zur pa mi dgos pas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ phrin las gzhol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar bya'o// gnyis pa nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la dbul/ gsum pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bka' srung mgon po gdong bzhi pa la dbul/ bzhi pa 'jig rten pa spyi la/ mgron bskyed pa nas phrin las gzhol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar byas la dbul/ lnga pa gnas de'i gzhi bdag dbang thob pa yod na dbul zhing*/

dbang ma thob na gnas khang gi phyi rol du song nas/ gtor ma de 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ phrin las gzhol la slar nang du 'jug go /de nas dpa' bo'i ston mo la longs spyad rgyu yod na mchod cing yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ lhag ma'i gtor ma/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis brjod pa'i bar tshul bzhin du bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ yang maṇ+ḍal gyi mthar mchod pa gsar pa ci 'byor pa bshams la/ de dag bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī guh+ya sa mā dzaḥmaṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra zhes sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas bdud rtsi dbul/ de nas sngar ltar dngos grub blangs la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas pad skor dang 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya sngon du 'gro bas/ mthe bong dang srin lag gis se gol gtogs la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gi lus la bsdus te/ de'ang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi lha rnams la phog pas/ des lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ rang gi phung po lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga thim/ khams bzhi la yum bzhi/ mig sogs la sems dpa' sems ma/ tshigs bcu la khro bo bcu thim pas/ phung khams de rnams lha so so'i skur bsam/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang rang gi lus kyi cha shas so so la thim pas dkyil 'khor de dag tu gyur nas/ rang lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur par bsams la/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron rnams badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol zhing*/

rang gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdus nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdo rje 'chang gi sar bsngo zhing*/ spyod lam thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par byas te/ cho ga rgyas par nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'o// yang rtsa rgyud le'u brgyad pa ltar bsdus te nyams su len na/ dang por dri'i maṇ+ḍal bya ba nas mchod pa bshams pa'i bar dang*/ chu byin gyis brlabs pa nas me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i bar sngar ltar bya/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa dang mdun gyi lha sgrub pa dus gcig la byed par bshad pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byas la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis tshom bu dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs te/ der gnas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa nas brtsams te/ mchod pa'i rnal 'byor yan chad dang po sbyor ba rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi mngal du bskyed pa'i lha rnams phyir spros/ slar 'dus nas gtso bo rang la thim/ gzhan rnams tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan so so'i steng du 'khod par bsam/ de nas rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du bsams la/ der mchod pa'i lha mo bskyed pa nas brtsams te/ gtor mas mchod pa'i bar gong bzhin rgyas bsdus ci ltar 'dod pa bya/ 'on kyang*/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dang mchod pa rnams kyis/ bdag dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gnas pa la tshur mchod par bsams pa ni khyad par ro// de nas 'di ltar bya/ 'grel par mi gsal kyang*/ don gyis thob pa'i dpa' bo'i ston mo la longs spyod pa nas/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba yan gong bzhin byas la/ de nas phra thig gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa/ gtso bo don dam du bzhugs shing bskul ba nas nye bar bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// de ltar rnal 'byor pas yang yang du cho ga khyad par can 'di nyams su blang pas bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa nyid do// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di phul bas// rlabs chen bsod nams tshogs mchog mthar phyin nas// bde chen rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog

/dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mchod pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa chen po rje btsun dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la sde snod 'dzin pa'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba la gzhi byas/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung thams cad nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i yan lag rnams tshang bar bsdus shing sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa pha rgyud phyogs mthun rnams nas cung zad kha bskangs te/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan nas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen bzang pos bgyis so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'od gsal chos sku'i bya lam rgya che bar// zung 'jug longs sku'i nyin byed rab rgyas shing*// phrin las sprul sku'i tsha zer stong 'phro ba// rdo rje 'chang bdag dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs chen gyis// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nyid// rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i tshul// gzhung bzhin dag par bshad kyis nyon// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i sngags pas/ sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas nas bshad pa'i man ngag zab mo bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i sngon du 'gro ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa'i cho ga bya ba la don gsum ste/

sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni snga bar mal nas langs te/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang gi sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra satwa zhes brjod pas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar bsam mo// de nas sa'i cha shin tu dag par khru gang gis tshad kyi dri'i maṇ+ḍal byas la/ me tog gcig dbus su bzhag pas bsrung ngo*// maṇ+ḍal gyi phyi'i khor yug tu/ chu gsum mam/ mchod yon rkyang pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga spyir bsham/ de'i nang du lha so so'i mchod pa bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas gsum phyogs rer tshan pa bdun bdun re/ gru bzhir bkod/ de'i nang gi shar nub gnyis su mchod pa gsum po tshar gnyis gnyis bsham/ gzhan yang bla re dang*/ ba dan dang*/ gos zung dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams ci 'byor du bsham zhing*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dang dril bu sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams kyang gzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ bdag gi rnal 'byor/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ bzlas pa bya zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po la gsum gyi dang po/ lce lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du/ a a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de gnyis kyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba re re/ de dag zhu nas lag pa la thim pas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ shud+dha dharma ta sid+dha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi lkog ma'i dbus su hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lce'i thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba/

de zhu nas lce la thim pas/ lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ badz+ra dzi hwa hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag pa des/ sngar bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi kha cung zad gsos shing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pas mchod rdzas rnams bgegs dang bral bar bsams la/ mdun du rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsgoms la rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud// gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas sems tsam de yang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa 'bras bu lhar bskyed cing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra satwa ma nu sma ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha a haṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing phyag na rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rang gi btsun mos mgul nas 'khyud pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par āḥdamar po thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams bkod la sgo gsum byin gyis brlab bo// 'dir kha cig rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug par 'dod pa ni gzhung dang dngos su 'gal lo// gnyis pa la gnyis/

dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dngos so// dang po la gsum gyi dang po srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gnod mdzes bkug nas rang gi mdun du bkug ste/ bdag gis ci bgyi zhes bka' nod pa la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing phyogs bcur se gol gtogs shing bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje de lcags kyur gyur nas/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin par zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis bsdigs bzhin pas bkug nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi phyi rol du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa'i nang du bcug par bsam mo// de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i rdo rje phur bu stod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa can/ lte ba man chad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can me dpung rab tu 'bar ba bcu spros te/ phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor zug par bsam/ de nas gnod mdzes la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa phaṭa kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro ādzña pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bka' bsgos pas/ gnod mdzes kyi lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me 'bar bar gyur nas/ phur bus spyi bo nas brdungs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas brdabs pas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ste/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi bar du son par phur bus brdabs pas lus g.yo ba med ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ yid rnam par rtog pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par bsams la/

gnod mdzes rang gi snying gar bsdu'o// de nas phur bu rnams las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i rwa ba ste gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i rwa ba dang me ri 'bar bas bskor bar bsam mo// kha cig 'di yan bdag bskyed du 'dod pa ni gzhung gi mtshams ma phyed par zad do// gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal bya ba ni/ hūm̐ bzlas pa'i ba lang gi lci ba'am/ de med na dri bzang gi chus mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yas skor gyi khye ma med par byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hrīḥ zhes dang*/ chur bcas lci ba sbyin pa yin// skyang nul bya ba tshul khrims yin// grog sogs bsal ba bzod yin te// bya ba rtsom pa brtson 'grus so// skad cig rtse gcig bsam gtan yin// ri mo snyoms pa shes rab yin// thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pas pha rol phyin drug mnyes par 'gyur// lha mi khyad par can skye zla ltar gzi 'phags shing*// nad kun las grol gser gyi mdog dang 'dra bar 'gyur// rgyal rigs 'bru dang gser sogs 'byor pas gang bar 'gyur// de bas bde gshegs mchog gi khyim du lus kyi las bya'o// zhes phan yon rnams brjod cing byug ris bya'o// gsum pa sa'i lha mo la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su me tog gcig bzhag la/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gsum bsams te/ sor mo sa la bsnun pa'i sgra dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi sa 'og nas/ sa'i lha mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa lte ba man chad sa'i 'og tu bzhugs pa zhig byung bar bsam/ de la oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul nas/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par 'dra// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ci ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdud kyi stobs bcom nas// bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ sa byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang de la mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas maṇ+ḍal gyi sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de nas me tog gis dkyil 'khor rim pa gsum dang ldan pa bris la/ nang ma'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po bri/ de bzhin du shar gyi 'dab mar 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ lhor rin po che la swā ser po/ nub tu pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje la hā ljang gu/ shar lhor 'khor lo la laṃ dkar po/ lho nub tu rin po che la māṃ sngon po/ nub byang du pad+ma la paṃ dmar po/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje la tāṃ ljang gu/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ 'khor lo la raṃ dkar po/ lho nub tu rin po che la shaṃ sngon po/ nub byang du pad+ma la gaṃ dmar po/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje la raṃ ljang gu/ gtso bo'i mdun du rdo rje la khaṃ sngon po/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar du 'khor lo gnyis la/ maiṃ dang thaliṃ dkar po/ lhor rin po che gnyis la/ oṃ oṃ ser po/ nub tu pad+ma gnyis la oṃ hūm̐ dmar po/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis la oṃ saṃ ljang gu/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang steng 'og gnyis su nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po re re bri'o// 'dir 'phags pa'i yul na/ maṇ+ḍal thams cad ba glang gi lci ba las byed pas/ de la sa bon rnams rang gi lag pas brir rung bas/

skabs 'di nyid du yi ge bri bar bshad pa yin la/ bod du ba lci bshad pa bzhin med pas/ de'i dod dri bzang gi chu la byed dgos la/ des byug ris tsam las yi ge'i rjes mi dod pas/ lha so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgod pa'am/ yang na dang por 'bras la sogs pa tshon gyis kha bsgyur la/ des sa bon gyi yi ge'i gzugs su bya ba gang bder bya'o// de nas sa bon rnams la dri'i chus bsang gtor lan gsum bya zhing bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzlas pas/ sa bon gyi yi ge rnams ngo bo dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu so gnyis kyi rang bzhin la rnam pa so so'i sa bon 'od 'bar ba dang bcas par bsam mo// de la mchod pa rgyas par bya ba'am/ ma grub na mdor bsdus pas kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du thog mtha' rnams kun la sbyar la/ dhūm̐ baṃ/ dī baṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi t+ye/ ces pas mchod cing*/ shap+ta ces pa rol mos kyang kha bskang ngo*// de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ de rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la rdo rje ma lngas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+ṣe rnams bcug pas mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs yi ge'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bstims par bsam mo// 'dir bris pa'i sa bon rnams sam/ cho ga gsum gang rung las rdo rje 'chang sngon po'am/ mi bskyod pas gtso bo byas pa'i lha rdzogs pa bskyed par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/

gzhung du yi ge tsam las lha bskyed par ma bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ cho ga 'di las dang po pa'i gang zag lha rgyas par bsgom du mi nus pa'i dbang du byas par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ rnal 'byor 'di sngon du song nas mdor byas ltar lha'i rnal 'byor du gdod bsgom dgos par bshad pa'i phyir ro// gal te lhar ma bskyed na yi ge tsam gyis dgos pa mi 'grub bo snyam na/ rnam pa yig 'brur bsgoms pas bsgom sla zhing*/ ngo bor lhar mos pas zhen yul la ma 'khrul la/ des las dang po pa'i skabs kyi dgos pa thams cad 'grub ste/ rgyud gzhan du/ lha nyid gsang sngags tshul gyis ni// dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// de bzhin du mi bskyod pa gtso bor 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ 'dir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bri'o zhes bshad la/ mi bskyod pa la ni nyi gdan yod pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje 'chang sngon pos gtso byas pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gzhung du ri bong 'dzin 'od ltar dkar reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud sku// zhes dkar por bshad pa dang 'gal bas so// gal te mchod brjod kyi yul de bdag bskyed kyi rdo rje sems dpa' de yin no snyam na/ de'ang mi 'thad de/ de ni yab yum gnyis ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bshad la/ 'dir reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud par bshad nas/ reg bya rdo rje phyag gnyis mar khas len dgos par 'gyur la/ de lta bu 'phags pa yab sras kyis gzhung gang du'ang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// thub pa dpal gyis/ rdor sems yab yum phyag gnyis par bshad pa'i yum ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar bshad pas reg bya rdo rje yin don med do// des na rang lugs la maṇ+ḍal la yig 'brur bsgoms pas lha'i rnam pa mi dgos kyang*/ yig 'bru lhar zhen pa'i yul dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pas gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du mos pa yin no// 'o na 'di'i gtso bo gang nas bshad snyam na/

spyir rdo rje sems dpa' la mi bskyod pa nyid rdo rje 'chang ngam/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs su byas pa dang*/ rigs lnga char gyi gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang ngam/ rdo rje sems dpar byas pa gnyis las 'di ni phyi ma yin te/ gzhung du/ mnyam med yon tan rin chen gter gyur sangs rgyas lnga yi gtsor gyur pa// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// rnam pa dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par byed pa ni/ rig pa'i dbang drug gi skabs su rnam snang chu dbang sogs rigs lnga dang dbang lnga sbyar nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang me long gi dbang gnyis sbyar ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro// gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ mdun gyi mchod rdzas rnams 'du byas la/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ oṃ las mchod yon/ paṃ las me tog dhaṃ las bdug spos/ daṃ las mar me/ gaṃ las dri/ naṃ las zhal zas dang*/ gzhan yang shaṃ las rol mo/ hūm̐ las mchod rdzas gzhan rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du bzed zhal bzhag la/ lha'i mchod yon dam pa 'dis// dkyil 'khor mchod par bgyid par 'tshal// thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te// mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /ces dang*/ bzed zhal gyi nang du/ mchod yon re re zhing dbul zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra dzi na dzika ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ man chad thams cad la sbyar la/ oṃ swā rat+na dhṛka oṃ āḥ.ā ro l̥ka oṃ hā pra dzñā dhṛka oṃ lam̐ mo ha ra ti/ oṃ mām̐ dwe ṣa ra ti/ oṃ pam̐ rā ga ra ti/ oṃ tām̐ badz+ra ra ti/ oṃ ram̐ rū pa badz+rī/ oṃ sham̐ shap+ta badz+rī/ oṃ gam̐ gan+dhe badz+rī/ oṃ raṃ ra sa badz+rī/ oṃ maiṃ mai trī/ oṃ thaliṃ k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi/ oṃ oṃ kha gar+bha/ oṃ oṃ lo ke shwa ra/ oṃ hūm̐ mañdzu shrī/ oṃ oṃ sarba ṇi wa ra ni biskaṃ bi ni/ oṃ saṃ sa man+ta bha dra/ oṃ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ pradzñāṃ ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ bi gh+nān+ta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ a tsa la/ oṃ hūm̐ ṭak+ki rā dza/ oṃ hūm̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa/ oṃ hūm̐ ma hā ba la/ oṃ hūm̐ uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti/ oṃ hūm̐ sum+bha rā dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ de nas gzhung 'dir/ pā t+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ artsa ma naṃ gis bsang gtor rnams 'bul bar bshad pas/ de dag re re zhing dbul ba'am/ klu'i byang chub kyis mchod yon rkyang pa las ma bshad pas/ 'di gcig pus kyang chog go /chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas/ de bzhin du lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ thams cad la sbyar nas/ me tog dbul/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung*// de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu gus pas bdag 'bul nas// ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis bdug spos dang*/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di// lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms// mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis mar me dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis dri chab dang*/ bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan// kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing*// thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di// 'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di// mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul gyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis mthar/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā sbyar ba dang*/ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod la rol mo ci 'byor pa dbul lo// de nas spro na mchod phreng du bshad pa ltar 'dod yon nas bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i bar rgyas par dbul ba'am/ ma grub na gzhung nyer spyod rkang thon du 'bul ba las gzhan ma bshad pas med kyang chog go /de nas rol mo dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal la bskor ba lan gsum bya zhing*/ ma hā ra ta su ḍa ḍi ta su to ṣ+yaḥsu su so/ badz+ra satwa a dh+ye sid+dh+ye mām̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ mchod yon gyi chus maṇ+ḍal la bsang gtor byas la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes lan gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems bzung la/ rdo rje thal mo gnas gsum du bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor la lus 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ na maḥte hūm̐ na maḥme hūm̐ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pas phyag bya'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med// gsang ba'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ spro na/ chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// drug pa rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po lnga yi rang bzhin rnam par dag /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das// dug lnga gdul phyir thabs kyi skur ston pa// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// khams bzhi rnam par dag cing shes rab ma// dmigs med thugs rje'i rang bzhin tshad med bzhi// 'gro ba'i don du lha mo'i tshul 'dzin ma// rig ma yum chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// yum lnga rnam par dag pa lha mo'i tshul// gzugs sgra dri dang ro dang reg bya ste// 'dod yon lnga yis rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// mchod pa'i lha mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// skye mched rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid// spyan lnga mngon shes drug gi rang bzhin rnams// 'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras tshul 'dzin pa// sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// tshigs bcu rnam par dag pa khro bo'i tshul// bsdu bzhi'i rang bzhin sgo skyong rnam bzhi dang*// phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcas par bzhugs pa yi// stobs chen khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba'i don du sna tshogs tshul 'dzin pa// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la// mchog tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod par bya'o// gsum pa bzlas pa bya zhing byin gyis brlab pa ni/

mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gsal bar bltas la/ yi ge gsum ci nus bzlas so// de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas dngos grub blangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang la thim par bsam/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po bsams la/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i dngos// rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlab gnas su// rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gang yin// phung po lnga yis rab gang ba// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis// bdag kyang de dang 'dra gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas lus byin gyis brlab/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po bsams la/ chos kyi gsung gang dpal dang ldan// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas// rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol// rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin// tshig de nges pa phun sum tshogs// bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra bar// chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas ngag byin gyis brlab/ snying ga nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ sngon po bsams la/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'dzin pa// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas// rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlab nas su// rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol// kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin// gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa// bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra bar// rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas sems byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas so// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod yon gyi chus/ maṇ+ḍal bsang gtong lan gsum byas la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor rnams gshegs su gsol/ 'dir ye shes pa cha gnyis su byas pa'i cha gcig rang la bstim/ cha gcig gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo rang gi lus la bsdu bar 'dod pa ni/ shin tu mi 'thad de/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo cha gnyis su byas nas gshegs pa 'di ni gzhung gang du'ang ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor lhar bskyed pa gzhung du ma bshad pas bsdu rgyu'i lha med pa'i phyir ro// de nas me tog rnams bsdus te/ yang sa phyogs dris byugs la/ me tog gcig dbus su bzhag ste/ bzod par gsol cig sa yi gzhi// zhes brjod la rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab par bya'o// de nas las kyi rjes rnams mi mngon par bsdu/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor la/ dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig gam/ lo phyed dam/ lo gcig tu nyams su blangs na/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes pa'i mtshan ma rnams 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de nas sgrub thabs mdor byas nas bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms la bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgrub par bya ba yin no// gzhung 'dir/

mdor bsdus rim las gsung don rtogs dka' ba// zhes cho ga 'di mdor byas kyi gzhung gi don du bshad pa yang*/ 'di bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i cho gar byas nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags zur pa ma bshad par/ snying rje chen po la dmigs pa man chad gsal bar bshad pas/ rnal 'byor 'di sngon du song nas sgrub pa'i thabs la 'jug pa yin no// zhes pa ni mngon par rtogs pa dang mtshams sbyor ba nyid do// gsang ba kun 'dus dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// rigs lnga'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' la// rmad byung mchod pa'i cho ga 'di phul bas// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas gyur cig /'dir ni ma dag cho ga rgyang bsrings te// grub brnyes dam tshig rdo rje'i gzhung bzang la// zhib mor dpyad nas dag par bkod pa 'di// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bstan pa rgyas phyir yin// dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod pa'i cho ga tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni dam pa'i chos shes nas tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa sde snod 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba'i ngor rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje'i gzhung gi don ji lta ba bzhin du dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen bzang pos bgyis so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// yid 'ong sgyu ma'i chu gter che las 'khrungs// rang bzhin rnam dag 'od gsal khams las grub// zung 'jug rtogs pa'i bang rim phreng ba can// rgyal ba ri dbang che la bdag cag dad// rmad byung brgyud pa'i chu klung kun 'dus pa'i// ye shes rgya mtsho dngos grub rba rlabs can// phrin las yid bzhin nor bus legs gtams pa'i// smin byed dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad kyis nyon// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma yongs su smin par bya ba la gnyis te/

thun mong gi theg pas rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i cho gas smin par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdo rje slob dpon la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ gza' skar dang tshes grangs bzang po la bab pa'i tshe phyag 'tshal nas yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sdig bshags lan mang du byas la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa yang bya'o// de nas slob ma de sngar sdom pa dang mi ldan na/ dge bsnyen la sogs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rnams byin la yang dag par bsrung du gzhug go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ slob mas gsol ba gdab pa/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab cing*/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ slob ma'i sems las byung ba'i bgegs rnams bsal bar bsams la/ bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags sam/ mtshan sngags lan bdun bzlas pas bsrungs la/ yo byad rnams gsog tu gzhug go /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi/ dang po sngon du bsnyen pa ni/ slob dpon gnas dben par sgrub thabs ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ gtso bo'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi khri phrag re re bzlas shing*/ bcu cha'i sbyin sreg gis lha mnyes par bya'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la gnyis/ rdul tshon la brten pa dang*/ ras bris la brten pa'o// dang po ni/ dang por sa ni sbyang ba dang*// de nas sa yang 'dzin pa dang*// phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang*// thod le kor gyis thig gdab dang*// de nas sa lha sogs lhag par// gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang*// phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang*// nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang*// tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang*// tshon rtsi rnams ni dgye ba dang*// lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni// de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang*// khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*// de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang*// de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang*// lha dang bla ma yon mnyes dang*// rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang*// de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang*// dkyil 'khor las byed phur bu dang*// skud pa bsdu ba nyid kyang ste// zhes pa ltar/

cho ga nyi shus sgrub par bya ba la/ dang po sa sbyang ba ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa legs par brtags pa'i sar/ gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis zhing skyong gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma dbul zhing*/ mchod pas mchod nas/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa gzhi 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas sa byin par bsam mo// de nas las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas shing*/ sa pus mo nub tsam du brkos la/ shing dang gyo mo dang*/ gseg ma la sogs pa'i sa rdo bsal nas/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i sas bkang la/ 'thas par bcag cing ngos mnyam la der ba byung lnga'i byug dri'i chus bsang gtor bya/ grub na drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs sbyangs/ badz+ra satwa zhes bzlas shing*/ phyogs thams cad du rdo rje'i lta bas blta bar bya'o// de nas sa phyogs thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms te cho ga dang po'o// gnyis pa sa bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas der bla re la sogs pas brgyan zhing*/ dri bzang po'i chus byugs la/ lha so gnyis kyi me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i mthar ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gnyis bsham mo// de nas rang chas gos dkar po dang gtsug tor la sogs pas brgyan la/ sa phyogs stong par bsgoms pa nas phrin las 'chol ba'i bar gtor chog bzhin byas la/ 'das pa'i lha la thun gsum du gtor ma dbul/ de nas bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs skyong la gtor ma gnyis pa 'bul te/ gtor chog las shes so// de nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs zhi bar byas te/ cho ga gnyis pa'o// gsum pa bgegs nye bar zhi ba ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su rang nyid gos dmar po gyon pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ kha shar du bltas la 'dug ste/ mngon par rtogs pa rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ bar snang la dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gang bar bsgoms la/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing*/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// bdag gis gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// bdag ni dam tshig lha rnams dang*// mnyam par 'gyur bar the tshom med// byang chub sems dpa'i sems gcig pas// bdag ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur// bdag deng de bzhin gshegs pa yi// rigs su skye ba gdon mi za// deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste// bdag gis mchod sbyin bla na med// sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pas// deng bdag 'dus pa mchog yin no// zhes brjod pas spro ba bskyed nas/ nam mkha'i lha rnams la phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod de/ spos dang bcas pas dril bu bzung la/ lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsams nas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs// bdag ming che ge zhes bya bas// rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri// sangs rgyas kun deng gshegs su gsol// dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rnams ni// ci nus bzhin du rab tu bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor ba'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de nas phyogs bzhi nas/ rigs bzhi'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams kyis mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/

zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems can po// rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// thun mong du/ khyed zhabs pad+mo ma gtogs par// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// thub pa bdag ni 'khor ba las// bsgral ba'i phyir du dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba btab pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs la rtse mo sbyar te/ 'og tu phyogs pas spyi bor bzung zhing*/ hūm̐ badz+ro t+tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes brjod pas/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg ste/ snyems pa dang bcas pas langs nas/ rang gtso bo las chad pa'i gtso bo gnyis par bsgoms la/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ bdag nyid rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid// bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal// bdag ni phyag na rdo rjer bstan// bdag ni bdag po rdo rje can// deng bdag rdo rje sems dpar grub// zhes rigs thams cad pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do// de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgom pa nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes kyi bar gyi khro bo rnams srung 'khor ltar bsgoms la/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon par ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bar bsams la/ rdo rje'i lta bas/ g.yas g.yon du blta'o// de nas rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las/ rdo rjer bsgom zhing rdo rje'i gom pas hūm̐ zhes drag tu brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa la g.yas phyogs su bskor la/ dbang ldan du gnas nas/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgos te/ a pa sa ran+tu bha wan+to/ ye ke tsi ta de wa/

a su ra/ yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ a pa smā ra/ bhū ta/ ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ ostā ra ka ma hāl+la ka a nu tsa ri pa ri ṣa da/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ pu ru ka maṇ+ḍa sid+dhiṃ/ a nu sid+dhā/ a tra pri thi wī pra de she che ge mo shi ṣ+ya s+yā bhi si bo dhi pa ri pū ra ṇār+thaṃ/ sarba satwāḥ.a nut+ta ra dzñā na la b+dha he tu/ shrī badz+ra satwa ma hā maṇ+ḍa la mā lī kha ta bh+yaṃ mā yā ta de tām̐/ ma hā badz+ra dha ra ādzñaṃ shū twa shī gh+raṃ me ba sa kra ma tha/ yo nā ti kra mi ta/ ta s+ya ha ma ne na/ pra dz+wa li ta hūm̐ ka re/ badz+re ṇa dīp+ta pra tīp+te na/ ma hā tā dzñā na badz+ri ṇa/ mur+dha naṃ sha ta di bi ki rā mi/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing*/ khro bo'i sngags kyis phyogs kun tu yungs kar gtor ro// de nas hūm̐ yig brjod cing*/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po/ dbus su mnyam pas te/ stangs stabs lnga'am/ grub na gzhung bzhin stangs stabs rnams rdzogs par byas la bgegs bsal lo// de nas rang sa'i dbus su 'dug la/ mdun du seng lding gi phur bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bcu snod gsar par bzhag ste/ yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags so// de nas rang zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo bcu dang bcas pa sngar bskyed pa de'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sgrub thabs ltar 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa sprul la/ bgegs khron pa'i nang du bcug pa'i bar byas nas/ phur bu rnams rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa sngon po me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ smad mdung rtse gcig pa'i rnam par gyur pa de gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yon pas bzung nas/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btsugs par bsam/ de nas oṃ gha gha la sogs pa'i sngags brjod cing*/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor gyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/

steng gi ni shar gyi shar dang*/ 'og gi ni nub kyi nub tu gdab cing*/ rdo rje'i tho ba'am/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas brdung ngo*// de ltar bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ste/ zhes pa nas yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ phur bu rnams la mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul zhing bgegs mi 'byung bar gsol ba btab ste/ thun gzhan la yang de bzhin bya'o// de nas bgegs thams cad kyang rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam yin gyi sems las gzhan med la/ sems kyang stong pa nyid thog mtha' dbus gsum dang bral ba'i byang chub kyi sems so// snyam du yun ring du bsams te/ cho ga gsum pa'o// bzhi pa thod lo kor gyis thig gdab pa ni/ gzhon nu ma ma nyams bas bkal ba'i ras bal gyi skud pa sum sgril gsum sgril bas dgu bsgril du byas la/ ring ba bzung ba'i cha la gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur dang*/ sbom phra sgo'i cha nyi shu cha ru byas pa'i las kyi thig skud dri bzang dang bcas pa'i thod lo kor gyis thig chal dang lhan cig sbags la/ slob dpon gtso bo dang slob ma rnam par snang mdzad dam/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor du bskyed la/ yi ge gsum zlos shing*/ thig gdab bo// de la thog mar shar nub kyi tshangs thig btab la/ de'i dbus nas ci ltar rigs pa'i zlum por bskor ro// de'ang shar nub kyi tshangs thig phrad pa'i gnas nas sor gcig gi che ba'i zlum po gnyis bskor bas lho byang du nyis 'gyur ro// de la slob dpon nub dang*/ slob ma shar du gnas pas/ tshangs thig dang po gdab bo// de bzhin du slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa dang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thig dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho'i rtsa thig dang*/ slob ma de nyid dang slob dpon rlung du gnas pas nub kyi rtsa thig dang*/

slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi rtsa thig gdab bo// slob dpon me dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab bo// de nas thig phran rnams kyi cha dbye bar byas te dbus su brgyad cha phyis pa sgo/ sgo de'i bzhi cha cha chung ste/ rtsa ba'i phyi rol gcig dang gnyis// gcig gnyis gcig dang gcig gi mthar// thig drug zur nas ngos su ste// tshangs las rim gyis ring bar ni// cha chung gsum du dang po'i thig /gnyis thig cha chung gnyis rtser reg /cha chung brgyad du gsum stegs bu'i// thig las dang po'i thig gnyis te// de ni cha chung re re'i bar// dpangs su cha chung lnga pa'o// rtsa ba'i rtse nas byung ba'i thig /cha chung bzhi ste ngos su'ang bzhi// steng du'ang bzhi ste gsum kyog pa'o// ka ba'i rtse nas phyi ngos su// cha chung re dor thig bzhi ste// phyed dang gnyis gcig phyed bcas gcig /re re dor bar thig bzhi ste// rta babs snam bu bcu gcig go /de las phyogs gnyis su ni rgyar// tshangs pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du ni// cha chung phyed bcas mda' yi mthar// snam bu cha chung phyed dang gsum// thig ni cha chung phyed dang bzhi// cha chung drug mthar gnyis pa dang*// gsum pa cha chung gsum pa'o// cha chung bzhi mthar bzhi pa ni// cha chung lnga ste mda' phyed bcas// gsum dor nas ni phyed dang lnga// gsum nas drug pa cha chung lnga// bzhi ni cha chung bdun rnams te// thig bcu gcig pa cha chung lnga// snam bu lnga pa'i steng gi ni// ngos su cha chung phyed dang bzhi// bdun pa'i 'og ma cha chung gsum// steng gi cha chung drug steng du// snam bu rnams mthar song ba'i thig /gzhan gyi mtha' dang lhan cig tu// kyog po gcig go 'di nang du'ang*// cha chung phyed nas de bzhin gzhan// de bzhin cha chung rig byed mthar// thig zlum de nas gnyis yin te// cha chung gnyis gnyis dor bar ro// bzhi dor bar ni zlum po gzhan// rtsa thig nang dang de nang du'ang*// sgo tshad re dor thig gnyis ni// zur thig nas ni zur thig bar// de nyid nas dang de nang du// re re dor ba'i thig zlum gsum// tshangs pa'i thig las g.yas g.yon du// mig dang zla ba dor bar thig

/drang po gnyis gnyis nang ma'i thig /zlum po'i rtse la reg pa'o// zhes pa ltar las kyi thig rnams gdab ste/ cho ga bzhi pa'o// 'di yan chad la bla ma dag nub dang po sa'i cho gar bzhed do// lnga pa sa'i lha mo la sogs lhag par gnas pa la gsum las dang po sa'i lha mo lhag gnas ni/ de ltar sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sar bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas la/ der bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can/ phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan par bsam/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gsum bsams te/ sor mo sa la lan gsum bsnun pa'i sgra dang hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs la mchod nas dbyer med du bstim mo// de nas mdun du bshams pa'i mchod pa bsang sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ sa byin nas de nyid du thim par bsam/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams byas pa sa la bzhag la/ de las hūm̐ yig 'bar ba 'phros pas sa 'og gi bar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ yang oṃ badz+ra ḍ-iḍha tiṣ+ṭha zhes lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bsam mo// gnyis pa lha lhag gnas ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi sa la bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus thig la mi gnod par byug cing*/ so so'i sngags bdun nam gsum gsum brjod la/ gtso bo lnga'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ gzhan rnams la zlum po re bya/ der gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par bsams la/ zhal phyag rnams rdzogs par gsal gdab/ de la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga nas gsang mchod kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ zangs la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rab lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ de ma 'byor na phyogs kyi la bzhi/ mtshams kyi la bzhi/ dbus kyi gcig ste dgu'am/ de'ang ma 'byor na phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'am/ yang na rigs lnga yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo rnams la re re ste lnga'am/ de thams cad ma 'byor na rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gcig dang*/ de rnams kyi steng du las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang bcas pa rnams la lha so so'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan bri/ rnam rgyal gcig las med na/ bum pa'i gdong la nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje/ de'i 'og gi phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ las thams cad pa la nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul pa bcing ngo*// de nas las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug dri bzang po dang ldan pa'i chus bkang ba'i nang du rin po che lnga 'bru lnga sman lnga rnams gzhug a mra la sogs pa'i shing gang yang rung ba lngas kha brgyan pa/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs phyogs su bkod la/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chos dri bzang dang ldan pa'i chus bkang la/ me tog gi phreng ba bcing ba'i rdo rje gzhag go /de nas bum pa rnams bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/
