shū n+ya tās stong par bsgoms pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed la/ bum pa so sor lha so so dang*/ gcig las med na rnam rgyal du lha thams cad dang*/ las bum du bgegs mthar byed rnams so so'i sa bon las bskyed/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ mchod la dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams byas la/ me tog phreng ba nas bzung ste/ lha so so'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ 'bru gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ khrus kyi don du gtsug tor rnam rgyal lam/ phyir bzlog blo gros bzang mo'i gzugs nyer gcig bzla/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la/ sngar bzhin du mchod bstod byas nas gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ hūm̐ bzlas pa'i dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su cung zad re phul bas/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor gyur te/ chu dang ro gcig du 'dres par bsam mo// de nas las bum gyi chu dang*/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣ+ṭ+rod ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha ha stā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya kā nāṃ/ ga ṇa pa ti/ dzī wi ta/ an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i phreng sngags kyis bsangs la/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs par de srid du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig ces brjod la/ las bum dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgor bzhag go /bum bzlas dang mchod pa ni nyi ma re re la thun gsum du byas te/ cho ga lnga pa'o// drug pa sangs rgyas la gsol ba gdab pa ni/

de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bar snang gi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsams la/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer bsams nas/ thugs rje yi ni bdag cag bdag /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang*// khyed cag la yang mchod slad du// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni// de phyir bka' drin mdzad par rigs// rdo rje can bdag che ge mo// gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ni// cho ga ci nus yo byad kyis// sang ni yang dag bri bar 'gyur// de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la// rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas// 'khor bcas kun gyis dkyil 'khor la// byin gyis brlabs par mdzad par 'os// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab pas gnang ba byin par bsams te cho ga drug pa'o// bdun pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni/ de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgor 'khod la/ lag tu me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ pus mo sa la btsugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du byas pa la mchod nas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma la/ bla mas/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug bya ste// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan byas te// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer na// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// gal te 'di la dmigs gyur na// 'jig rten pha rol 'byung ma yin// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// mi la 'di 'bras ma lus 'grub// ces brjod la myang 'das kyi blo bskyed du gzhug go

/de nas rang mi bskyod pa yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od kyis slob ma bkug ste/ kha nas bcug la byang chub kyi sems su zhugs par gyur nas rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon te/ lha mo'i pad+mar gnas pa la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon/ slob ma la dbang bskur bar bsams la/ pad+ma nas byung ste shar sgor bzhag la/ slob ma gcig gtso bor byas nas/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// dus gsum du ni legs 'byung ba'i// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// sangs rgyas ye shes mnyam med pa// rdo rje sngags kyi stobs kyis thob// sngags kyi sbyor ba mnyam med pa'i// drag po chen po bdud kyi sde// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// shākya seng ge mchog la sogs// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas kyang*// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa spro ba bskyed la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan par bdag gis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bdag gis gzung*// rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyis// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu// zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos dang*// byams pa rin chen rigs mchog gi

/sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pa lan gsum gyis mthun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa rnams 'dzin du bcug go /de nas bgegs mthar byed kyi gsang sngags kyis bsrungs la/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥ snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ rnams bsam zhing*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus slob ma'i gnas gsum du reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ yi ge gsum las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis lus dri ma med par bsam mo// de nas spyi bor me tog mdun du spos dang mar me/ snying gar dri'i byug pa rnams dbul/ de nas 'o ma can gyi shing las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes pas 'cha' ru bcug la/ ba glang gi lci bas sa la dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru bzhi/ dpangs su ba glang gi ko ba tsam byas la/ der slob ma kha byang du phyogs te ltos pa med par dor ro// der bla mas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir bltas na/ phrin las bzhi 'grub/ steng du rig 'dzin/ 'og tu sa 'og bla ma la phyogs na mchog 'grub bo// zhes bstan no// de nas bam̐ las byung ba'i dri bzang gi chu/

oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a ba na ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas te/ khyor ba gsum sbyin pas sgo gsum gyi sdig pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam mo// de nas las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i ku sha mang ba stan dang*/ nyung ba sngas kyi don du/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ zhes pas byin no// de nas gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i sum sgril/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags sam/ sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas la/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon par bcings shing*/ oṃ bud+dha mai dhi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swā hā/ zhes bzlas so// snying ga dang mgrin pa dang spyi bo gsum du/ mas rim gyis sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzlas pa'i dri'i chu sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyis blud do// de nas slob dpon gyis/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag bstan// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// zab cing rgya che zhes bshad pa// rnam par rtog med zab pa ste// rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku// 'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad// kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don// phye ste so sor shes nas su// de nas gcig tu 'dres byas pas// zag med go 'phang bsgom par bya// de yi kun tu kun las kun// rnam kun kun tshe rang nyid ni// sangs rgyas thams cad rang bzhin du// grub par rang nyid kyis mthong 'gyur// byang chub sus kyang byin ma yin// su yis kyang ni bzung ma yin// rang chos yongs su shes pa las// de las sangs rgyas sangs rgyas brjod// sems can bag la nyal dbye bas// yang dag mgon pos de nyid ni// 'bad pas sbas nas phung po ni// rin chen za ma tog tu bzhag

/de phyir bla ma'i zhabs kyi ni// drin gyis 'bad pas rtogs byas te// de nyid kyis yid gsal gyur pa// de nas spyod pa rab tu bya// 'di na gtsang sbra nges sdom med// dka' thub med cing dka' spyad med// dka' spyad med cing nges med la// bde ba brten pas 'grub par 'gyur// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa 'di mchog la// blo gros shin tu dri med na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pas// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pas// bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te// gang gis khyed rnams theg chen du// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dwang bas na// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes brjod cing don bshad do// de nas ku sha che ba stan dang*/ chung ba sngas su bcug la/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal du bcug la/ mtshan ma mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun snga dro nga la smros// zhes brjod la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// nangs par snga bar rmi lam dris te/ bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na bdag med pas sbyangs te/ cho ga bdun pa'o// brgyad pa thig gdab pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba'i bar byas la/ sngar gyi sngags rgyas nam mkhar bteg ste/ slar yang mchod bstod bya'o// de nas ye shes kyi thig skud kha dog lnga pa'am/ ring thung sbom phra las thig dang mtshungs pa 'du byas la/ bsang sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ thig skud nag po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/

dkar po oṃ las rnam snang*/ ser po swā las rin 'byung*/ dmar po āḥlas 'od dpag med/ ljang gu hā las don grub du bskyed de/ nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs kar/ sa bon lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thig skud 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra sū traṃ me pra yats+tsha ma hā maṇ+ḍa la sū tra nā ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mi bskyod pa la gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin du ak+ṣo bh+ya ces pa'i gnas su/ sha shwa tas rnam snang dang*/ rat+na saṃ bha was rin 'byung dang*/ a mi tā bhā was 'od dpag med dang*/ a mo gha sid+dhi rnams bcug la/ don grub la gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang mi bskyod par gsal ba'i mig gnyis su dzaḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba ser po la/ oṃ dīp+ta driṣ+ṭha aṃ ṣu shi dzaḥ zhes pa bkod la/ sngags de nyid brjod cing*/ mig gi rdzi ma 'gugs pa'i 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis/ nam mkha'i lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig skud so so la sa bon gyi rang bzhin can dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ thig skud so so la thim par bsam/ de nas oṃ a n+yo3 n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥs+pha ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭhaḥsarba dharmā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ dang por thig skud lnga re re bsgril/ de nas lnga po gcig du bsgril la/ dri bzang gi chus byug cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag dri dang me tog la sogs pas mchod/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dris byug cing*/ me tog sil ma bkram nas/ slob dpon lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ nub nas shar dang*/ slob ma shar nas nub tu bltas la nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la mchod nas/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa dang*/ slob ma rnam snang du bsgom/ rang gi mig gnyis dza las byung ba'i nyi zla 'od ser po can du bsams nas/

g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thig skud lte bar bzung zhing*/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ thig skud kyi rtse mo slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing blangs la lte ba'i thad du bzung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang gung mos thig skud bzung la nam mkhar gdab cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gyi sgra bya/ sgra de yang*/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi// dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas thig skud la thim par bsams la/ tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du lus dmad la sa la yang thig gdab bo// de nas dpon slob gnyis rdo rje'i 'gros kyis g.yas skor du phyin la/ sngar bzhin du btab nas/ thig skud la mchod bstod byas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ ye shes kyi thig skud sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar bstim mo// de nas oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pa rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas thig gi 'og nas zhugs par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin te/ rang gi mig g.yas g.yon hī las nyi ma dang zla bar bskyed la/ hī hī/ zhes brjod cing*/ phyogs kun tu khro bo'i lta bas bltas la/ thar pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i sgrib pa bsal bar mos la/ dri bzang gi chus sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dbyi zhing sgo bzhi ka dbye bar bya ste/ cho ga brgyad pa'o// dgu pa tshon sna lnga ni/ rdul tshon kha dog lnga pa legs par 'du byas la/ re re la'ang gzhan bzhi cung zad bsres nas/ rigs lnga'i sa bon bris nas/ bsang sbyangs te stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon sngon po hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa/ dkar po oṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang*/ ser po swā dang rin po che las rin 'byung*/

dmar po āḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med/ ljang gu hā dang ral gri las don grub tu bskyed/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rigs lnga'i thugs kar/ hūm̐ la sogs pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rdul tshon 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsams la/ thig skud kyi skabs ltar 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis bkug ste/ tshon so so la thim par bsams la/ rang rang gi sa bon 'bru gsum gyi bar du bcug pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas rang gi mig gnyis su dzaḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba bskyed de/ sngar gyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i lta bas gzi brjid bskyed nas/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can la chags pa dang*/ rjes su chags par 'gyur ba'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ dri dang me tog sogs kyis mchod pa ni/ cho ga dgu pa'o// bcu pa tshon dgye ba'i cho ga ni/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi phur bu phyung la/ shul tshon sna lngas bkang nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ lag pa g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas brtsams nas/ rtsig pa lnga sbom phra sgo'i nyi shu cha/ ring ba sgo tshad gcig gi tshad du bri zhing*/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol mdzad// rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam par grol// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing mchod bstod byas la/ rin po che'i snod dam/ rdza phor gyis bkab nas/ steng du rdo rje bzhag ste/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// de nas rang ngam slob mas ci bder bris te/ dbus kyi re mig sngon po/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ 'dod yon dmar po la lha mo ci mdzes/ pha gu ser po la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa/ drwa phyed kyi gzhi ma nag po la/ mu tig gi do shal dang*/ do shal phyed pas brgyan pa/ de dag gi nang du zla phyed rdo rje dang*/ rin po ches spras pa/ shar bu dang mda' yab kyi gzhi sngon po la/ shar bu dkar po dang*/ mda' yab pad 'dab phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis mdzes par byas la/ rta babs kyi ka ba dang*/ kyog pa'i nang dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams phyogs mdog rta babs kyi snam bu'i shar bu dang*/ mda' yab sngar dang 'dra/ mun snam sngon po/ rin po che ser po/ rta rmig dang*/ ba raṇ+ḍa ni mdzes tshon/ gser ni ser po/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'i dbus su/ pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad+ma'i lte ba ljang gu/ 'dab ma sna tshogs/ ge sar ser po/ pad+ma'i sa gzhi dmar skya/ chos 'byung gi re khā dkar po/ rdo rje rwa ba'i gzhi ser po la rdo rje nag po/ de'i 'khor yug gi re khā dkar po/ 'od zer phreng ba kha dog lnga dang ldan pa bri'o// de'i nang du lha snam rim pa gnyis pa'i nang du le tshe dgu'i phyi rol 'od zer phreng ba kha dog lnga pa/ de'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba gzhi sngon po la rdo rje dkar po/ ka ba rnams gzhi sngo nag la/ shar gyi gnyis la 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub la pad+ma/ byang la ral gri rnams phyogs mdog du bri zhing*/ rtsig pa sbrel ran dus su/ sngar gyi rdo rje dang*/ snod bsal la/ mtshan ma bzang na/ spro ba bskyed/ ngan na srung 'khor bsgom pa la sogs gyis bzlog par bya ba ni cho ga bcu pa'o// bcu gcig pa lha spyan drangs pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rdul tshon gyi dbus su mtshan ma dgod de/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la/

so so'i gdan sgrub thabs bzhin bkod nas/ dbus su nyi ma la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang gu/ shar lhor dbus nag la mtha' dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i spyan/ lho nub tu rdo rje sngon po/ nub byang du pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba sdong bu dang bcas pa/ byang shar du ut+pal sngon po/ rim pa gnyis pa'i mer me long dmar po/ bden bral du pi wang sngon po/ rlung du dung chos ser po/ dbang ldan du zhal zas kyi snod dmar po/ rim pa gsum pa la shar du sdong bu dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi me tog dkar po dang*/ 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po gnyis/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po gnyis/ byang du ral gri ljang gu gnyis/ shar sgor tho ba sngon po/ lho sgor rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/ nub sgor pad+ma dmar po/ byang sgor sna tshogs rdo rje/ mer ral gri/ bden bral du zhags pa/ rlung dang dbang ldan du ral gri re re/ steng du gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'i gzugs/ 'og tu zhags pa rnams nag por bri/ mtshan ma thams cad 'od zer lngas bskor ba rang rang gi phyogs su mgo bstan pa ste/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ni nub tu mgo phyogs par bya'o// de ltar dkyil 'khor lhag chad med cing dag par bris nas/ dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i 'khor yug du byug tshon lhag ma rnams la mchod de/ ye shes kyi tshon gshegs nas/ lhag ma rnams gnas dben par gzhag go /de nas sngar lhag gnas byas pa'i bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar g.yas skor du bkod cing*/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad re re zhing bcu bas mi nyung ba'am/ ma 'byor na lha grangs dang mnyam pa bsham/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sgos kyi chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'tshogs par bya'o// de nas rang nyid khrus byas te/

shar sgo dang nye bar kha nub tu bltas te 'dug la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab/ slob mas lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas la/ rang skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ nyer spyod dang 'dod yon lngas mchod la/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi rtsig pa'i 'og nas 'dzul te/ dbus kyi bris pa'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i skur bsam/ de nas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang*/ zhes pa nas/ gzhal yas khang spro ba'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed tha mi dad du bskyed/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha rnams ye shes pa dang 'dres pa mi dgos/ slar 'dus nas so so'i mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ shar gyi re mig gi pad zla'i steng du rnam snang dkar po/ zhes sogs kyis bskyed do// de nas rang gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya phyung la/ de reg rdo rje mar bskyed pa nas las la gnas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ lus dkyil gyi lha thig ler zhu nas pad+ma'i dbus su babs pas/ thig le cha so gnyis su gyur/ de rnams brten pa'i lha so gnyis su bskyed de/ zhal phyag gsal gdab/ de nas mtshan sngags kyis phyir phyung*/ rang rang gi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang*/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs te/ so so'i ye shes pa dang gcig tu 'dres nas mchog tu dga' ba'i sku dang ldan pas slar 'byon par bzhed bzhin du bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas sangs rgyas de rnams spyan drang ba'i phyir/ dam tshig pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/

de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la so so'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon hūm̐ dang oṃ la sogs pa dang*/ ye shes pa rnams kyang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom mo// de nas rang dam tshig sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs te/ lha so so la thim par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bya'o// de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa bdag gi mdun du 'ongs nas/ bka' nod pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'byon par skul cig ces bsgos pas/ des de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa spyan drangs nas mdun du bzhugs pa la/ 'dod yon lngas mchod de/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces pas gsol ba gdab cing*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa rnams la bstim mo// de nas sta gon gyi lha la mchod nas/ dgug gzhug bya/ lha so so'i rigs bdag yab yum rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar bsam pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ lha so so'i sngags kyi rjes la ar+ghaṃ brtags pas/ bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// la sogs pas bstod nas/ rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du bsam pa nas/ bsang mchod kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'khor rnams kyi nyi shu rtsa gcig re/

thun mong du yi ge brgya pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ci nus bzlas la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i rdo rje 'chang phyag gnyis par bsams la/ rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pas rdul tshon gyi phyir 'thon nas lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du phyin la/ der sa gzhi bstar ba'i dbus sam/ maṇ+ḍal dri'i byugs pa la me tog gi tshom bu bcu bkod de/ dbus su tshangs pa dang*/ rgyab tu sa'i lha mo'o// de'i mthar mchod pa dang*/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma'am/ ma 'byor na shin tu che ba gcig bsham/ de la sha dang*/ sgog btsong dang*/ la phug sogs kyis brgyan la/ chang dang chus sbyang ngo*// de nas shū n+ya tās sa phyogs stong par bsgom pa nas/ 'jig rten pa rkyang pa'i mgron bskyed la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa dbul zhing phrin las gzhol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar byas la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du bar chad bsrung bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ mchod gtor rnams rol mo dang bcas pas sa gtsang sar dor ro// de nas slob dpon nang du 'ongs la nye reg byas te/ cho ga bcu gcig pa'o// bcu gnyis pa slob ma gzhug pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi nga rgyal du 'phos la/ hūm̐ bzhi pa bzlas shing*/ me tog gi phreng ba blangs la/ rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byed par bsam zhing*/ dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nas bskor ba byas shing*/ dril bu gsil/ yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing lhag chad kyi nyes pa dag par bya/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis gtso bo la me tog dbul zhing rang gi mgo la bcing*/ de nas khro bo'i lta bas bltas pas nang nas sgo bzhi phye bar bsgoms la/

nub sgo'i thad kar rkang pa g.yon brkyangs dang*/ lag pa hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas nas drag tu dkrol te/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra uṅgha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas shar sgo dbye bar bsam/ de bzhin du byang du gnas nas lho sgo dang*/ shar nas nub sgo dang*/ lhor gnas nas byang sgo rnams phye bar bsams la/ dkyil 'khor la phyag byas nas/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig ces gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rang shar sgo nas phyir 'thon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su gnas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bla ma'i bya ba rnams mdzad cing*/ rang nyid kyis slob ma'i bya ba rnams byas par bsgoms la/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin dbang thams cad rdzogs par blangs nas/ slob ma 'jug pa'i don du thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba gdab ste/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po// gzugs brnyan gyi ni dpe yang ste// dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang mtshungs// bden pa 'di yis slob ma rnams// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu gzhug /'khor lo rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa// mthong na sdig pa mtha' dag spong*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa// snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig dran par byas pa las// zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa kun// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni bdag 'jug go /de nas sngar sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar sgor bkug nas/ las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal dbul/ chas su gzhug pa'i phyir/ dar dmar pos gdong g.yogs la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐/ oṃ pra bi shwa bha ga wān ma hā su kha mok+ṣa su raṃ sarba sid+dhi su kha pra daṃ pa ra ma su kha ut+tam sid+dh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpra sid+dh+ya swaḥzhes brjod/

a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ zhes dri/ des kyang*/ bden chen bdag ni skal bzang lags// zhes lan btab ste/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod la rjes zlos byed du bcug la/ sems bskyed sbyin/ de nas snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi zhes brjod la/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas pas snying gar reg ste/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes brjod/ de nas mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad par yang mi bya'o// zhes brjod la/ oṃ āḥbi gh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas khrid cing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ ma hā ra ta su ḍa ḍi ta su to ṣ+ya su su kho badz+ra satwa ād+ya sid+dh+ya māṃ/ zhes pas bskor ba byas la/ slob ma shar sgor mi bskyod par bskyed la/ rdo rje thal mo brkyangs nas lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u bas+thā nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi mi bskyod pa las mi bskyod pa gnyis pa chad cing snying gar thim pas mi bskyod pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas lho sgo nas rin 'byung du bskyed la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/

dpral ba sa la reg pa'i phyag byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor nas rin 'byung chad de/ dpral bar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas nub sgor 'od dpag med du bskyed/ thal mo dpral bar sbyar bas kha sa la reg pa'i phyag byas shing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā pra warta ya māṃ/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor las 'od dpag med chad de mgrin par thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas byang sgor don grub tu bskyed/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ spyi bo sa la reg pa'i phyag byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karmā ṇāṃ āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor las don grub chad de spyi bor thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas slob ma stan la bzhag ste/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ de'i rtse mos me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug slob dpon gyis sngags dang phyag rgya de nyid bcings la/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ satwa badz+rī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ hūm̐/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi de'i phyir ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya'o// khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ yang 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/

yang phyag rgya snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag gnas par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs// zhes ye shes dbab pa gsang ma gsang gi phan yon nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag nas/ dung chos kyi chu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsngags pa byin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha/ zhes brjod la 'thung du bcug pas/ dam tshig bsrung ma bsrungs kyi phan yon nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la gzhag go /de nas slob ma'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa rnams bya'o// de nas slob mas yon phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ slob ma 'od dpag med du mngon byang lnga las bskyed la/ de'i spyi bor hā/ lkog mar āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bkod la/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam snang 'od dpag med mi bskyod pa rnams spyan drangs lus kyi nang du thim pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi lus thams cad khong stong du bsam/ de'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yi ge dzhaiṃ dmar po de las byung ba'i me'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer rkang mthil nas zhugs nas spyi gtsug gi bar du phyin pas lus thams cad sbyangs shing sems 'od gsal bar byas par bsam mo// yang slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'/

mgrin par āḥlas 'od dpag med/ mgo bor hā las rnam snang yab yum dang bcas par bsams la/ de rnams la dzhaiṃ gi 'od kyis bskul bas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun babs pas/ lus thams cad gang bar bsams la/ slob dpon gyis sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ slob ma'i snying gar bzhag la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba// rdo rje'i ye shes bla na med// de nyid khyod la 'bebs par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ā we sha aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod la dbab/ gal te ma phebs na mngon byang lnga'i tshul gyis yi ge gsum las byung ba'i rdo rje 'chang du bskyed/ de yongs su gyur pa las zhe sdang rdo rjer bsams la/ de'i yan lag thams cad la āḥdamar po 'od zer dang bcas pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ye shes chen po bskul bas/ rdo rje gsum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i thabs kyi ye shes kyis lus gang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes āḥdamar po'i rnam pas char ltar 'bab par bsams la/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing*/ ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ ha āḥdzhaiṃ zhes drag tu brjod pas/ lus 'phar ba la sogs pa ye shes babs pa'i rtags byung na/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje'i 'od kyis mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje bskul bas/ de āḥ'i rnam pas lce la bkod la/ bru hi badz+ra zhes brjod cing*/ dge mi dge dris pas lung du bstan par 'gyur ro// de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ gal te 'phar g.yo ma zhi na/ hūm̐ āḥha muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol la/ yi ge gsum dang las thams cad pas bsrung ngo*// de nas khyod kyi mig lam na snang ba ci lta bu zhes dris la/ des dkar/ ser/ dmar/ nag tu snang ngo*// zhes smra na/

zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las 'grub bo// zhes bshad la dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su skor ba byed du bcug la/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug pa 'di'i// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ci ltar de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub cing 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra bar// de 'drar dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces brjod la/ sngar gyi me tog gi phreng ba las/ ma rnyings pa'i me tog gcig bton te/ de tāṃ las rin po che'i me tog bsams la/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod pa'i 'od zer gyis sdig pa bkrus par mos shing gus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dpal mi bskyod rdo rje la dkyil 'khor pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i dbu'am/ rang rigs kyi lha gang yin gyi dbu la 'bab par shog cig snyam du bsams la/ yid kyis rang dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsgoms nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa sha shwa to me bhā wa hri da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ oṃ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añdza liṃ nā tha hoḥ zhes brjod do// me tog dor bas/ gang la babs pa de'i rigs kyi lha yin pas/ de'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga yang sbyin no// lha gnyis kyi bar du ltung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs yin cing*/ mnyam na gang la dad pa de'i rigs yin no// rtsig pa'i phyi rol du ltung na/ lan gsum du bskyar zhing*/ bskyar yang phyir ltung na dngos grub mi 'grub cing dkyil 'khor yang de la mi bstan no// de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba de blangs la/ slob ma'i mgo la bcings te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod pa ni/

dbang dang po phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba yin no// de nas slob ma'i mig gnyis su oṃ re re/ snying gar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ bsgoms nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid de'ang*// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad spyan ni 'byed par mdzad// ces pas mig ras bsal la/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi// rdo rje pad+ma brtse rol pas// gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis// he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes brjod la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bstan la/ de dag gis rnam par dag pa'ang bshad de/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi nges bzhir 'gyur// tshangs pa'i gnas ni grwa yin no// bsdu ba'i dngos po zhes bya sgo'o// bzhi yi ming can re re ste// dad pa'i dbang po la sogs sems// rnam pa lnga po yang dag 'byung*// rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi sgo khyud ni// bzhi ste de yang rnam pa bzhi// de yi dbus kyi 'khor lo gang*// dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi gzhal ba ni// rnam par thar pa brgyad yin te// dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'o// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni// ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun gyi khang chen du// thams cad tshe na ka bar 'gyur// chos dang de nyid don gyi brda// 'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de ni// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /de nas 'khor lo'i bdag po nas// brtsams te gnod mdzes mthar thug lha// de bzhin de nyid du gnas rnams// rdo rje can gyis slob mar bshad// phung po lnga yi rang bzhin du// sangs rgyas lnga rnams rab bstan bya// spyan ma la sogs lha mo bzhi// sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin no// de bzhin 'dod yon lnga'i ngo bor// gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa'o// mig la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du// sa yi snying po la sogs so// lag sogs ngo bor khro dbang po// gshin rje dgra sogs bstan par bya// de nas lus 'khor la gnas pa'i// sangs rgyas mi bskyod sogs rim bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes brjod pa ni cho ga bcu gnyis pa'o// bcu gsum pa khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram dbang ldan du/ khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ dkar nag dmar ba'i rwa ba gsum dang ldan pa 'phar ma gnyis pa'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su mtshan ma dang bral ba/ shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri rnams bkod la/ snam bu rnams la dbang bskur ba'i bum pa rnams spyan drangs la/ phyogs phyogs su ma nor bar dgod/ lte ba'i steng du rin po che'am shing gi khri bzhag la/ las thams cad pas bsrungs te cho ga bcu gsum pa'o// bcu bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ci ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar khu tshur gnyis kyis bzung nas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yas g.yon du bskor la mer dor/ de bzhin du chu dang*/ kham phor dkar po dang*/ rtswa dūrba'i myu gu dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i chang bu dang*/ zan chang dang*/ ras kyis kyang bskor zhing byab bo// de nas lag pas nye reg bya/ snying gar dri/ mgor me tog mdun du mchod yon dang mar mes bskor bzhin pa dang*/ sardza rā dza'i bdug spos rnams kyis sbyang ngo*// de nas slob ma las bum gyi chus bsang*/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin rang gi khar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas lha mo'i pad+mar 'thon pa las cho ga gsum gyis rnam snang du bskyed/

de nas bla ma'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la mchod de/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba bskyab pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung nas ci ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pas 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu nas/ spyi gtsug rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi khu bas slob ma rnam par snang mdzad du byas pa la dbang bskur te/ lha mo'i pad+ma nas phyir 'thon nas dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod pa la/ rten lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ de la brten pa lus dkyil gyi lha rnams sa bon nam sa bon las lhar bskyed la dgod/ ye shes pa bcug sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa rnams bya'o// de nas bum chu rnams las thams cad pas bsang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chu rnams oṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang du bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug rgyas gdab/ dbang bskur/ mchod cing bstod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bltas la/ yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig ma rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sems dpa' sems mas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mos bgegs bsal bar bsgom zhing*/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa bzung ste/ til gyi gong bu ltar gang bas// rgyal ba bum pa 'dzin pa yis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur te// de ltar shes nas yid bder gyis// zhes brjod pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i bum pa'i kha rgyan g.yas pas bzung la/ des chu blangs la/ spyi bor blug cing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka na s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa dṛ ḍho me bha wa/

bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje// ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan// sdang bas zil gnon skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa// mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yi ni// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan// rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing*// rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo yongs su sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan// phongs pa'i sdug bsngal 'grol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing*// khengs pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan// 'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i drwa ba 'joms pa po// chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spangs// de sbyong thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥ.oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes brjod cing thog mar rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ de nas rigs bzhi dang*/ yum bzhi dang*/ sems dpa' dang*/ sems ma dang*/ khro bo'i bum pas/ rang rang gi sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/

'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid du bstims la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod la/ de ltar dbang dgu las/ rnam par snang mdzad chu'i dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de chu'i dbang ngo*// de nas khrus kyi dkyil 'khor las babs te/ gos dmar po gsar pa gyon/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ gdugs dkar po bzung la/ bde ba chen po 'dod chags che// rdo rje chen po nor che ba// shes rab chen po ye shes che// rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag bsgrubs// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che// dngos grub kun gyi bde ster ba// kun gyi dbang bskur bskur don du// rdo rje'i dbang bskur bla na med// e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal// thar pa nor chos 'dod pa ster mdzad rgyal// ye shes lnga dang dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal// mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal// zhes glu blangs nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ shar sgor 'dug tu bcug la/ sngar ltar nang chog gi cho ga gsum gyis/ swā las rin 'byung du bskyed/ dbu rgyan bsang sbyangs te/ rin 'byung du bskyed la zhu ba las byung ba'i rin chen 'byung ldan du blta ba'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ bum pa bzung ba nas chu dbang gi bar dor/ de'i tshab tu dbang bskur rdo rje la sogs kyi tshig dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pū dzā ya a tī sha mā mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dbu rgyan byin la/ slob dpon gyis lag pa gnyis rdo rje thal mo sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis skyil krung du bskum/

gung mo gnyis gshibs te rtse sprad la/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs bar par btsugs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mo'i phyag rgya spyi gtsug tu bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dha tī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes pas spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ sngar gyi sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ satwa badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pas dpral bar oṃ las rnam snang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya las/ gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma bcag nas rin po che 'dra bar byas la/ rin chen rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yas par bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes pas rna ltag g.yas par swā las rin 'byung*/ de nyid las gung mo pad+ma 'dra bar byas la rdo rje chos ma'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ dharma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃḥ zhes pas ltag par āḥlas 'od dpag med/ de nyid las dbus ma'i rtse mo bcag pa las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon par bzhag la/ oṃ karma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes pas rna ltag g.yon par hā las don grub bskyed/ de nas dbu rgyan la btags pa'i dar dpyangs rna ltag g.yas g.yon du bcings nas mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ri tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes brjod la/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// sogs kyis chu'i dbang bskur/ dri ma sbyangs/ rin 'byung gis dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang thob par byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma nang chog gis āḥlas 'od dpag med dang*/ rdo rje cho ga gsum las 'od dpag med du bskyed/ mchod bstod zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la byin te/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// legs par grub phyir rdo rje zung*// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// dngos grub mchog phyir rdo rje longs// sangs rgyas kun gyis khyod la stsol// rdo rje brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra a dhī pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ces pas rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brten// zhes brjod de/ slob ma'i snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bor reg la/ lag pa g.yas su gtad/ des kyang lha'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje gsor la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /ces brjod cing*/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi satwa hi hi hi hi/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin/ chu'i dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma nang chog gis hā las don grub dang*/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu cho ga gsum gyis don grub du bskyed/ mchod bstod zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la sbyin te/ zla ba'i 'od can ye shes sku mnga' rgyal ba'i cod paṇa 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i don du srid gsum 'dul mdzad bsdigs pa'i rdo rje can// sangs rgyas rnams ni bskul phyir de kho na nyid so sor sgrogs pa'i chos nyid dril bu 'khrol// dngos po kun gyi ngo bo ma lus ston pa'i bcom ldan gang yin de ni rgyal gyur cig

/me long gi ni gzugs brnyan dang*// rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang*// mig 'phrul 'dra ba sus mthong ba// de ni mnga' bdag tu bshad do// zhes brjod de/ dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad/ des kyang dkrol te/ dku g.yon pa'i phyogs su bkan te bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje snyems pa'i tshul gyis bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu ra ko me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa mo tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muts+tsha badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe aḥ.aḥ bdag gis bcom ldan gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la nye bar mdzod// slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra hrīḥs ma s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod la chu'i dbang bskur/ don grub kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod de/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don grub dang*/ de la brten pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de dril bu'i dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma nang chog gi hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ mig thur a dang rdo rje las shes phyin dang*/ me long hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdor sems su bskyed/ mchod bstod zhu ba las byung ba'i mig thur dang me long du bltas la/ gser gyi thur mas mig 'byed cing*/ mig sman byug pa'i tshul du byas la/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a ba ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hṝḥ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis// ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin// rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi// mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal// zhes brjod pas/ ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas ye shes kyi mig phye bar bsam mo// de nas as bsngags pa'i me long byin te/

chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes pas chos can sna tshogs pa rnams me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dran du bcug nas/ me long rdo rje dang bcas pa bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid yin// de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag gang*// byang chub sems 'di shes par gyis// thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'chang chen po dang rang gi sems dbyer med du shes par gyis shig ces brjod la chu dbang bskur ro// rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan la mchod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long gi dbang thob/ yul yul can gyi dri ma dag chos can dang chos nyid gnas gyur/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon du byas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ de'i rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long gi dbang ngo*// de nas slob ma nang chog gi hūm̐ las mi bskyod par bskyed pa nas/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i bar byas/ dbang rdzas kyi bskyed chog mi dgos pas na/ rang shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su bsgyur te/ g.yon pas chos gos gyi grwa gnyis 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/

bhūr+bhu wa swaḥ.aḥ zhes lung bstan cing*/ gang la phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad de/ phyag rgya 'di nyid kyis mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs yin no// zhes brjod de lung bstan la/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyar bsgyur te/ ma hā sa mā ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis// sdig pa kun las rnam grol te// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyi nas 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams las grol// byang chub sems ni nam mi spangs// rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni// gang zhig bskyed pa nyid tsam gyis// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// dam pa'i chos la smod mi bya// nam yang dor bar mi bya ste// mi shes pa'am gti mug gis// rnam par bsten par bya ma yin// rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang*// phyag rgya'ang nam yang smad mi bya// slob dpon smad par mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// rang gis bdag nyid yongs btang ste// dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya// ci ltar bde bas bde bzung ste// 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas// de ring bdud rnams pham byas nas// grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs// deng dus khyod kyi sangs rgyas nyid// thob 'gyur nyid la the tshom med// ces brjod pas/ dbugs phyung la/ rdo rje dril bu mgo bor 'khrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta he shrī che ge badz+ra ta thā ga ta sa mā ya sidh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu wa swaḥ.aḥ zhes brjod la/ che ge'i gnas su/

dpal mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags la/ chu'i dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab ste mchod la/ mi bskyod pa ming gi dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ ming gi dbang ste cho ga bcu bzhi pa'o// bco lnga pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing thal mo sbyar te/ gang gis bdag nyid khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab la/ phyag mtshan gyi rigs chung bzhi'i slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ slob ma dang 'khor lo cho ga gsum gyis rnam snang du bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur/ dbang rdzas gyi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo byin te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// dza ya dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti pra warta ya dharma tsakra/ zhes brjod la dbang bskur/ de bzhin du slob ma dang rin po che rin 'byung du bskyed pa sogs byas la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ci ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu ston// oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzña na a bhi ṣe ka pra warta oṃ oṃ oṃ/ slob ma dang pad+ma 'od dpag med du bskyed pa sogs byas la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// 'dod chags dag pa rab tu ston// oṃ badz+ra dharma sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzñā na rā ga pad+ma ra la swa bhā wa hrīḥ.aḥ

slob ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje don grub du bskyed pa sogs byas la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ci ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje mchod pa rab tu bskong*// oṃ badz+ra karma sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzñā na sarba pū dza swa bhā wa aḥzhes pas dbang bskur bas rigs bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i slob dpon du gyur par bsam mo// de nas rigs thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ slob ma khrus stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi khri la bzhag nang chog gis cho ga gsum las rdo rje 'chang du bskyed/ byang sems kyi khu bas dbang bskur pad+ma nas phyir 'thon pa la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lus la bkod/ ye shes pa bcug gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa rnams bya'o// de la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje bsang sbyangs hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// zhes sogs sngar bshad pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis rdo rje byin la/ des kyang rdo rje bzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes brjod de bzung*/ dril bu āḥlas rdo rje snyems mar bskyed/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces brjod la gtad/ slob mas kyang lan gsum dkrol zhing*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa'i// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes brjod de dkrol lo// yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad// lus kun brtan par byed pas na// de phyir phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags// zhes brjod la/

slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku phyag rgya chen po/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud par bsams la/ lag pa gnyis kyis 'khyud pa'i tshul byas la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlab// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma rnams ni bsdu bar gyis// zhes brjod la/ lha thams cad kyi chu'i dbang rgyas par bskur/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes rab gnas bya zhing mchod do// de nas dam tshig bsgrags te/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin par yang khyod kyis longs// gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas// slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pas// rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob par 'gyur// de phyir sangs rgyas 'bras 'dod phyir// gus dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis// bsam yas 'bras bu rtsol ba po// 'di la 'bad pa kun gyi mchog /byang chub go 'phang bla'am ci// srid pa sel bar su yis nus// gang las skyes shing 'chi ba med// gang zhig las gnyis la nus ldan// rdo rje slob dpon med par ni// nyon mongs thams cad spang ba dang*// mya ngan 'das zhi go 'phang dang*// phyir mi ldog pa thob mi 'gyur// rang gi dam tshig rtag tu bsgrub// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod// rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// thabs dang shes rab ldan sems kyis// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// rtag tu rnam rtog med gyur nas// khyod kyis 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs shing*// bka' lung dam pa rtag pa yi// dam tshig dang ni ldan pa 'di// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// zhes brjod do// de ltar dam tshig 'dzin pa'i slob ma la// khyod dngos grub gang 'dod ces dri/

bdag 'di 'tshal lo zhes zer na/ gang 'dod pa'i lha dang sngags ster ba yin kyang*/ 'dir thun mong du/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dpon slob gnyis ka gtso bo sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bskyed/ bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags phreng bkod la/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam gsum bzlas la/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las chad pa'i sngags phreng byung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' skor du 'khod par bsams la/ lha thams cad kyi sngags gsum mam/ ma grub na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ swā āḥhāḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas/ slob mas me tog phul la/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la nye bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/ me tog de nyid spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pas/ sngags kyi dngos grub thob par bsam pa ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa ste/ cho ga bco lnga pa'o// bcu drug pa lha la yon dbul ba'i cho ga ni/ slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la ci 'byor pa'i yon phul/ de tsam ma 'byor na/ lha thams cad la gos zung cig phul la/ oṃ a nut+ta ra sarba pū dza me gha sa muṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ glu gar sogs kyis mchod pa ni cho ga bcu drug pa'o// bcu bdun pa bla ma la yon dbul ba'i cho ga ni/ slob mas bla ma la ci 'byor ba'i yon phul la/ bla mas/ yul dang yid 'ong chung ma dang*// rin po che dang gser 'bar dang*// nor bu mu tig byi ru dang*// lus po yang ni dbul bas so// de nyid mi zad par 'dod pas// gang gang ci'ang ches yid du// 'dod chags ches khyad 'phags pa nyid// de de bla ma la dbul bya// slob dpon lha ni dam pa ste// 'bad pa'i sgo nas mchod par 'os// 'jig rten rjes bzung rgyu nyid kyis// de nyid lha yi gzugs can no// gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'dzin// tha dad nyid du mthong gyur pa// de yi de nyid dngos grub ni// tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid can mi thob// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pas yang dag 'byung*// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur// gang zhig bskal ba bye bar ni// brgya phrag tu yang rnyed dka' ba// de nyid sangs rgyas brtson ldan la// skye ba 'di la rtsol bar mdzad// ces phan yon bshad la/

spro ba bskyed de cho ga bcu bdun pa'o// bco brgyad pa rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ slob ma rnam snang du dmigs la rjes gnang byin te/ phreng ba la sogs dbang rnams kyis// dbang bskur nga yis byin pa yis// sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs te// sangs rgyas kun gyi mdun na gnas// da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon te// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsam// khyod ni bdud las rnam rgyal te// sangs rgyas thams cad 'thob par 'gyur// seng ge'i spyod pa legs spyad pas// khyod kyis sems can don rnams byos// chos rnams kun la ser sna dang*// sems can rnams la mi phan gang*// nyam nga shin tu che na yang*// bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya// 'di la the tshom mi bya ste// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /mnyam med khyod kyis bsgrag par bya// dkyil 'khor legs par bri bya ste// slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis// dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su// slob ma rnams la dbang bskur yang*// brtul zhugs brtan pas 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub// de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis ni// dngos grub de rnams thams cad 'byung*// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang ba dang*// khyod rtag bla ma gus pa yis// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan thogs drin du gzo zhes brjod// des na byas pa gzo ba yin// sangs rgyas rnams kyang khyod la bsrung*// zhes brjod pa dang*/ slob mas thal mo sbyar la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes brjod la/ khas blangs nas de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las/ phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso cher lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/

sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ de ltar thun mong gi dbang dgu 'khor dang bcas pa thob nas/ dus gcig la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur na/ skabs 'dir mchog dbang gsum bskur dgos la/ re zhig bskyed rim kho na'i lam la slob par 'dod pa'i gang zag la ni bum dbang yan chad kyis chog ste/ cho ga bco brgyad pa'o// bcu dgu pa gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ni/ de nas bla mas rdul tshol gyi dkyil 'khor la nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang mchod rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ dngos grub blang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rnams thog mar rang gis sprul pa'i phyir mthar yang rang gi lus la bsdus te/ de'ang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ rdul tshon gyi lha rnams la phog pas/ des lha rnams spyan drangs nas rang gi phung po lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga thim/ khams bzhi la yum bzhi/ mig sogs la sems dpa' sems ma/ tshigs bcu la khro bo bcu thim pas phung khams de rnams lha so so'i skur bsam/ brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ rang gi lus kyi cha shas so so la thim pas/ dkyil 'khor de dag tu gyur nas/ rang lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur par bsam/ de dag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od 'phros/ des sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bas sgrib pa dag nas hūm̐ yig tu gyur/ des nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur par bsam/ de rnams rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas bdag la thim par bsam mo// de las langs nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad rdo rje 'chang du bsgom pa ni cho ga bcu dgu pa'o// nyi shu pa dkyil 'khor sogs bsdu ba'i cho ga ni/

de ltar dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ a kā ro'i sngags sam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas mtshan ma rnams mtha' nas rim gyis bsdu/ de nas tshangs thig nas brtsams te/ gtso bo'i bar du rdo rjes bsub/ rang gi spyi bor rdul tshon cung zad bkod cing*/ don du gnyer ba yod na sbyin/ lhag ma rnams bum pa'i nang du blugs la mchod pa dang bku sti rgya chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i cha klung du cho ga bzhin du dor/ bum pa chu gtsang mas bkang ba bzung ste/ des thig rnams bsub cing dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la bsang gtor bya/ de nas rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rkang pa g.yon brkyang dang*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis la mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar byas la/ phan tshun 'khyud pa skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ut+kī la ya sarba bigh+nān/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥzhes bzlas te/ phur bu rnams phyung la/ rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje la thim par bsam/ 'o ma la/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags bzlas pas phur bu bkru zhing*/ khung bur blugs pas/ bgegs rnams kyi rma sos te sangs rgyas par bsam/ phur bu'i skud pa rnams bkrol te snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ tsan+dan gyi chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ satwa ar+tha/ ur sid+dhi swā hā/ zhes bzlas la ci bder bzhag go /de nas khro bo bcu la phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ gtor ma phul la gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la ba byung gi chus byugs la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de ma grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas te/ lhag chad kha bskangs la/ bsngo ba dang smon lam dang*/ bkra shis rnams bya ba ni cho ga nyi shu pa'o// gnyis pa ras bris la brten pa la gnyis/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas der maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'tshogs par byas la bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/

de nas sngar bshad pa'i cho ga bzhi pa yan chad bya mi dgos la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon byed par ma bshad pas ma byas kyang rung mod/ bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyis mdzad pas/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas sngar bzhin bya/ lha lhag gnas kyi gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ der cho ga gsum las lha rdzogs par bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa nas mchod pa sogs bya/ bum pa sta gon la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gcig 'du byas la/ der lha thams cad rdzogs par bskyed la bzlas pa bya/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ slob ma lhag gnas dang*/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bteg ste mchod bstod bya ba'i bar sngar ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ nang par snga bar mdang sta gon byas pa'i gnas su bris sku rab gnas can bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham pa nas/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dang*/ sta gon gyi lha gzhug pa/ mchod cing bzlas pa bya ba/ phyi rol tu gtor ma sbyin pa/ sgo dbye ba/ bdag 'jug bya zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i bar sngar dang 'dra'o// slob mar dbang bskur la/ thun mong gi dbang dgu yan chad sngar bzhin bskur ba'am/ yang na 'od dpag med kyi dbang la rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ mi bskyod pa lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung gnyis dor nas rjes gnang gi mjug tu/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung ba gsum byin kyang rung ngo*// de nas mchog dbang gsum bskur ba la/ thog mar gsang dbang gi don du/ slob mas bla ma la 'dod yon lnga dang*/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan dang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul la thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che// nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam spyod pa// kun tu bzang po spyod pa'i mchog /rgyal mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa// nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog

/rgyal bzhi mchod pa bshad du gsol// thar ba'i lam ni rab ston pa// theg pa gsum gyi lam la gnas// sangs rgyas skal mchog dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol// byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i spyan// chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// sku gsung thugs ni shin tu dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje theg pa la'o// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab la/ slob mas mthong na ma dad kyi dogs pas gdong g.yogs bcings la/ rnam snang du bsgom du bcug bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang*/ rig ma reg bya rdo rjer bskyed/ gnyis ka'i lus la rigs lnga sogs lus dkyil dgod/ rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dus byas rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis snyoms par 'jug pa las la gnas pa/ mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs chags pa chen pos zhu ste/ stong pa gsum rim gyis thim pa'i thams cad stong pa la 'od gsal/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin nyams su myangs nas nyon mongs pa dag pa'i gnas mngon sum du byas la/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod nas phaṭa ces brjod pas/ shes rab kyi chu skyes su byang chub kyi sems babs par bsam mo// de mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs la/ slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag par bsam zhing*/ dngos su bdud rtsi byin la/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod la byin/ des kyang rang gi lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad mnyes pa'i phyir/ a ho su kha/ zhes brjod cing myangs pas lus thams cad gang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i dri ma dag stong pa gsum gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams la cung zad mnyam par gzhag go

/de nas byang sems lhag ma de dung chos su dri bzang gi chu dang bsres nas yi ge gsum gyis bsngags te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro bas/ spyi bo nas blug cing 'thung du bcug la dbang bskur te/ pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab byung ste// rgyal ba rnams kyis dbu ni shin tu bskams pa la// rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung ba ye shes chu// dri med char gyis spyi bor dbang ni bskur gyur cig /ces pas so// de nas slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal las 'phos nas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin du mos te/ 'bru gsum gyis bsrung zhing mig ras bsal la/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las lus dkyil dang 'brel ba'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma 'khrud/ lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ sems dben bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ rig ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che// thams cad stong pa bla na med// mngon par byang chub mthong bas na// slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol// las dang skye las rnam grol ba'i// tshe 'dir byang chub nyid thob pa// rang myong mtshan nyid gcig pa nyid// sems dpa' chen po stsal du gsol// khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan na skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen po// de bas sangs rgyas mchog brnyes mdzod// ces sam/ bsdu na/ dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas ni// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

phan tshun ngo tshas bcings nas bde ba ngos mi zin pas/ de spang ba'i phyir/ gdong ras bcings la/ bla mas rig ma reg rdo rje mar bskyed/ rigs lnga bkod nas/ de'i lag pa slob ma'i lag par gtad nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dpang por byas te/ gzugs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtag /'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje'i skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya// de bas rig pa 'di mchog yin// chos kun gnyis su med pa la// dngos po gnyis su brtags pa yin// de bas 'khor bar rnam bral bar// rtag tu khyod kyis mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o// rmongs pa gang zhig 'das gyur na// de yi dngos grub mchog mi 'grub// ces brjod de gtad/ rig ma des kyang lus dri bzangs pos byugs/ gos dang bral bas/ rang gi chu skyes slob ma la ston cing*/ e ma bdag gis pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// s+t+waṃ bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod par bsam/ slob ma gsung rdo rje'i nga rgyal las 'phos te/ thugs rdo rjer bskyed/ rig ma reg rdo rjer bsam/ gnyis ka la lus dkyil bkod/ rdo rje pad+ma 'du byas/ rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis snyoms par zhugs la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtswa g.yon gyi cha na gnas pa sor mos bskul te/

de las byung ba'i bde ba la sogs pa'i sbyor bas hūm̐ glu ru blang zhing brtsam par bya'o// de ltar snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu yongs su gang ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ gsum pa dga' bral snang ba nye bar thob pa zhes bya ba/ rang gis nyams su myang bar byas te/ rdo rje pad+mar rab gnas te// byang chub sems kyang spang mi bya// bskyod bya de yi dga' ba yis// sems ni kun du gang bar bsgom// rnal 'byor pas ni byang chub sems// ji srid ma dor de srid du// rgyun mi 'chad par dga' ba las// byung ba'i bde ba cis mi thob// ces pa ltar don mngon du bya'o// gal te thig le 'dzag tu dogs na/ phaṭa ces brjod cing*/ thig le phyung la don grub kyi nga rgyal gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas mchod do// de nas rig ma'i rkang pa g.yon pa rang gi mgo la bzhag nas/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis// ci srid byang chub snying po'i bar// rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi// bla na med pa'i don byos shig /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi// 'di ni man ngag las ni shes// rig ma 'di ni dor byas nas// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya// brtul zhugs rnams kyis mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod// de ltar 'di ni rnal 'byor mchog /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma// rim pa ji bzhin yongs shes bya// rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang ston// zhes rig ma'i brtul zhugs byin la/ de'i lan du/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol lags// ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal// sems can kun la ci 'dod par// dngos grub bla na med pa stsal// zhes gtang rag phul la gdong g.yogs bsal nas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/

yid kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ gdong ras bcings pa'am/ ma bcings kyang rung ste/ slob ma sngar dbang gsum pa'i dus kyis nyams myong dran du bcug la/ 'di skad brjod do// 'dir bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dpe don du sbyar nas gsungs pa'i don yang*/ da lta khyod kyis dbang gsum pa'i dus su/ rang dang phyag rgya gnyis lha'i sku yab yum du snang bzhin pa'i dus na/ sems lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas de kho na nyid kyi don du zhugs pa gnyis dus mnyam du yod pa bzhin du/ lam 'di goms pas mthar rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku rang snang gi rig ma dang kha sbyor ba'i sku dang*/ de'i dus na thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang*/ stong nyid ro gcig tu gyur pa'i 'od gsal thams cad stong pa gnyis ngo bo dbyer med pa'i ye shes zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed de/ de ni thob bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa yin la/ de lta bus lus 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku dang*/ sems 'od gsal ro gcig pa ma thob kyang de dang mthun par mos pa yid byed kyi tshul gyis bsgoms pas 'bras bu zung 'jug mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// de'i don yang*/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes pa'i don yang*/

dngos po thams cad ni snod kyi 'jig rten te de dang bral ba dang*/ bcud kyi phung khams skye mched kyi bdag nyid can gyi gzung 'dzin spangs pa ste/ mdor na snod bcud kyi gnyis snang thams cad dag pa/ chos bdag med pa 'od gsal ba yin la/ de dang mnyam pa ste ro gcig tu zhugs pas rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa dang*/ zung du 'jug pa'i rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'od gsal stong pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ste/ sa bcu la zhugs pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyi mig gi spyod yul tsam du gyur pa'i zung du 'jug pa'i sku yin no// zhes bshad do// de nas slob mas dbang bzhi pa'i don la/ yid ches nas dga' ba'i blos/ e ma ho sangs rgyas/ e ma ho chos/ chos bshad pa ni ngo mtshar che// yang dag don ni dag pa'i don// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag med pa yi chos las byung*// sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs mdzad pa// rnam par mi rtog dmigs su med// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// kun tu bzang po thams cad don// byang chub sems ni rab bskor ba// byang chub spyod mchog rdo rje mchog /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// sangs rgyas byang chub rab ston pa// byang chub sems khyod la phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing gtang rag dbul lo// de nas sngar gdong ras bcings na bkrol la/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lam zung 'jug gi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed de/ dbang bzhi pa'o// de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar bsdams la/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// gtso bos bdag ni mchod par bzhes// zhes brjod la/

dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa yang dag par bsrung ba la nan tan du bya'o// de nas bla mas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ras bris kyi ye shes pa rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ las kyi rjes rnams mi mngon par bsdu zhing*/ rang rdo rje 'chang gi nga rgyal gyis/ bsngo ba dang smon lam btab la bkra shis bya'o// rgyal bas lung bstan rab dga'i sa brnyes pa// skyob pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi pad+ma las// legs 'ongs gdams pa'i bdud rtsi legs bsten pas// blo gros mig bye rtogs pa'i lus rgyas pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug klu yi byang chub dang*// blo chen sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis// legs mdzad dkyil 'khor cho ga'i gzhung bzang gnyis// rnam dag dbang gi chu bo dang bcas pa// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa skye dgu'i mgon// sdom brtson kha che'i mkhan po shākya shrīs// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gling nas spyan drangs nas// bod yul 'gro la phan bde bskyed phyir spel// de yi spyan sngar 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i mchog /chos kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas// ma nor dbang dang gzhung gi lung mnos nas// bshad cing bsgyur te legs par gtan la phab// de yi rjes 'jug dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang po la// mdo sngags gnyis kyi sde snod mang 'dzin pa// bshes gnyen bsam gtan dpal gyis bskul nas sbyar// rnam dkar dge ba gad+gā'i chu rgyun des// 'gro ba'i sems kyi dri ma kun sbyangs nas// zag med sku bzhi'i nor bus yongs gang ba// kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug gyur cig /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can/ rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/
