shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos grub chen klu'i byang chub kyi cho ga nyi shu pa dang*/ shar phyogs kyi slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i ras bris kyi cho ga dang*/ 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba'i smin byed kyi skabs rnams las 'byung ba'i don thams cad tshang bar bkod cing nyams su blang bde bar mdzes byed kyi lo mgo zla ba'i yar tshes lnga la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen bzang pos bgyis so// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las rgya mtsho bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las rgya mtsho ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab lus rdzogs bsam gtan thor cog mdzes// brtson 'grus tshangs skud bzod pa'i ska rags thogs// tshul khrims gun+dhe sbyin pa'i mchog sbyin can// sangs rgyas drang srong che la gus phyag 'tshal// lha rnams tshim dang sngags kyi nus bskyed dang*// sdig pa sbyang sogs las kun bsgrub pa dang*// dngos grub mchog rnams bde blag bsgrub pa'i phyir// sbyin sreg cho ga gzhung bzhin bshad kyis nyon// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dngos grub myur du 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ sbyin sreg gi cho gas lha mnyes par bya ba la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ sngar sa chog ma byas na dkyil chog ltar bya zhing*/ sngar byas na mi dgos pas/ sa phyogs der ba byung dang*/ dri bzang pos byugs la/ tshangs zur gyi thig rnams gdab/ de'i dbus su zhi ba la thab khung zlum po/

rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran sor bzhi dor ba'i phyi rol du/ rgya dang dpangs su sor bzhi pa'i kha khyer gyis bskor bar bya/ de'i phyi rol du/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rten gnas// de yi dbus su thab khung dgod// ces 'byung ba'i mchod rten gyi don ni/ gzhal yas khang la bshad pas/ lha snam shin tu che bar bya/ de'i phyi rol du rtsig pa dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ sgo dang rta babs nas me ri'i bar dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa chu tshon gyis bri/ thab kyi nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang*/ phyi'i kha khyer la 'khor lo dang*/ 'khor lo'i phreng ba bri/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan dang*/ thab khung gi grwa bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje phyed pa bri'o// rgyas pa la thab khung gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru do/ zabs su khru gang pa/ mu ran sogs gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du lha snam sogs sngar dang 'dra ba/ thab kyi dbus dang kha khyer la/ rin po che cha dgu pas mtshan cing*/ grwa bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rin po ches mtshan pa bri ste/ me thab kyi mtshan nyid do// thab khung der zhi ba la mchod sbyin gyi shing la sogs pa 'o ma can gyi rtse mo las byung ba'i shing rlon pa 'dab ma dang bcas pa/ sbom phra mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam/ srid du khru gang dang ldan pa/ sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis byugs pa'i bud shing gis thab khung dang dpangs mnyam par brtsig rgyas pa la yal ga can gyi dbus kyi cha las byung ba'i shing*/ sbom phra cha ga gang dang*/ srid du khru do'i tshad dang ldan pa/ zho dang*/ mar dang*/ dri ser pos byugs pas thab kyi dbyibs bzhin du brtsig de'i nang du/ me tshang bcas la bzhag ste/ bud shing gi mtshan nyid do// de nas bdag gi g.yas/ thab khung gi g.yon du/ zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi shing dang*/ rgyas pa la 'bras bu can gyi shing las grub pa'i yam shing rtse mo gnyis mar la byug pa dang*/

mar dang*/ til dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ 'bras dang*/ so ba dang*/ nas dang*/ sran ma dang*/ gro dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ ku sha rnams bsham/ g.yon du/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ mdun du nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ phur bu bcu tho ba dang bcas pa yang bsham/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'tshog par bya zhing*/ thab khung gi phyi'i me ri'i steng du/ phur khung bcu yang dgod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de nas bdag nyid zhi ba la/ gos dang rgyan dkar pos brgyan cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sogs zhi bar 'dod pa'i sems dang*/ rgyas pa la rgyan gos ser pos brgyan cing*/ chos dang longs spyod rgyas par 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ 'jam zhing 'bol ba'i stan la/ zhi ba la shar dang*/ rgyas pa la kha byang du phyogs pas 'dug ste/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na/ sgrub cing mchod pa rnams legs par tshar nas/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma gtong*/ nang du zhugs la/ lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ sgo dbye ba dang*/ lhag chad kha bskang ba yan chad rdzogs par byas nas/ sbyin sreg la 'jug go /sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na thab khung gi drung ngam/ gnas gzhan du'ang rung ste/ bdag bskyed tshogs rten nas nyer bsdu'i bar bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas la/ zhi ba la tsog pu'am/ skyil krung*/ rgyas pa la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod la/ thog mar bdag nyid shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa nas/ de zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgyur la/ de'i phrag pa nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad/ zhi ba la oṃ las skyes pa'i sems dpa'i rdo rje dkar po dang*/ rgyas pa la swā las skyes pa'i rdo rje ser po 'od rab tu 'bar ba can rnams kyis lus thams cad la khyab par bsams la/

de rnams las dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i yi ge hūm̐ me'i rang bzhin can dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ sbyin sreg gi sa'i cha la phog pas/ sa'i nyes pa thams cad bsregs nas/ sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo// de nas rang gi snying gar hūm̐ bsams pa las/ khro bo bcu spros nas/ thab khung gi phyi rol gyi phyogs bcur 'khod par bsams la/ de nas 'og gi gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas/ des bgegs bkug pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas phur bu gdab pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ dngos su phur bu rnams rang ngam slob mas sngar gyi phur khung rnams su gdab cing*/ tho bas brdung ba dang*/ me dang*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ gur dang*/ sa gzhi rnams kyis bsrung ste/ gnas bsrung ba'o// de nas thab kyi phyi'i bris pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas/ rang lha snam gyi steng du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bsam/ de nas ku sha gtsang ma/ las thams cad pas bsangs la/ thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ g.yas skor du/ dang po'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non pa dgram zhing*/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed de// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /'dis bdag la bgegs med par mdzod cig oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī sarba bigh+nāṃ/ nā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing dgram mo// de nas thab dang yo byad rnams las thams cad pas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs nas stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba la oṃ dang*/ rgyas pa la swā bris pa dang rjes su mthun zhing*/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i thab khung dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bskyed la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ā swā hās yam shing dang*/

oṃ shrī swāṃ hās mar dang*/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru rnams dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad byin gyis brlab bo// de nas shing khru gang pa ras dkar pos dkris la/ zhi ba la bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gam/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'i pho brang nas byung ba'i me blangs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas me sbar nas/ bud shing brtsigs pa'i me mtshams su bzhag la/ sngags de nyid brjod cing*/ mar blugs gzar gsum gyis me gsos te/ rlung g.yab kyis g.yob cing sbar ro// de nas me de nyid bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ zhi ba la baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥraṃ hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ pā sa ka zhes bya ba'i me lha sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ phreng ba/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon na dril bu dbyug gu/ gun+dhe rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ sma ra dang ag tshom 'phyangs pa/ kṛh+ṇa swa ra'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dkar pos mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'bab par bskyed/ rgyas pa la laṃ las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i steng du/ oṃ āḥraṃ hūm̐ las ma hen+t+ra zhes bya ba'i me lha sku mdog ser po rgyas pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rin po che phreng ba mchog sbyin/ g.yon dril bu dbyug gu/ gun+dhe rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog sogs sngar dang 'dra ba la tshangs skud ser po thogs shing*/ sku las bdud rtsi ser po'i rgyun 'bab par bskyed la/

gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma'i rtsa ba nas bzung*/ g.yas pas ku sha dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ mthe bong bskyod pas/ mthe bong gi rtse mo srin lag gi rtsa bar 'dzugs bzhin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// ces dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ a bhe sha a bhe sha ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya/ bā ha nā ya swā hā zhes pa'i sngags la/ zhi ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā sa ka ag+na ye ya mān+ta kṛ ta dzaḥ ces dang*/ rgyas pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hen+t+ra ag+na ye ya mān+ta kṛ ta dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ thab kyi me mtshams su bzhugs par bsam/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ ku shas bsang gtor nas blangs la gtor zhing*/ sngar gyi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bsal/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta baṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa la dbyer med du bstim/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya dz+wa la ya/ sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas dam la bzhag go /de nas zhi ba la byang chub khu tshur dang*/ rgyas pa la rin chen khu tshur gyis dgang gzar dang blugs gzar bzung ste mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la lan gsum me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ zhi ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā sa ka ag+na ye ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa dang*/ rgyas pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hen+t+ra ag+na ye ma ma puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i rjes la/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ a bhi sha a bhi sha/ ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar dang nang bdud rtsis mchod la/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing*// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang*// thabs la mkhas pa drang srong cha lugs ni// 'dzin byed me lha khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba// bdag gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs// tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/ bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul te/ zhi ba la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā sa ka ag+na ye/ zhes pa thams cad kyi sngon du sbyar la/ oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ zhes so so'i sngags rnams brjod pa'i mthar/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas sbyar la yam shing dbul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hās til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zho zan dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās so ba dang*/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma ma sha dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūrba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta swā hās ku sha rnams bdun nam/ nyer gcig phul la/ slar yang mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la lan gsum dbul zhing*/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar bzhin bya/ de nas 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis me la bsang gtor byas la/ bzed zhal du mchod yon phul bas/ me lha 'bar ba'i gzugs su gyur par bsams te/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas me de bsang sbyangs nas/

stong pa'i ngang las me'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi thab sbyor sku mdog sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad cing*/ khro gnyer g.yo ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ ha har bzhad pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas na/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ral gri/ gtun shing 'dzin pa/ g.yon na dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi gnas pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na/ bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa skad cig gis bskyed la/ de la mar gyi byon zan gsum dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams brgya'am bdun la sogs pa ci nus pa dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta sarba bigh+nān+nā shā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod do// de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ bgegs mthar byed dbang ldan gyi thab kyi kha khyer la 'khod nas bar chad bsrung bar bsam ste bgegs bzlog pa'i cho ga'o// de nas thab dang yo byad thams cad bsangs la/ me'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ der rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na lha so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ me tog gis mtshon nas spyan drangs te/ thab tu dor ba so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ sngar bskyed pa'i gdan gyi steng du so so'i sa bon las/ zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig

/ces pa dang*/ pad skor gyi phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga bān i hi bhak+ṣa sa ma ye na tsa pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha saṃ bhu dzaṃ pra sa dha yā mi/ zhes brjod pas/ mdun du byon pa la/ zhi ba la oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzi na dzika ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā dang*/ rgyas pa la oṃ āḥhūm̐ rat+na dhṛka ma ma puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis sngar ltar byon zan phul la dam tshig pa la bstim/ dbu rgyan rang chas can du bsam mo// de nas zhi ba la lha thams cad 'od dkar po 'phro zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa/ ljags rnams la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ rgyas pa la lha thams cad 'od ser por 'phro zhing rgyas pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun ser por babs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa/ ljags rnams la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de nas/ phyi dang nang dang*/ gsang ba rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod la/ lha so so'i sngags sngon du 'gro bas re re zhing bsreg rdzas rnams zhi ba la brgya/ rgyas pa la brgya dang brgyad dbul ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na/ gtso bo la grangs tshang ba dang*/ 'khor rnams la bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig re dbul/ de'i bar la me'i mtshan ma brtag ste/ 'ja' dang 'dra zhing mdog sdug dang*// byi ru bcag pa lta bu dang*// g.yas su 'khyil zhing shin tu snum// zhes sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma dang*/ de las ldog na mi dge ba'i mtshan mar shes par byas la/ sngar bzhin bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sbyin sreg byas la/ bgegs sbyang*/ mtshan ma bzang na de dag mi dgos/ de nas sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

nongs pa bzod par gsol/ lha dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs pa yin na/ so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ me tog gis mtshon nas spyan drangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar min na/ lha rnams rang gi lus dkyil la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas bsdu'o// de nas me lha'i sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul bas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ me lha'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ mchod bstod bya/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig re phul la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon kyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pa'am/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcings// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la gsol// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod la/ de nas gtor ma gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ me lha'i sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/

'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed byin pa za ba gshegs// ci bzhin dus su 'dir byon zhing*// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas me lha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ste/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci nus su bya/ de nas me ma shi bar du mi dkrug mi brdal/ mi bsgul lo// long med na/ zhi ba la 'o ma dang*/ rgyas pa la dri ser pos me gzhil la thal ba dang sol ba rnams bsdus nas/ las thams cad pa'i bum par blugs la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor te/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dbang dang drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor mthar ma phyin gyi bar byed mi rung bar bshad pas 'dir ma bris so// sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ sngags dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg khri phrag gcig gi lha tshim par bya dgos par bshad pas/ de'i tshul yang bsnyen pa bya ba'i gnas de nyid du zhi ba'am/ rgyas pa'i thab khung rkyang pa byas la/ de'i drung du kha byang ngam shar du bltas la/ bsreg rdzas g.yas dang*/ mchod rdzas g.yon du bzhag rang rnam snang ngam/ rin 'byung gis gtso bo byas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum tshang bar bsgoms nas/ mdun gyi bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ thab khung bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ de'i nang du lhag mos ltar lha so gnyis rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ nam mkha' la bteg de nas me blangs nas sbar te/ mar byugs la ma shi ba bya/ der sngar nam mkhar bteg pa de phab la bstod pa/ phyi mchod nang mchod mnyes mchod rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas sngar zhi ba'i thab khung bris pa yin na/

lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar rdzas so so'i sngags dang bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i thab khung bris na/ rim pa gnyis kyis rtogs pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes brjod/ bsdu na 'bru gsum gyi mthar/ zhi rgyas kyi spel tshig bcug pas rung ngo*// de ltar gsang sngags 'bum phrag re la/ sbyin sreg khri phrag re re bya'o// mthar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod cing bstod/ dngos grub blangs/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ lha rnams rang gi lus dkyil la bsdu/ thab la ras gsar pas g.yogs la sba/ nangs par yang cho ga la sngar bzhin 'jug go /yang na sbyin sreg dang bzlas pa dus mnyam du tshar bar bya ste/ sngags bcu bzlas shing*/ sbyin sreg re re byas pas sbyin sreg khri song tsam na sngags 'bum phrag gcig thon par bya'o// yang legs grub kyi rgyud las/ nyin bar bzlas pa dang*/ de du song gi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg mtshan mor byed par bshad pas/ ji ltar rigs par nyams su blangs pas/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha mnyes par 'gyur zhing*/ rgyu des bsod nams rgyas shing nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// mgon po klu sgrub shing rta'i srol 'byed mchog /dpal ldan zla ba grags pas rjes bzung ba// rab 'jigs rdo rje'i gzhung gi rjes 'brangs nas// ma nor sbyin sreg cho ga gsal bar byas// 'dir 'bad dge ba 'od gsal me 'od kyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i bud shing kun bsregs nas// rnam par mi rtog chos sku'i thab khung du// gzugs sku ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel la thos bsam don du gnyer ba'i slob ma bshes gnyen bzang pos bskul zhing*/ yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par blangs pa/

shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos slob dpon rab 'jigs rdo rje'i gzhung dang*/ 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba'i sbyin sreg gi skabs rnams la brten nas mdzes byed kyi lo mgo'i yar tshes bdun la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga bkra shis rgya mtsho bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i sgo nas rten la rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i cho ga bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dge legs sa gzhir tshogs gnyis sa bon btab// thabs mkhas snying rje'i chu yis brlan pa las// sku gsum snye ma yon tan lo 'dab rgyas// skyob pa dpag bsam shing la gus btud nas// bstan pa rgya mtsho yun du gnas phyir dang*// phan bde rgya mtshos skye dgu ma lus pa'i// bsod nams rgya mtsho yang dag bskyed phyir du// bkra shis rgya mtsho'i rab gnas bshad kyi nyon// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas// bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas// slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus// yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni// cho ga dag la 'jug par bya// zhes pa ltar don drug las/ dang po gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten lugs ma dang*/ bris pa dang*/ 'bur du byas pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzo bo'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa'o// gnyis pa gang gis rab tu gnas par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ de nyid bcu shes shing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa las su rung zhing cho ga la mkhas pa/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can no// gsum pa gang du rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas ni/

bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa shin tu yangs pa'i sa phyogs so// bzhi pa nam bya ba'i dus ni/ tshes dang gza' skar khyad par can 'dzom pa'i yar gyi ngo'am/ gza' skar lhag par bzang na mar gyi ngo la yang rung zhing*/ dpyid zla 'bring po sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus dang*/ dgun zla 'bring por 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi dus gnyis ni/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bshad do// lnga pa yo byad ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med cing gya nom pa rnams bsag go /drug pa cho ga la dngos dang*/ de'i phan yon gnyis kyi/ dang po la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du 'byung ba las/ thog mar rgyas pa'i tshul brjod na/ don gsum ste/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po ni/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas// rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la// bgegs bskrad mchod de dgug gzhug bya// rgyas gdab mchod bstod gtor ma dang*// snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// rten dgab bdag bsrung sta gon no// zhes pa ltar don bcu gsum las/ dang po legs par bsham pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i yo byad dang rab gnas la dgos pa'i yo byad bsham pa'o// dang po ni/ thog mar rab gnas bya ba'i gnas su/ sa sbyangs pa nas brtsams te/ bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i bar gyis sa'i cho ga rgyas par bya/ de nas thod le kor gyis thig gdab pa nas/ tshon dgye ba'i bar gyi thig gdab pa dang*/ sta gon dang*/ tshon byin gyis brlab cing bkye ba rnams byas la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mtshan ma dgod pa dang mchod gtor bsham pa yan chad dkyil chog ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten stegs bu mthon po'i steng du/ shar la sogs par zhal gzigs par byas la/ dar ram ras la sogs pas g.yogs te/

las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pas bsrung ngo*// de'i mdun du khrus sa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru bzhi/ dpangs su khru gcig gam gnyis yod pa bya/ rtsig pa ma grub na rdul tshon ser pos/ khru bzhi pa'i gru bzhi pa bris te/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris la/ der dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang*/ mtshams bzhir yum bzhi'i mtshan ma 'dri ba'am/ yang na bla ma dag dbus su rin po che cha dgu pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'dri ba mdzad pas/ de ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// de'i dbus su man+dzi la sogs pa'i steng du/ gser dngul lam zangs kyi khrus gzhong bu ga dang bral pa bzhag la/ der sngar rab gnas byas pa'i rten chung ngu zhig gam/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rdo rje la sogs pa bzhag de dang nye bar maṇ+ḍal lam/ gro ga la gur gum mam gi wang gis yi ge gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams bris la bzhag go /'dab brgyad so so'i steng du/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa brgyad du dri bzang po'i chu dang*/ 'og nas bshad pa ltar so so'i rdzas kyis bkang*/ kha rgyan dang mgul chings la sogs kyis brgyan pa bsham/ khrus stegs de'i mdun du dūr ba'i pir dang*/ dri'i til mar ram/ med na til mar la dri bzang btab pa dang*/ n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i shing shun lnga'am/ ma 'byor na sran dkar gyi phye ma dang*/ me long dang*/ ras dkar po'i sku phyi ba dang*/ bgegs dang dri ma sbyangs pa'i yo byad rnams kyang bsham/ khrus stegs kyi g.yon phyogs su rab gnas kyi lha la mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bris te/ de'ang phyogs re re la cha lnga lnga ste bcu par byas la/ dbus kyi cha gnyis la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ phyi rol gyi zur nas bskor la lcags ri bya/ phyogs bzhi nas mchod rten ltar je chung du btang la ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/

shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser po/ zur bzhi'i re mig rnams sngon por bya/ de'i phyi rol du/ shar zla gam/ lho sog ka nub zlum po/ byang gru bzhi ste gling bzhi dang*/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon du gling phran gnyis gnyis/ dbyibs sngar dang 'dra bar byas la bri/ gling phran gyi khyams g.yas g.yon la/ shar du dpal be'u 'khor lo/ lhor pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs bum pa/ byang du dung dang nya bri zhing*/ mtha'i lcags ri sngon por bya'o// dbus kyi pad+ma'i steng du rin po che bdun gyi gzugs bkod/ gzhan yang bla re dang*/ dar gyi lda lding dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsag go /gnyis pa bdag bskyed bya ba ni/ slob dpon dpon slob rnams khrus byas te/ dkyil 'khor dang nye bar 'dug la/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ba nas brtsams te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mchod cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ phyi rol du gtor ma btang nas nye reg bya ba'i bar rdzogs par byas nas/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la bskor ba bya zhing*/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ me tog dbul zhing rang gi mgo la bcing ba/ sgo phye zhing gsol ba gdab pa yan chad dkyil chog ci lta ba bzhin du bya/ de nas bdag 'jug bya ba'am/ sta gon gyi skabs 'dir ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do// gsum pa 'bum bzlas ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bum pa rnams ni sngar bzlas zin pas 'dir mi dgos la/ khrus bum brgyad la gzungs thag btags la/ las bum gyi chus gtor zhing bgegs mthar byed kyis bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyangs ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/

nang chu dang so so'i rdzas rnams kyis yongs su gang bar bsams la/ dri lnga blugs pa'i bum pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de bzhin du gan+dha'i gnas su so so'i sngags rnams sbyar la bzlas te/ mngar gsum gyi bum pa la/ tri ma dhu ra dang*/ zho la/ da dhi dang*/ 'bras bu la/ pha la dang*/ 'bru la/ brū hi dang*/ 'bras yos la/ lādz+dza dang*/ sman la/ o ṣa dhi dang*/ rin po che'i bum pa la/ ma ṇi snā na zhes byas la/ brgya rtsa re bzlas/ thun mong du gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags ci nus su bzlas la/ nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo// bzhi pa rten sbyang ba ni/ thog mar bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma gsum bshams la/ chus bran nas lan gsum du rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas pa byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/ ting lo dang*/ chang bu rten la bskor zhing rdo rje sor/ suṃ bha ni bzlas pa lan gsum byas nas/ sngags kyi tshig gi rjes la gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la gtor ma phyir dor ba zhi drag phyed mas sbyong ba dang*/ de nas rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dril bu dang*/ spos thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsregs// zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod pas snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ khro bo'i tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan dang*/ so so'i sngags kyis mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod phul la/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spang zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod la/

zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la/ bar du gcod par brtsams pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rang rang gi gnas su song shig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la/ rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ mtshon chas bsdigs/ sna tshogs pa'i rol mo drag tu bya zhing*/ khro bo bcu'i phreng sngags sogs drag sngags mang du bzlas/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad phyi rol du bros par bsam pa ni drag po'i sbyang ba'o// de nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ rang gi mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag la/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib rnams snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par 'thon nas/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ de g.yas kyi ye shes kyi mes bsreg g.yon gyi rgya mtshos bkrus par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ yang na bshad rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar/

oṃ sarba a pa ra ṇa shud+dha sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ya badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod do// lnga pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rten gsar pa la khrus bya ba'i sngon du/ khrus stegs kyi steng gi rten dang yig 'bru rnams la las bum gyi chus khrus bya zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de dag sku la sogs kyi tshig dang sngags kyi sku phyi'o// de nas chu de khrus bum brgyad por cung zad re blugs la/ lugs ma la sogs pa bkrur rung ba rnams rol mo dang bcas pas khrus stegs su spyan drangs la dngos su bkru/ de ltar mi rung ba rnams la me long gi nang du rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar bar byas la/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du// chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas// bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ thog mar dri'i til mar ram/ med na til mar la dri bzang btab pas me long la byug de nas shun lpags lnga'i phye ma'am/ ma 'byor na sran dkar gyi 'dag chal gyis mnyes/ dūrba'i pir gyis drud/ chu gtsang mas kyang bkru'o// de nas dri'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin brlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas ras dkar po la gur gum gyi chus/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥ zhes bris pa'am/ ma 'byor na de dag brjod bzhin du/ thig le lnga byas la/ de rang gi phrag pa g.yon pa la bskon te/

des dngos su phyi ba'am/ me long gi gzugs brnyan la phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hṝḥ.a kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de bzhin du bum pa 'og ma rnams kyis bkru ba'i tshe yang*/ sngon du rdzas gsum gyis byugs pa dang*/ bar du rang rang gi bum pas bkru ba dang*/ mthar sku phyi ba rnams thams cad la shes par byas la bya'o// de nas rdzas gsum gyis sngar ltar byugs la/ mngar gsum gyis bum pas bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o// zhes dang*/ tri ma dhu snā na sogs brjod cing sku phyi/ yang byug cing*/ zho'i bum pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ da dhi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing phyi/ yang byug cing*/ 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi bum pas/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ pha la snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing phyi/ yang byug cing*/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi bum pas/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ bru hi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing phyi/ yang byug cing*/ 'bras yos kyi bum pas/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ lādz+dza snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing phyi/

yang byug cing*/ sman gyi bum pas/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yengs dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ ṣa dhi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing phyi/ de nas rdzas gsum gyis byug cing*/ rin po che'i bum pas/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bkru/ de dag sku la sogs brjod cing ras kyis phyi'o// de nas dri yi bum pa thogs te/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// dri chu drug gis khrus mdzad cing*// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes brjod cing bkru'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cig

/gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang gis chos rnams mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang*// gsum gtsang gtsang ma mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsungs pa// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad gyur cig /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyis 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde gyur cig /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde gyur cig /khyed cag lam 'gror bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong rnams kyang bde gyur cig /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed la kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas dri'i bum pas bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing*/

de dag sku la sogs zhes sogs kyis sku phyi'o// drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ rten rnams las thams cad pas bsang*/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'am/ khro bo yin na raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rten ngo shes pa rnams rang rang gi sa bon dang phyag mtshan las so sor bskyed/ mi shes pa rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ de las rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod rten dang lha khang ni bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo/ de las rnam snang du bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten dang lha khang gi nang du/ cho ga gsum gyis rigs lnga bskyed la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsgom/ po sti rnams ni āḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med/ rdo rje dang dril bu la sogs pa phyag mtshan rnams ni hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod par bskyed/ khang bzang dang*/ rta babs dang*/ ljon shing dang*/ rdo ring dang*/ chu mig dang khron pa rnams ni bh+rūm̐ dang 'khor lo las rnam par snang mdzad du bsam mo// de rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsams la byin gyis brlab bo// bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug pa la gsum/ spyan drang ba dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces dang*/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur byon tshul byon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces brjod la las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo drag tu bya'o// de nas/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol zhing*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/

zhes pas gdan 'bul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas// phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa// tshim byed yid 'ong gang ldan pa// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas dri dang*/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na// lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba// chu dang thang skyes yid byung rnams// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ me tog dang*/ phyogs bcu kun nas bdug spos ni// lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs// dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// badz+ra dhū pe/ bdug spos dang*/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi// rin chen mar me la sogs pa// snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// badz+ra ā lo ke mar me dang*/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na// lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas// yon tan kun ldan gang yin de// thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul// badz+ra ne wi d+ye/ zhal zas dang*/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rol mo rnams dbul lo// gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ de ltar mchod pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang nye bar spyan drangs/ oṃ pradzñān+t+ra kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa rnams zhugs/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ zhes pas ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing bstim mo// gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang*/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mos sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// che ge mo yi don slad du// bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs shing*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs pa'i rigs// zhes lan gsum brjod la sngar ltar dgug gzhug bya'o// brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ sngags kyis dbang bskur bas/ lha thams cad kyi sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas/ so so'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam zhing*/ lha ngo mi shes pa rnams la mi bskyod pa'am/ rdo rje sems dpas rgyas gdab bo// dgu pa mchod bstod bya zhing gtor ma btang ba ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/

de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' rnams 'og ma kun la sbyar/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// me tog dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul// ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes// badz+ra puṣ+pe/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni// mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// badz+ra dhū pe/ mun pa'i tshogs kun 'joms byed cing*// phyogs kun gsal ba'i mar me 'di// kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// badz+ra ā lo ke lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni// rang byung nyid la 'bul bar bgyi// kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol// badz+ra gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i// bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan// thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /chos dbyings ye shes mnyes la 'bul// badz+ra ni wi d+ye/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston pa// shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra// bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi// don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shab+da/ ces dang*/ dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo dbul lo// de nas/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// zhes sogs kyi de nyid lnga pa dang*/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyed la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rje thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen gling mchog skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon de la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/

gtor ma rnams sbyangs te/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ gnyis pa nag po chen po dang*/ gsum pa gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong gang yin dang*/ bzhi pa 'byung po spyi rnams la phul te/ rten byin rlabs che ba dang*/ yon bdag bkra shis pa'i phrin las gzhol lo// de nas sbyin sreg byed na/ zhi ba'am rgyas pa gang rung bya ste/ de'ang 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i skabs su/ rab tu gnas par bya ba'i lha thab tu spyan drangs la/ de'i sngags kyis bsreg rdzas 'bul ba sogs cho ga rdzogs par bya'o// bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bcug pa'i ye shes pa rnams nang par dngos gzhi'i dus su rten byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ 'byon par zhu'o snyam du bsams la/ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba// kun gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir// bdag ni rdo rje che ge mos// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// rab gnas nang par bgyid par 'tshal// tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la rab tu gnas par bgyi 'tshal na/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams sang nang par byon cing*/ rten byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag la dngos grub kyi mchog stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la mchod bstod bsdus pa cig bya'o// bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i rten la nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ hūm̐ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha/

ces pas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rten gyi ye shes pa phye la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsams nas mchod bstod bsdus pa cig bya'o// kha cig ye shes pa brtan bzhugs byed kyi/ nam mkhar mi 'degs pa man ngag yin zer ba ni/ snyan gsan phab pa'i dgos pa ma shes par zad do// bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas na bza' ser pos rten rnams mi mngon par dgab la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ de ltar rab gnas kyi sta gon zin pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub blang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ ye shes pa rnams brtan bzhugs byas la/ rang gi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod pas bsrung bar bya'o// de nas sang nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa bsham pa la sogs pa rnams byas la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bde bar nyal te/ sta gon gyi cho ga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod// rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab// rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab// dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya// gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya// de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang*// sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o// zhes pa ltar don bcu gsum las/ dang po bdag bskyed ni/ sang tho rangs snga bar ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ gos ser po gyon la stan la 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ba nas/ sgo dbye zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar rdzogs par bya/ rten la dbang bskur dgos pas/ rang gis bdag 'jug blang zhing gsol ba gdab pa rnams bya'o// gnyis pa rten sbyang ba dang*/ gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ sta gon ltar nyams su blangs la/ bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug pa ni/ sku gzugs rnams kyi dbu'i rgyab phyogs su bug pa yod na/

sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rig sngags chen mo dang*/ rten 'brel snying po dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// sems kyi sdom pa legs pas na// thams cad du'ang sdom pa legs// zhes pa'i so so thar pa rnams gzhug bu ga med pa'am/ mchod rten dang sku gzugs sngar bcug zin pa yin na/ ring bsrel mi dgos la/ gzungs dang so sor thar pa bris la dbu'am bre la gdags so// lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams langs la/ lag tu me tog dang*/ rol mo rnams thogs nas/ yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang*/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang*/

cho 'phrul gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ bslab pa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pas de de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang*/ shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes pas nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs pa rnam par spong ba dang*/ bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang*/ skyes bu sku blta bas chog mi shes pa dang*/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// zhes brjod cing*/ rab tu gnas par bgyi'o// zhes pa'i skabs su thams cad kyis tshig mthun par brjod la/ rten la me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug rol mo dbul zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ shākya mu na ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha gang yin gyi sngags dang*/ rang gi yi dam gyi sngags bzla ba rnams ni sde tshan re re'i mthar bya'o// rjes dran bzhi po 'di/ bla ma dag gis lan gsum re mdzad par snang la/ gzhan dag lan cig las ma bshad zer na'ang*/ gcig dang gsum du byed pa gang yin mi gsal zhing*/ sems bskyed kyi tshig thams cad lan gsum re 'don pa gzhung du ma nas 'byung la/ 'dir sems bskyed kyi tshig tu slob dpon zhi ba snying pos bshad pas lan gsum du byas pa 'thad pa yin no// de nas stan la 'dug nas/

kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems cung zad bsgoms la/ 'di skad brjod de/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi pas de'i mthus bdag gis sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ngo*// 'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o// phas kyis rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o// sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod do// 'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o// ma dad pa dang phyir rgol ba dang lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro// las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o// srid pa'i rgya mtsho bskam par bgyi'o// chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o// bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do// bsam gtan gyi bde ba las rtser stsal to// 'dod chags kyi me dpung gzhil bar bgyi'o// zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po rnams gzhom par bgyi'o// bde ba la gzud do// phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o// ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o// sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o// 'jigs pa thams cad ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o// de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis kyang gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/

drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ sta gon gyi skabs su ji ltar bshad pa ltar ro// bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya dang*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs nas// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs pa dang phyi 'brang gi bgegs bsal ba byon legs bya ba/ gdan dang mchod pa 'bul ba rnams sta gon dang 'dra bar byas la/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa nam mkhar gnas pa de/ rten la dgug gzhug yang yang bya zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi khams dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa sngar bzhin bya'o// brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang*/ phyag mtshan gsum bsgoms pa sngar bzhin no// dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi rten la dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rig pa'i dbang drug

rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang che chung gnyis dang bcas pa dkyil chog bzhin rgyas par bskur la/ de'i tshe bum chu rnams kyis rten la dngos su gtor ba'am/ me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la chu dbang rgyas par bskur/ dbu rgyan dang cod paṇa mgo la bcing ba'am/ bris sku sogs yin na 'ching ba'i tshul bya/ rdo rje dang dril bu me long rnams phyag tu gtad par bsams la/ mdun du bzhag pa sogs slob ma la dbang bskur ba ltar bya'o// de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i byang chub kyi sems rten gyi lce la bzhag pa dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pas zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsams la/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa rnams dkyil chog bzhin du bskur ro// de ltar dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'am/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ sngar sta gon gyi skabs ltar/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod do// de nyid lnga pa sogs kyis bstod do// kha cig spyan dbye ma byas par mchod bstod la mi dbang bas 'dir mchod bstod mi byed pa man ngag yin zer ba ni mun sprul du zad de/ de ltar na sta gon gyi skabs su rten rnams lha so sor bskyed pa la/ mchod bstod rgyas par bshad pa de'ang mi 'thad par gyur te/ der spyan dbye ba ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ gser drug nam las mi chung ba'i thur mas/ dngul gyi kong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blangs pa'am/ ma 'byor na thur ma des dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon phra mo gcig blangs la spyan gyi thad du byug cing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog

/oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu/ sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing*/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo// bcu gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rten de la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis dbul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ sngar gyi rdo rje 'chang zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// de bzhin du posti ni/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs dang*/ gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur par blta/ phyag mtshan rnams ni mi bskyod pa zhu ba las phyag mtshan so so'i dbyibs dang kha dog ci lta ba bzhin du bsam/ khang bzang dang rta babs sogs ni rnam par snang mdzad zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i khang bzang sogs rang rang gi rnam pa ci lta ba bzhin bsam mo// de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir du dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo dbul/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas so// de ltar lan gsum du byas pa'i rjes su/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa// rin chen dbang po snang ba mtha' yas dpal// don grub la sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams// sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// zag med bde ba'i dbang phyug bde gshegs yum// spyan ma mā ma kī dang gos dkar mo// sgrol ma la sogs rigs kyi lha mo rnams// sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// byams pa sa snying phyag rdor nam snying po// 'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug kun tu bzang*// sgrib sel la sogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams// sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// ma lus rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes byed pa'i// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje dang*// chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs sems ma rnams// sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// gshin rje gshed dang shes rab pad mthar byed// bgegs dgra mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can// stobs chen gtsug tor can dang gnod mdzes rnams// sku gzugs 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas rten 'di la// 'gro ba'i don du mi 'bral brtan bzhugs nas// sbyin bdag dge zhing shis par mdzad du gsol// ji srid sa sogs 'byung ba chen po bzhis// sku gzugs gnod par ma gyur de srid du// thugs rje chen ldan mgon po bcom ldan rnams// brtan par bzhugs nas bkra shis mdzad du gsol// zhes sogs kyis tshig gi brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/

rol mo dang bcas pas rten gyi gnas gsum du rdo rje reg pas/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs par bsam mo// rten la me tog 'thor ba'i dngos gzhi 'di yin pas/ rjes dran bzhi'i skabs dang*/ sngags kyis mnga' dbul la dngos gzhi byed pa rnams ni ma shes pa yin no// bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham/ de dag bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ dpag tu med par sprul la dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun// bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol// zhes dang*/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi mchod yon dang*/ sngags kyi ar+ghaṃ rnams kyi gnas su/ lha rdzas me tog dang*/ puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū paṃ/ snang gsal dang*/ dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ye/ sil snyan dang*/ shap+ta/ ces pa rnams bcug cing*/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra bar sbyar la/ dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo rgya cher dbul lo// de nas rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje ma lnga spros la/ des mchod par bsams te/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa// ston zla'i mdog can gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyi mngon sprul nas// rgyal ba sras bcas gzugs kyi bde bas mchod// oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rī hūm̐/ zhes pas gzugs dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa 'dra bar sbyar la/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa// dbang sngon mdog can sgra yi rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis=

/rgyal ba sras bcas sgra yi bde bas mchod// shap+ta/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab= /gser bzang mdog can dri yi rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon= /rgyal ba sras bcas dri yi bde bas mchod// gan+dhe/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab= /nyi ma'i mdog can ro yi rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis= /rgyal ba sras bcas ro yi bde bas mchod// ra sa/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab= /nam mkha'i mdog can reg bya'i rdo rje ma// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon= /rgyal ba sras bcas reg bya'i bde bas mchod// oṃ āḥspar+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas bkra shis pa'i yo byad kyis mchod pa dang*/ nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa dang*/ mchod pa nyi shu pa rnams mchod phreng du bshad pa ltar rgyas par bya'o// de nas bstod pa bya ba'i phyir/ lha so so'i sgos bstod ci rigs pas bstod/ de tsam mi shes na/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ po sti yod na/ dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi// sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes// chos sku'i rang bzhin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang yin na/ de'i nang du bskyed pa'i rigs lnga po la/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku// mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la// 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung*// bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku// skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o// zhes pas bstod/

thun mong du/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad// yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can// yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de// dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin// dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams// sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol// rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*// smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can// 'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*// tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*// khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yang mi 'gyur// e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan// mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pa// khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas// dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yang dag yon tan rgya chen te// lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes pas bstod do// gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho ba'i mnga' dbul ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten thams cad la mnga' dbul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' rgyan// rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcu// gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi'o// zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po dkyil 'khor ni/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal bris pa de phul bar bsams la/ sa gzhi spos kyis byug cing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog

/oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa khrus ni/ dri zhim po'i chus bkru zhing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa na bza' ni/ rten rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can la/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'bul bar bsams la/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā yā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas longs sku dang byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs can gyi rten dang*/ mchod rten dang glegs bam rnams la/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dbul zhing*/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yis// na bza'i mchog ni rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra ba sa s+ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa rgyan ni/ rin po che'i rgyan mang po dbul zhing*/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir// rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang*// rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyi// mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā laṃ kā rā wa bhū ṣe ṇe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga pa 'dod yon rnam lnga ni/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga ci 'byor pa dbul zhing*/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor pa lnga bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ drug pa rin chen bdun ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs dbul zhing*/

mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ badz+ra sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐/ bdun pa bcud ni/ rin po che'i snod gcig gam lngar/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga rnams blugs pa dbul zhing*/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku mnga' brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa dbul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañdza bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ brgyad pa gdugs sogs ni/ gdugs dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla re dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ brtse ba'i 'khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang*/ ting 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba// mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul// skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams thun mong du 'bul lo// gnyis pa rten so so la mnga' dbul ba la gsum las/ dang po sku gzugs la mnga' dbul ba ni/ spu gri 'bregs spyad so mangs dang*// rmang gzer tshems shing sbabs bzhar ro// zhes pa ltar drug las dang po ni/ rten rab byung gi cha lugs can rnams la/ gser gyi spu gris dbu skra dang zhal spu bregs pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang*// gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir// dad pas gser gyi 'bregs spyad phul ba yis// 'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsi dhū la āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa ni/ gser gyi 'bregs spyad kyis sen mo bregs pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang*// bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi// sen mo'i 'bregs spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis// sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog

/oṃ na badz+ra na kha ts+tshe da na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa ni/ rten longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams dang*/ byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs can rnams la/ gser gyi so mangs kyis dbu skra bshad pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ dbu skra rin chen lcangs lo ma dkrugs shing*// mdzes shing blta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang*// bdag blo sbyang phyir rkyen dang 'tshams pa 'di// phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ba la sho dhā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa ni/ gser gyi rmang gzer dbul zhing*/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa// dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang*// mos pas 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba yis// 'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga pa ni/ gser dngul las byas pa'i tshems shing dbul zhing*/ dkar la thag bzang bzhi bcu tshar ba'i tshems// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang*// bdag cag dad pas tshems shing 'bul lags kyis// 'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dhā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ drug pa ni/ gser gyi lpags bzhar dbul zhing*/ bsnyen bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan// thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bo dag na yang*// dag byed 'di ni bdag gis dbul lags kyis// skye bos rtag tu dam chos thos par shog /oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇa sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo// de'ang gsang 'dus la sogs zhal sbyor gyi sku la ni/ spu gri dang 'bregs spyad mi 'bul zhing*/ tshe dpag med la sogs pa longs sku'i rnam pa can la ni spu gri ma gtogs gzhan lnga ka dbul zhing*/ thub dbang la sogs pa sprul sku rnams la so mangs mi dbul bar gzhan lnga ka dbul lo// gnyis pa mchod rten la mnga' dbul ba ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod paṇa 'phan// rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan// zhes pa ltar brgyad las/

dang po srog shing dbul zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig gnyis pa 'khor lo dbul zhing*/ oṃ pra mar+dha nā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig gsum pa dar gyi cod paṇa dbul zhing*/ oṃ pa taṃ kā laṃ pā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub la sogs pas mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ de dag gis mchod rten dang*/ sku gzugs dang*/ gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig bzhi pa 'phan dbul zhing*/ oṃ pa taṃ ke swā hā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig lnga pa chu srin rgyal mtshan dbul zhing*/ oṃ kuṃ bhi ra dh+wa dza swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi btang bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig drug pa gdugs dbul zhing*/ oṃ bh+ra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig bdun pa me tog gi phreng ba dbul zhing*/ oṃ rat+na mā la trāṃ/ ces bya ba dang*/ na maḥs+t+rai yā dh+wa a nu ga te pra tiṣ+ṭha puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te sku blta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig

brgyad pa rin po che la sogs pa'i gdan phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ puṇ+ya dhā ra ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad kyi gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang*/ dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang*/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang*/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du bskong ba nor bu'i rin po che'i gdan dang*/ chags pa'i skyon thams cad spong ba pad+ma'i gdan dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing dbul lo// gsum pa glegs bam la mnga' dbul ba ni/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang*// glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po rin po che'i khri dbul zhing*/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la dbang bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ā sa nā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa na bza' dbul zhing*/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir dbul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa glegs shing dbul zhing*/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang*// thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgab bya ba// phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pradzñā u pa ya a pa dwa ye hūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa glegs thag dbul zhing*/ spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*// ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar// glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yi// 'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog

/oṃ badz+ra pusti ka ban+dha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo// gsum pa sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho gas rab tu gnas bya'i lha dang*/ glegs bam yin na 'od dpag med dang*/ lha khang yin na rnam snang thab tu spyan drangs la/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i 'bru yis gtso byas pa'i sreg blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul/ bdag dang yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir du/ dūrba dang 'bras kyi sbyin sreg ci 'grub bya/ de'i rjes su thab khung gi me la mañdzi'i steng du tshon dkar po'am ser pos byug pa'i snod du bzhag la/ de'i nang du 'bras dang sbrang rtsi dang*/ ka ra dang bsres pa'i 'o ma blugs la/ gtso bo'i sngags bzlas bzhin du 'o thug bsgrubs la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis rten la dbul lo// gal te 'o thug ma grub na snod bzang por lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig gi mthar/ bza' ba dang*/ bca' ba dang*/ btung ba sna tshogs pa bshams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas rten la phul bar bsam zhing*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin chos la spyod par shog /oṃ di bya an+na sa mā dhi dh+yā na pṛ ṇa ne swā hā/ zhes brjod do// bzhi pa sngags kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags pa kun gyis bzung la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrī bhu khaṃ badz+ri bha wa dṛ ḍha tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la/ thams cad kyis lag tu me tog thogs nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don zhing rten la me tog gi char phab pas/
