bkra shis par bsams la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo// dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod// rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo// slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya// slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod// rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no// zhes pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ sta gon gyi skabs ltar 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ nag po chen po la sogs pa la gtor ma dbul lo// gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten gang la gtad par 'dod pa'i chos skyong la/ gtor ma rgya chen po phul la/ khyed kyis rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la bsrung ba dang skyong ba gyis shig ces brjod/ de nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i go bskon pas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par bsam/ de bdag gi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i phyir/ rdo rje thogs nas/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// oṃ ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ yang de'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag par bsams la/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyis shig ces dam la bzhag go /gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod cing dngos grub blang ba ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya zhing*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la dngos grub blang ngo*// bzhi pa bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/

rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dag /gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// nongs gyur bzod par mdzad pa'i rigs// kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa ru// yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// sa dang chu dang me rlung las// lha rnams kun gyi sku gzugs la// bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang*// mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol// dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas ni// slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi// bu dang tsha bo srung mdzad nas// gang gnas dge bar gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa rnams/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis bdag la bsdus la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ phur bu bsdu ba sogs dkyil chog ltar bya'o// gal te rab gnas zin nas kyang*/ sgrub mchod yun ring du byed na gshegs gsol dang nyer bsdu mi bya bar/ brtan bzhugs byed pa nyid do// lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ mdun du stan ser po'i steng du sbyin bdag thal mo sbyar nas 'dug du bcug la/ khyed kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin du// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// zhes dang*/ khyed kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyis/ khyod kyis rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas rgyun mi chad par mchod pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o// drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang sngags kyis yon bdag bsang la/ de nas skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar gsal te/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis khro bo spyan drangs shing bstod pa dang*/ bden pa bdar zhing*/

sbyin bdag 'khor bcas bkra shis par byed pa la/ bar du gcod par brtsams pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la/ las thams cad pa zlos shing*/ rol mo drag tu byas la bgegs bsal lo// de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad mdun du 'du byas la bsang sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sbyin bdag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpon slob thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang*/ sbyin bdag gis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod do// de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang 'dra bar sbyar la/ gi wang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa srungs kyis gi wang phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar la/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar/

dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtsā 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūrba phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don 'di kun 'grub shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur cig /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus byas nas// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pas// bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus rab tu 'joms byed cing*// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na/ zhes sogs sbyar ba'i bkra shis brjod cing*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rten la dbul zhing*/ yon bdag rnams la reg tu gzhug go /bdun pa rten la mchod pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i lha'i mdun du/ mchod pa gsar pa ci 'byor pa bshams la/ ji ltar rigs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas mchod cing bstod pa dang*/

phyag dang bskor ba ci nus su bya'o// brgyad pa bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ slob dpon dpon slob kyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pa bya'o// dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa ni/ sbyin bdag gis slob dpon dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang yon dbul bar bya'o// bcu pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ rab gnas rgyas par bya ba'i don du gnas khang de nyid dam gzhan du yang rung ste/ slob dpon dang dge 'dun dang bzo bo dang*/ grogs byed pa dang*/ zhal ta pa rnams la dga' ston gyi bsnyen bkur rgyas par bya zhing*/ sngar gyi tsā ru'i bza' ba lha la phul ba'i lhag ma rnams tshogs pa thams cad la drangs shing*/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur// zhes brjod do// bcu gcig pa slar yang shis par bya ba ni/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci shes pas der 'tshogs pa rnams bkra shis par bya zhing*/ rten mchod pa'i bsam pas glu dang gar dang rol mo la sogs pa ci nus par bya'o// bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyi rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul ba dang*/ khrus stegs la sogs pa rnams bsdus zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ rnyed pa rnams kyang bgo ste/ gos zung la sogs pa rnams ni 'phan dang rgyal mtshan du byas te/ mchod rten rnams dang gtsug lag khang du 'bul/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dman pa thams cad phongs pa dang mgon med pa'i mi'i 'gro ba la sbyin zhing*/ khyi dang bya rogs sogs la ni/ lhag par dkor du 'gyur bas mi sbyin par bshad do// bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg bya ba ni cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir mtshan mo zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ ma 'grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas so// yon bdag gis kyang zhag bdun du rten la mchod pa bar ma chad du dbul zhing*/

de nas kyang ci nus pas mchod par bya ste/ cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa 'bring du bya ba ni/ nang par gza' skar la sogs pa 'dzom par shes nas phyi dro'i dus su mchod gtor dang bum pa la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams 'tshog par byas la/ sang tho rangs rten gyi drung du 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin phab la sgrub thabs ltar bskyed rim rgyas par bsgom/ de nas bum pa gsum mam gnyis bshams pa'i dang por/ dkyil chog ltar lha thams cad tshang ba dang*/ gnyis par bgegs mthar byed bsams la/ bum bzlas tshul bzhin du bya/ gsum par khrus kyi rdzas rnams ci 'byor par blugs la/ so so'i sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rab gnas kyi sta gon gyi chos rnams dor te/ dngos gzhi'i rten sbyang ba nas brtsams te/ las kyi rjes bsdu ba'i bar sngar bshad pa ci lta ba bzhin du bya ste/ cho ga bar ma'i rim pa'o// gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ mchod gtor bshams pa nas/ bum bzlas kyi bar 'bring ltar bya/ de nas rten sbyangs pa nas spyan dbye ba'i bar sngar bzhin byas nas/ gsol ba gdab pa dang mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba rnams byas la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i sngags kyis mnga' dbul zhing me tog gi char dbab pa ni/ dngos gzhi yin la/ gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ chos skyong bsgo ba sogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams sngar ltar bya ste/ cho ga mdor bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa rab tu gnas par byas pa'i phan yon ni/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yi// brtags pa las gsungs tshul legs pas// de byas bsod nams che ba ni// mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu skyes// sku gzugs kyi ni mtshan nyid kyi// de la byin rlabs 'jug par 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa nyid do// de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas pa legs par bya ba ni/

bstan pa rin po che dang*/ sems can mang po la phan pa kho na yin pas de'i cho ga dag par bya ba shin tu gal che ba yin la/ de'i tshul yang bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud du gsal bar gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang*/ pradzñā pa li ta dang*/ zhi ba snying po dang*/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen rnams kyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ltar bkral zhing*/ de rnams kyi don bsdus nas lo ts+tshā ba chen po rin chen bzang pos sdom du mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa'i srol dang*/ sdom 'byung la sogs pa'i rgyud gzhan gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon a bha yā sogs kyis rnal 'byor bla med ltar byas pa'i cho ga ste/ lugs gnyis las/ 'di ni rab gnas kyi rgyud gyi cho ga dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sbyar ba ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rgyud 'di bla med dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gnyis ka'i thun mong ba yin te/ oṃ ni spyi bor bstim bya zhing*// snying gar hūm̐ gi yi ger 'gyur// ngag gi phyogs su a yig go /ces bla med ltar sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ rig ma spyan ma ji bzhin du// cho ga bzhin du mngon dbang bskur// zhes rig mas dbang bskur ba bshad pa'i phyir ro// bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas phyi'i de nyid bcus khyad par du byas pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyang*/ yo ga kho nar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod de/ phyi'i de nyid bcus khyad par du byas pa'i phyir ro// des na rgyud thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yan chad kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la sbyar bar bshad pa shin tu 'thad par snang bas/ de'i lag len dag par bkod la/

bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i le'u lnga bcu rtsa gsum par bshad pa'i rab gnas ni/ 'di'i cho ga bsdus pa dang khyad par cung zad kyang ma snang zhing*/ bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i cho ga nyi shu par bshad pa'i rab gnas kyang snang mod/ gzhung de the tshom can du grags pas 'dir ma bkod la/ slob dpon a bha ya sogs kyi lugs kyang 'di dang mi mthun pa shin tu mangs pas 'dir ma spros so// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis dang*// bstan 'dzin phrin las rgyas pa'i bkra shis dang*// sbyin bdag bsod nams rgyas pa'i bkra shis rnams// rab tu 'phel phyir bkra shis rab rgyas pa'i// rab gnas cho ga bkra shis rgya mtsho 'di// rgyud dang 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs dang*// rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab ci bzhin du// rnam dkar bkra shis rgyas pa'i thabs 'di bsgrubs// 'dir 'bad dge ba 'od stong bdag po des// bstan pa'i pad tshal rnam par rgyas byas nas// dam chos bkra shis sbrang rtsi'i rtsi bcud kyis// 'gro ba bung ba'i bsam pa tshim byed shog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi snying po dbu ma'i sde snod dang gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshul khong du chud pa gnas brtan sangs rgyas rin chen gyis thog mar bskul ba dang*/ don gnyer gyi slob ma bshes gnyen bzang pos yi ge'i rkyen sbyar zhing 'phral du bskul ba la brten nas mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rgyal ba gnyis pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun bzang pos sna tshogs dbyig gi lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i yar tshes gcig la bkra shis kyi 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// //'dis skye dgu rnams kyi chos dang bkra shis rgyas par gyur cig
/dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
